book.title: Sri Guru Granth Sahib

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: so satigur tin kau bheTiaa jin kai mukh masatak bhaag likh paiaa ||7||
verses.translation: The True Guru meets with those upon whose foreheads such blessed destiny is recorded. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਮਰਜੀਵੜੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat kareh marajeevaRe gurmukh bhagat sadhaa hoi ||
verses.translation: They alone worship the Lord, who remain dead while yet alive; the Gurmukhs worship the Lord continually.

verses.original: ਓਨਾ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: onaa kau dhur bhagat khajaanaa bakhasiaa meT na sakai koi ||
verses.translation: The Lord blesses them with the treasure of devotional worship, which no one can destroy.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਏਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gun nidhaan man paiaa eko sachaa soi ||
verses.translation: They obtain the treasure of virtue, the One True Lord, within their minds.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh mil rahe fir vichhoRaa kadhe na hoi ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs remain united with the Lord; they shall never be separated again. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕੀਨੀਆ ਕਿਆ ਓਹੁ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kee sev na keeneeaa kiaa oh kare veechaar ||
verses.translation: He does not serve the True Guru; how can he reflect upon the Lord?

verses.original: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਬਿਖੁ ਭੂਲਾ ਗਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabadhai saar na jaaniee bikh bhoolaa gaavaar ||
verses.translation: He does not appreciate the value of the Shabad; the fool wanders in corruption and sin.

verses.original: ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: agiaanee a(n)dh bahu karam kamaavai dhoojai bhai piaar ||
verses.translation: The blind and ignorant perform all sorts of ritualistic actions; they are in love with duality.

verses.original: ਅਣਹੋਦਾ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਦੇ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: anahodhaa aap ganaidhe jam maar kare tin khuaar ||
verses.translation: Those who take unjustified pride in themselves, are punished and humiliated by the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak kis no aakheeaai jaa aape bakhasanahaar ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, who else is there to ask? The Lord Himself is the Forgiver. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: too karataa sabh kichh jaanadhaa sabh jeea tumaare ||
verses.translation: You, O Creator, know all things; all beings belong to You.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jis too bhaavai tis too mel laih kiaa ja(n)t vichaare ||
verses.translation: Those who are pleasing to You, You unite with Yourself; what can the poor creatures do?

verses.original: ਤੂ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: too karan kaaran samarath hai sach sirajanahaare ||
verses.translation: You are all-powerful, the Cause of causes, the True Creator Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jis too meleh piaariaa so tudh milai gurmukh veechaare ||
verses.translation: Only those unite with you, Beloved Lord, whom you approve and who meditate on Guru's Word.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਰੇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: hau balihaaree satigur aapane jin meraa har alakh lakhaare ||8||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to my True Guru, who has allowed me to see my unseen Lord. ||8||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਤਨਾ ਪਾਰਖੁ ਜੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਰਤਨਾ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: ratanaa paarakh jo hovai su ratanaa kare veechaar ||
verses.translation: He is the Assayer of jewels; He contemplates the jewel.

verses.original: ਰਤਨਾ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: ratanaa saar na jaaniee agiaanee a(n)dh a(n)dhaar ||
verses.translation: He is ignorant and totally blind - he does not appreciate the value of the jewel.

verses.original: ਰਤਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਬੂਝਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: ratan guroo kaa sabadh hai boojhai boojhanahaar ||
verses.translation: The Jewel is the Word of the Guru's Shabad; the Knower alone knows it.

verses.original: ਮੂਰਖ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਦੇ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: moorakh aap ganaidhe mar ja(n)meh hoi khuaar ||
verses.translation: The fools take pride in themselves, and are ruined in birth and death.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਤਨਾ ਸੋ ਲਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak ratanaa so lahai jis gurmukh lagai piaar ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he alone obtains the jewel, who, as Gurmukh, enshrines love for it.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਨਿਤ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa naam ucharai har naamo nit biauhaar ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, forever and ever, make the Name of the Lord your daily occupation.

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਖਾ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kirapaa kare je aapanee taa har rakhaa ur dhaar ||1||
verses.translation: If the Lord shows His Mercy, then I keep Him enshrined within my heart. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕੀਨੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kee sev na keeneeaa har naam na lago piaar ||
verses.translation: They do not serve the True Guru, and they do not embrace love for the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਮਤ ਤੁਮ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਓਇ ਜੀਵਦੇ ਓਇ ਆਪਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: mat tum jaanahu oi jeevadhe oi aap maare karataar ||
verses.translation: Do not even think that they are alive - the Creator Lord Himself has killed them.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਡਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੂਜੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: haumai vaddaa rog hai bhai dhoojai karam kamai ||
verses.translation: Egotism is such a terrible disease; in the love of duality, they do their deeds.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਮੁਏ ਹਰਿ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak manmukh jeevadhiaa mue har visariaa dhukh pai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukhs are in a living death; forgetting the Lord, they suffer in pain. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਹਿਰਦਾ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਸਭਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jis a(n)tar hiradhaa sudh hai tis jan kau sabh namasakaaree ||
verses.translation: Let all bow in reverence, to that humble being whose heart is pure within.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jis a(n)dhar naam nidhaan hai tis jan kau hau balihaaree ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to that humble being whose mind is filled with the treasure of the Naam.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਬੇਕੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jis a(n)dhar budh bibek hai har naam muraaree ||
verses.translation: He has a discriminating intellect; he meditates on the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਮਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: so satigur sabhanaa kaa mit hai sabh tiseh piaaree ||
verses.translation: That True Guru is a friend to all; everyone is dear to Him.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਬੁਧਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: sabh aatam raam pasaariaa gur budh beechaaree ||9||
verses.translation: The Lord, the Supreme Soul, is pervading everywhere; reflect upon the wisdom of the Guru's Teachings. ||9||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur seve jeea ke ba(n)dhanaa vich haumai karam kamaeh ||
verses.translation: Without serving the True Guru, the soul is in the bondage of deeds done in ego.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੀ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur seve Thaur na paavahee mar ja(n)meh aaveh jaeh ||
verses.translation: Without serving the True Guru, one finds no place of rest; he dies, and is reincarnated, and continues coming and going.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਫਿਕਾ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur seve fikaa bolanaa naam na vasai man maeh ||
verses.translation: Without serving the True Guru, one's speech is vapid and insipid; the Naam, the Name of the Lord, does not abide in his mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਨਿ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak bin satigur seve jam pur badhe maareean muh kaalai uTh jaeh ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without serving the True Guru, they are bound and beaten in the City of Death; they arise and depart with blackened faces. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾਲਉ ਐਸੀ ਰੀਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਮੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaalau aaisee reet jit mai piaaraa veesarai ||
verses.translation: Burn away those rituals which lead you to forget the Beloved Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸੇਤੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਹੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak saiee bhalee pareet jit saahib setee pat rahai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, sublime is that love, which preserves my honor with my Lord Master. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: har iko dhaataa seveeaai har ik dhiaaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Serve the One Lord, the Great Giver; meditate on the One Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: har iko dhaataa ma(n)geeaai man chi(n)dhiaa paieeaai ||
verses.translation: Beg from the One Lord, the Great Giver, and you shall obtain your heart's desires.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਦੂਜੇ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਤਾ ਲਾਜ ਮਰਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: je dhooje paasahu ma(n)geeaai taa laaj maraieeaai ||
verses.translation: But if you beg from another, then you shall be shamed and destroyed.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਭੁਖ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: jin seviaa tin fal paiaa tis jan kee sabh bhukh gavaieeaai ||
verses.translation: One who serves the Lord obtains the fruits of his rewards; all of his hunger is satisfied.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: naanak tin viTahu vaariaa jin anadhin hiradhai har naam dhiaaieeaai ||10||
verses.translation: Nanak is a sacrifice to those, who night and day, meditate within their hearts on the Name of the Lord. ||10||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੰਉ ਆਪਿ ਤੁਠਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਜਨ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat janaa ka(n)au aap tuThaa meraa piaaraa aape lian jan lai ||
verses.translation: He Himself is pleased with His humble devotees; my Beloved Lord attaches them to Himself.

verses.original: ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਦਿਤੀਅਨੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਤੁ ਸਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਬਣਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: paatisaahee bhagat janaa kau dhiteean sir chhat sachaa har banai ||
verses.translation: The Lord blesses His humble devotees with royalty; He fashions the true crown upon their heads.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sukhe'ee niramale satigur kee kaar kamai ||
verses.translation: They are always at peace, and immaculately pure; they perform service for the True Guru.

verses.original: ਰਾਜੇ ਓਇ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਭਿੜਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: raaje oi na aakhe'eeh bhiR mareh fir joonee paeh ||
verses.translation: They are not said to be kings, who die in conflict, and then enter again the cycle of reincarnation.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਕਂੀ ਵਢਂੀ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak vin naavai naka(n)ee vadda(n)ee fireh sobhaa mool na paeh ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the Name of the Lord, they wander about with their noses cut off in disgrace; they get no respect at all. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਿਖਿਐ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: sun sikhiaai saadh na aaio jichar gurmukh sabadh na laagai ||
verses.translation: Hearing the teachings, he does not appreciate them, as long as he is not Gurmukh, attached to the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur seviaai naam man vasai vichahu bhram bhau bhaagai ||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, the Naam comes to abide in the mind, and doubts and fears run away.

verses.original: ਜੇਹਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੇਹੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: jehaa satigur no jaanai teho hovai taa sach naam liv laagai ||
verses.translation: As he knows the True Guru, so he is transformed, and then, he lovingly focuses his consciousness on the Naam.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਆਗੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam milai vaddiaaiee har dhar sohan aagai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, greatness is obtained; he shall be resplendent in the Court of the Lord hereafter. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾਂ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਜਣ ਆਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: gursikhaa(n) man har preet hai gur poojan aaveh ||
verses.translation: The minds of the Gursikhs are filled with the love of the Lord; they come and worship the Guru.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਣੰਜਹਿ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: har naam vana(n)jeh ra(n)g siau laahaa har naam lai jaaveh ||
verses.translation: They trade lovingly in the Lord's Name, and depart after earning the profit of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਭਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: gursikhaa ke mukh ujale har dharageh bhaaveh ||
verses.translation: The faces of the Gursikhs are radiant; in the Court of the Lord, they are approved.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸਿਖ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਂਝ ਕਰਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur satigur bohal har naam kaa vaddabhaagee sikh gun saa(n)jh karaaveh ||
verses.translation: The Guru, the True Guru, is the treasure of the Lord's Name; how very fortunate are the Sikhs who share in this treasure of virtue.

verses.original: ਤਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕੰਉ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜੋ ਬਹਦਿਆ ਉਠਦਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: tinaa gursikhaa ka(n)au hau vaariaa jo bahadhiaa uThadhiaa har naam dhiaaveh ||11||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those Gursikhs who, sitting and standing, meditate on the Lord's Name. ||11||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak naam nidhaan hai gurmukh paiaa jai ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the treasure, which the Gurmukhs obtain.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਦੀ ਵਥੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਅੰਧੇ ਭਉਕਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: manmukh ghar hodhee vath na jaananee a(n)dhe bhauk mue bilalai ||1||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are blind; they do not realize that it is within their own home. They die barking and crying. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੰਚਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਨਿਰਮਲੀ ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: ka(n)chan kaiaa niramalee jo sach naam sach laagee ||
verses.translation: That body is golden and immaculate, which is attached to the True Name of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: niramal jot nira(n)jan paiaa gurmukh bhram bhau bhaagee ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh obtains the Pure Light of the Luminous Lord, and his doubts and fears run away.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh sadhaa sukh paaveh anadhin har bairaagee ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs find lasting peace; night and day, they remain detached, while in the Love of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: se gursikh dhan dha(n)n hai jinee gur upadhes suniaa har ka(n)nee ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed are those Gursikhs, who, with their ears, listen to the Guru's Teachings about the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਹੰਉਮੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਭੰਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur satigur naam dhiraRaiaa tin ha(n)aumai dhubidhaa bha(n)nee ||
verses.translation: The Guru, the True Guru, implants the Naam within them, and their egotism and duality are silenced.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਡਿਠਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੰਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: bin har naavai ko mitr naahee veechaar ddiThaa har ja(n)nee ||
verses.translation: There is no friend, other than the Name of the Lord; the Lord's humble servants reflect upon this and see.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤੁਸਟੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਗਲ ਮੰਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: jinaa gursikhaa kau har sa(n)tusaT hai tinee satigur kee gal ma(n)nee ||
verses.translation: Those Gursikhs, with whom the Lord is pleased, accept the Word of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਤਿਨੀ ਚੜੀ ਚਵਗਣਿ ਵੰਨੀ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: jo gurmukh naam dhiaaidhe tinee chaRee chavagan va(n)nee ||12||
verses.translation: Those Gurmukhs who meditate on the Naam are imbued with the four-fold color of the Lord's Love. ||12||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਕਾਇਰੁ ਕਰੂਪੁ ਹੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਕੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh kair karoop hai bin naavai nak naeh ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh is cowardly and ugly; lacking the Name of the Lord, his nose is cut off in disgrace.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਭੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin dha(n)dhai viaapiaa supanai bhee sukh naeh ||
verses.translation: Night and day, he is engrossed in worldly affairs, and even in his dreams, he finds no peace.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਉਬਰਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ ਤ ਬਧੇ ਦੁਖ ਸਹਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh hoveh taa ubareh naeh ta badhe dhukh sahaeh ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, if he becomes Gurmukh, then he shall be saved; otherwise, he is held in bondage, and suffers in pain. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sadhaa dhar sohane gur kaa sabadh kamaeh ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs always look beautiful in the Court of the Lord; they practice the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar saa(n)t sadhaa sukh dhar sachai sobhaa paeh ||
verses.translation: There is a lasting peace and happiness deep within them; at the Court of the True Lord, they receive honor.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh har naam paiaa sahaje sach samaeh ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are blessed with the Name of the Lord; they merge imperceptibly into the True Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh prahilaadh jap har gat paiee ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, Prahlaad meditated on the Lord, and was saved.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh janak har naam liv laiee ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, Janak lovingly centered his consciousness on the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਸਿਸਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੁਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh basisaT har upadhes sunaiee ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, Vashisht taught the Teachings of the Lord.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਿਨੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur har naam na kinai paiaa mere bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, no one has found the Lord's Name, O my Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਲਹਾਈ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: gurmukh har bhagat har aap lahaiee ||13||
verses.translation: The Lord blesses the Gurmukh with devotion. ||13||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਈਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੋ ਭਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kee parateet na aaieeaa sabadh na laago bhaau ||
verses.translation: One who has no faith in the True Guru, and who does not love the Word of the Shabad,

verses.original: ਓਸ ਨੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਉਪਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਉ ਗੇੜਾ ਆਵਉ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: os no sukh na upajai bhaavai sau geRaa aavau jaau ||
verses.translation: shall find no peace, even though he may come and go hundreds of times.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh sahaj milai sache siau liv laau ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh meets the True Lord with natural ease; he is in love with the Lord. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਏ ਮਨ ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: e man aaisaa satigur khoj lahu jit seviaai janam maran dhukh jai ||
verses.translation: O mind, search for such a True Guru, by serving whom the pains of birth and death are dispelled.

verses.original: ਸਹਸਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sahasaa mool na hoviee haumai sabadh jalai ||
verses.translation: Doubt shall never afflict you, and your ego shall be burnt away through the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਕੂੜੈ ਕੀ ਪਾਲਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: kooRai kee paal vichahu nikalai sach vasai man aai ||
verses.translation: The veil of falsehood shall be torn down from within you, and Truth shall come to dwell in the mind.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਚ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar saa(n)t man sukh hoi sach sa(n)jam kaar kamai ||
verses.translation: Peace and happiness shall fill your mind deep within, if you act according to truth and self-discipline.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak poorai karam satigur milai har jeeau kirapaa kare rajai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, by perfect good karma, you shall meet the True Guru, and then the Dear Lord, by His Sweet Will, shall bless you with His Mercy. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਦੀਬਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਮੁਠੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jis kai ghar dheebaan har hovai tis kee muThee vich jagat sabh aaiaa ||
verses.translation: The whole world comes under the control of one whose home is filled with the Lord, the King.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਤਲਕੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਬਾਨਿ ਸਭਿ ਆਣਿ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tis kau talakee kisai dhee naahee har dheebaan sabh aan pairee paiaa ||
verses.translation: He is subject to no one else's rule, and the Lord, the King, causes everyone to fall at his feet.

verses.original: ਮਾਣਸਾ ਕਿਅਹੁ ਦੀਬਾਣਹੁ ਕੋਈ ਨਸਿ ਭਜਿ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਬਾਣਹੁ ਕੋਈ ਕਿਥੈ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: maanasaa kiahu dheebaanahu koiee nas bhaj nikalai har dheebaanahu koiee kithai jaiaa ||
verses.translation: One may run away from the courts of other men, but where can one go to escape the Lord's Kingdom?

verses.original: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਬਾਨੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਤਿਨਿ ਰਹਦੇ ਖੁਹਦੇ ਆਣਿ ਸਭਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਅਗੈ ਖਲਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: so aaisaa har dheebaan vasiaa bhagataa kai hiradhai tin rahadhe khuhadhe aan sabh bhagataa agai khalavaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord is such a King, who abides in the hearts of His devotees; He brings the others, and makes them stand before His devotees.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: har naavai kee vaddiaaiee karam paraapat hovai gurmukh viralai kinai dhiaaiaa ||14||
verses.translation: The glorious greatness of the Lord's Name is obtained only by His Grace; how few are the Gurmukhs who meditate on Him. ||14||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਮੁਆ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur seve jagat muaa birathaa janam gavai ||
verses.translation: Without serving the True Guru, the people of the world are dead; they waste their lives away in vain.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਅਤਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਗਾ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bhai at dhukh lagaa mar ja(n)mai aavai jai ||
verses.translation: In love with duality, they suffer terrible pain; they die, and are reincarnated, and continue coming and going.

verses.original: ਵਿਸਟਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: visaTaa a(n)dhar vaas hai fir fir joonee pai ||
verses.translation: They live in manure, and are reincarnated again and again.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਸੀ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak bin naavai jam maarasee a(n)t giaa pachhutai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the Name, the Messenger of Death punishes them; in the end, they depart regretting and repenting. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਹੋਰ ਸਗਲੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਸਬਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: eis jag meh purakh ek hai hor sagalee naar sabaiee ||
verses.translation: In this world, there is one Husband Lord; all other beings are His brides.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਘਟ ਭੋਗਵੈ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ghaT bhogavai alipat rahai alakh na lakhanaa jaiee ||
verses.translation: He enjoys the hearts of all, and yet He remains detached; He is unseen; He cannot be described.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਵੇਖਾਲਿਆ ਸਬਦੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: poorai gur vekhaaliaa sabadhe sojhee paiee ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru reveals Him, and through the Word of His Shabad, we come to understand Him.

verses.original: ਪੁਰਖੈ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: purakhai seveh se purakh hoveh jinee haumai sabadh jalaiee ||
verses.translation: Those who serve their Husband Lord, become like Him; their egos are burnt away by His Shabad.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਰੀਕੁ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਵੈਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: tis kaa sareek ko nahee naa ko ka(n)Tak vairaiee ||
verses.translation: He has no rival, no attacker, no enemy.

verses.original: ਨਿਹਚਲ ਰਾਜੁ ਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੇਰਾ ਨਾ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: nihachal raaj hai sadhaa tis keraa naa aavai naa jaiee ||
verses.translation: His rule is unchanging and eternal; He does not come or go.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin sevak sevaa kare har sache ke gun gaiee ||
verses.translation: Night and day, His servant serves Him, singing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak vekh vigasiaa har sache kee vaddiaaiee ||2||
verses.translation: Beholding the Glorious Greatness of the True Lord, Nanak blossoms forth. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਦ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਤਿਨ ਕੰਉ ਰਖਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jin kai har naam vasiaa sadh hiradhai har naamo tin ka(n)au rakhanahaaraa ||
verses.translation: Those whose hearts are forever filled with the Name of the Lord, have the Name of the Lord as their Protector.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਮਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: har naam pitaa har naamo maataa har naam sakhaiee mitr hamaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is my father, the Lord's Name is my mother; the Lord's Name is my helper and friend.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਗਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਮਸਲਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਕਰਦਾ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: har naavai naal galaa har naavai naal masalat har naam hamaaree karadhaa nit saaraa ||
verses.translation: My conversation is with the Lord's Name, and my counseling is with the Lord's Name; the Lord's Name always takes care of me.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੁਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਵਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: har naam hamaaree sa(n)gat at piaaree har naam kul har naam paravaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is my most beloved society, the Lord's Name is my ancestry, and the Lord's Name is my family.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੰਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: jan naanak ka(n)au har naam har gur dheeaa har halat palat sadhaa kare nisataaraa ||15||
verses.translation: The Guru, the Lord Incarnate, has bestowed upon servant Nanak the Name of the Lord; in this world, and in the next, the Lord ever saves me. ||15||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕੰਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jin ka(n)au satigur bheTiaa se har keerat sadhaa kamaeh ||
verses.translation: Those who meet the True Guru, ever sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

verses.original: ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: achi(n)t har naam tin kai man vasiaa sachai sabadh samaeh ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name naturally fills their minds, and they are absorbed in the Shabad, the Word of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਕੁਲੁ ਉਧਾਰਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਮੋਖ ਪਦਵੀ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: kul udhaareh aapanaa mokh padhavee aape paeh ||
verses.translation: They redeem their generations, and they themselves obtain the state of liberation.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੰਉ ਸੰਤੁਸਟੁ ਭਇਆ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਜਨ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham tin ka(n)au sa(n)tusaT bhiaa jo gur charanee jan paeh ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God is pleased with those who fall at the Guru's Feet.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਜ ਰਖਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak har kaa dhaas hai kar kirapaa har laaj rakhaeh ||1||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak is the Lord's slave; by His Grace, the Lord preserves his honor. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਹੰਉਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਖੜਕੁ ਹੈ ਖੜਕੇ ਖੜਕਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ha(n)aumai a(n)dhar khaRak hai khaRake khaRak vihai ||
verses.translation: In egotism, one is assailed by fear; he passes his life totally troubled by fear.

verses.original: ਹੰਉਮੈ ਵਡਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ha(n)aumai vaddaa rog hai mar ja(n)mai aavai jai ||
verses.translation: Egotism is such a terrible disease; he dies, to be reincarnated - he continues coming and going.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: jin kau poorab likhiaa tinaa satagur miliaa prabh aai ||
verses.translation: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny meet with the True Guru, God Incarnate.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਉਬਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gur parasaadhee ubare haumai sabadh jalai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, by Guru's Grace, they are redeemed; their egos are burnt away through the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਗਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: har naam hamaaraa prabh abigat agochar abinaasee purakh bidhaataa ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is my immortal, unfathomable, imperishable Creator Lord, the Architect of Destiny.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮ ਸ੍ਰੇਵਹ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮ ਪੂਜਹ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: har naam ham sreveh har naam ham poojeh har naame hee man raataa ||
verses.translation: I serve the Lord's Name, I worship the Lord's Name, and my soul is imbued with the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਕੋਈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਅੰਤਿ ਛਡਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: har naamai jevadd koiee avar na soojhai har naamo a(n)t chhaddaataa ||
verses.translation: I know of no other as great as the Lord's Name; the Lord's Name shall deliver me in the end.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: har naam dheeaa gur paraupakaaree dhan dha(n)n guroo kaa pitaa maataa ||
verses.translation: The Generous Guru has given me the Lord's Name; blessed, blessed are the Guru's mother and father.

verses.original: ਹੰਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਣੇ ਕੰਉ ਸਦਾ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੈ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: ha(n)au satigur apune ka(n)au sadhaa namasakaaree jit miliaai har naam mai jaataa ||16||
verses.translation: I ever bow in humble reverence to my True Guru; meeting Him, I have come to know the Lord's Name. ||16||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕੀਨੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sev na keeneeaa har naam na lago piaar ||
verses.translation: One who does not serve the Guru as Gurmukh, who does not love the Lord's Name,

verses.original: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: sabadhai saadh na aaio mar janamai vaaro vaar ||
verses.translation: and who does not savor the taste of the Shabad, shall die, and be reborn, over and over again.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਈ ਕਿਤੁ ਆਇਆ ਸੈਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh a(n)dh na chetiee kit aaiaa saisaar ||
verses.translation: The blind, self-willed manmukh does not think of the Lord; why did he even come into the world?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲੰਘੇ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak jin kau nadhar kare se gurmukh la(n)ghe paar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, that Gurmukh, upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, crosses over the world-ocean. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਇਕੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਾਗਤਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਜਗੁ ਸੂਤਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਿਆਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: eiko satigur jaagataa hor jag sootaa moh piaas ||
verses.translation: Only the Guru is awake; the rest of the world is asleep in emotional attachment and desire.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਜਾਗੰਨਿ ਸੇ ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sevan jaaga(n)n se jo rate sach naam gunataas ||
verses.translation: Those who serve the True Guru and remain wakeful, are imbued with the True Name, the treasure of virtue.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧ ਨ ਚੇਤਨੀ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰਿ ਹੋਹਿ ਬਿਨਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh a(n)dh na chetanee janam mar hoh binaas ||
verses.translation: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not think of the Lord; they are ruined through birth and death.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜਿਨ ਕੰਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆਸਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh tinee naam dhiaaiaa jin ka(n)au dhur poorab likhiaas ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; this is their destiny, pre-ordained by the Primal Lord God. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਛਤੀਹ ਪਰਕਾਰ ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਇਐ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਭਈ ॥
verses.translit: har naam hamaaraa bhojan chhateeh parakaar jit khaiaai ham kau tirapat bhiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is my food; eating the thirty-six varieties of it, I am satisfied and satiated.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਨੰਗੇ ਨ ਹੋਵਹ ਹੋਰ ਪੈਨਣ ਕੀ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਸਰਧ ਗਈ ॥
verses.translit: har naam hamaaraa painan jit fir na(n)ge na hoveh hor painan kee hamaaree saradh giee ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is my clothing; wearing it, I shall never be naked again, and my desire to wear other clothing is gone.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਵਣਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਕੀ ਹਮ ਕੰਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਰਕੁਨੀ ਦੀਈ ॥
verses.translit: har naam hamaaraa vanaj har naam vaapaar har naamai kee ham ka(n)au satigur kaarakunee dheeiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is my business, the Lord's Name is my commerce; the True Guru has blessed me with its use.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਕਾ ਹਮ ਲੇਖਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸਭ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਅਗਲੀ ਕਾਣਿ ਗਈ ॥
verses.translit: har naamai kaa ham lekhaa likhiaa sabh jam kee agalee kaan giee ||
verses.translation: I record the account of the Lord's Name, and I shall not be subject to death again.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜਿਨ ਕੰਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਪਈ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam gurmukh kinai viralai dhiaaiaa jin ka(n)au dhur karam paraapat likhat piee ||17||
verses.translation: Only a few, as Gurmukh, meditate on the Lord's Name; they are blessed by the Lord, and receive their pre-ordained destiny. ||17||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਗਤੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jagat agiaanee a(n)dh hai dhoojai bhai karam kamai ||
verses.translation: The world is blind and ignorant; in the love of duality, it engages in actions.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਜੇਤੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਗੈ ਤਨਿ ਧਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bhai jete karam kare dhukh lagai tan dhai ||
verses.translation: But those actions which are performed in the love of duality, cause only pain to the body.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਜਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee sukh uoopajai jaa gur kaa sabadh kamai ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, peace wells up, when one acts according to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: sachee baanee karam kare anadhin naam dhiaai ||
verses.translation: He acts according to the True Word of the Guru's Bani; night and day, he meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਤੁ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਏ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗੇ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak jit aape laae tit lage kahanaa kichhoo na jai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, as the Lord Himself engages him, so is he engaged; no one has any say in this matter. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਮ ਘਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: ham ghar naam khajaanaa sadhaa hai bhagat bhare bha(n)ddaaraa ||
verses.translation: Within the home of my own being, is the everlasting treasure of the Naam; it is a treasure house, overflowing with devotion.

verses.original: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਸਦ ਜੀਵੈ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: satagur dhaataa jeea kaa sadh jeevai dhevanahaaraa ||
verses.translation: The True Guru is the Giver of the life of the soul; the Great Giver lives forever.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin keeratan sadhaa kareh gur kai sabadh apaaraa ||
verses.translation: Night and day, I continually sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise, through the Infinite Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ ਸਦ ਉਚਰਹਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਵਰਤਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh guroo kaa sadh uchareh jug jug varataavanahaaraa ||
verses.translation: I recite continually the Guru's Shabads, which have been effective throughout the ages.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: eih manooaa sadhaa sukh vasai sahaje kare vaapaaraa ||
verses.translation: This mind ever abides in peace, dealing in peace and poise.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਹੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar gur giaan har ratan hai mukat karaavanahaaraa ||
verses.translation: Deep within me is the Guru's Wisdom, the Lord's jewel, the Bringer of liberation.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak jis no nadhar kare so paae so hovai dhar sachiaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one who is blessed by the Lord's Glance of Grace obtains this, and is judged to be True in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਜਾਇ ਪਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)n dha(n)n so gursikh kaheeaai jo satigur charanee jai piaa ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed is that Sikh of the Guru, who goes and falls at the Feet of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)n dha(n)n so gursikh kaheeaai jin har naamaa mukh raam kahiaa ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed is that Sikh of the Guru, who with his mouth, utters the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)n dha(n)n so gursikh kaheeaai jis har naam suniaai man anadh bhiaa ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed is that Sikh of the Guru, whose mind, upon hearing the Lord's Name, becomes blissful.

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)n dha(n)n so gursikh kaheeaai jin satigur sevaa kar har naam liaa ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed is that Sikh of the Guru, who serves the True Guru, and so obtains the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਕੰਉ ਹੰਉ ਸਦਾ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੀ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਚਲਿਆ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: tis gursikh ka(n)au ha(n)au sadhaa namasakaaree jo gur kai bhaanai gursikh chaliaa ||18||
verses.translation: I bow forever in deepest respect to that Sikh of the Guru, who walks in the Way of the Guru. ||18||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਭ ਥਕੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: manahaTh kinai na paio sabh thake karam kamai ||
verses.translation: No one has ever found the Lord through stubborn-mindedness. All have grown weary of performing such actions.

verses.original: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਿ ਭਰਮਦੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: manahaTh bhekh kar bharamadhe dhukh paiaa dhoojai bhai ||
verses.translation: Through their stubborn-mindedness, and by wearing their disguises, they are deluded; they suffer in pain from the love of duality.

verses.original: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਸਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: ridh sidh sabh moh hai naam na vasai man aai ||
verses.translation: Riches and the supernatural spiritual powers of the Siddhas are all emotional attachments; through them, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, does not come to dwell in the mind.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur sevaa te man niramal hovai agiaan a(n)dheraa jai ||
verses.translation: Serving the Guru, the mind becomes immaculately pure, and the darkness of spiritual ignorance is dispelled.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਘਰਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naam ratan ghar paragaT hoaa naanak sahaj samai ||1||
verses.translation: The jewel of the Naam is revealed in the home of one's own being; O Nanak, one merges in celestial bliss. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabadhai saadh na aaio naam na lago piaar ||
verses.translation: One who does not savor the taste of the Shabad, who does not love the Naam, the Name of the Lord,

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਫਿਕਾ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: rasanaa fikaa bolanaa nit nit hoi khuaar ||
verses.translation: and who speaks insipid words with his tongue, is ruined, again and again.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਪਇਐ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak kirat piaai kamaavanaa koi na meTanahaar ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he acts according to the karma of his past actions, which no one can erase. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhan dhan sat purakh satiguroo hamaaraa jit miliaai ham kau saa(n)t aaiee ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed is the True Being, my True Guru; meeting Him, I have found peace.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhan dhan sat purakh satiguroo hamaaraa jit miliaai ham har bhagat paiee ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed is the True Being, my True Guru; meeting Him, I have attained the Lord's devotional worship.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhan dhan har bhagat satiguroo hamaaraa jis kee sevaa te ham har naam liv laiee ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed is the Lord's devotee, my True Guru; serving Him, I have come to enshrine love for the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਵੈਰੀ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਸਭ ਸਮ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhan dhan har giaanee satiguroo hamaaraa jin vairee mitr ham kau sabh sam dhirasaT dhikhaiee ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed is the Knower of the Lord, my True Guru; He has taught me to look upon friend and foe alike.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਣਾਈ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: dhan dhan satiguroo mitr hamaaraa jin har naam siau hamaaree preet banaiee ||19||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed is the True Guru, my best friend; He has led me to embrace love for the Name of the Lord. ||19||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮੁੰਧਿ ਵਿਦੇਸਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਨਿਤ ਝੂਰੇ ਸੰਮ੍ਹਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: ghar hee mu(n)dh vidhes pir nit jhoore sa(n)mhaale ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride is at home, while the Husband Lord is away; she cherishes His memory, and mourns His absence.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਦਿਆ ਢਿਲ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਨੀਅਤਿ ਰਾਸਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: miladhiaa ddil na hoviee je neeat raas kare ||1||
verses.translation: She shall meet Him without delay, if she rids herself of duality. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਾਲੀ ਕੂੜੀਆ ਬਾਝੁ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak gaalee kooReeaa baajh pareet karei ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, false is the speech of one who acts without loving the Lord.

verses.original: ਤਿਚਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਭਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਲੇਵੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tichar jaanai bhalaa kar jichar levai dhei ||2||
verses.translation: He judges things to be good, only as long as the Lord gives and he receives. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਜੀਅ ਤਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin upaae jeea tin har raakhiaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord, who created the creatures, also protects them.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit sachaa naau bhojan chaakhiaa ||
verses.translation: I have tasted the food of Ambrosial Nectar, the True Name.

verses.original: ਤਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਇ ਮਿਟੀ ਭਭਾਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: tipat rahe aaghai miTee bhabhaakhiaa ||
verses.translation: I am satisfied and satiated, and my hunger is appeased.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਲਾਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh a(n)dhar ik varatai kinai viralai laakhiaa ||
verses.translation: The One Lord is pervading in all, but rare are those who realize this.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪਾਖਿਆ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: jan naanak bhe nihaal prabh kee paakhiaa ||20||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak is enraptured, in the Protection of God. ||20||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਵੇਖਦਾ ਜੇਤਾ ਜਗਤੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur no sabh ko vekhadhaa jetaa jagat sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: All the living beings of the world behold the True Guru.

verses.original: ਡਿਠੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: ddiThai mukat na hoviee jichar sabadh na kare veechaar ||
verses.translation: One is not liberated by merely seeing Him, unless one contemplates the Word of His Shabad.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: haumai mail na chukiee naam na lagai piaar ||
verses.translation: The filth of ego is not removed, and he does not enshrine love for the Naam.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: eik aape bakhas milaian dhubidhaa taj vikaar ||
verses.translation: The Lord forgives some, and unites them with Himself; they forsake their duality and sinful ways.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਕਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਮਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak ik dharasan dhekh mar mile satigur het piaar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, some behold the Blessed Vision of the True Guru's Darshan, with love and affection; conquering their ego, they meet with the Lord. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਧ ਗਵਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: satiguroo na sevio moorakh a(n)dh gavaar ||
verses.translation: The foolish, blind clown does not serve the True Guru.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਲਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bhai bahut dhukh laagaa jalataa kare pukaar ||
verses.translation: In love with duality, he endures terrible suffering, and burning, he cries out in pain.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੇ ਨ ਉਪਕਰੇ ਅੰਤੀ ਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jin kaaran guroo visaariaa se na upakare a(n)tee vaar ||
verses.translation: He forgets the Guru, for the sake of mere objects, but they will not come to his rescue in the end.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਖਸੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmatee sukh paiaa bakhase bakhasanahaar ||2||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Instructions, Nanak has found peace; the Forgiving Lord has forgiven him. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਕੋਈ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਅਵਰੋ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: too aape aap aap sabh karataa koiee dhoojaa hoi su avaro kaheeaai ||
verses.translation: You Yourself, all by Yourself, are the Creator of all. If there were any other, then I would speak of another.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਬੋਲੈ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: har aape bolai aap bulaavai har aape jal thal rav raheeaai ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself speaks, and causes us to speak; He Himself is pervading the water and the land.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਛੋਡੈ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣੀ ਪੜਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: har aape maarai har aape chhoddai man har saranee paR raheeaai ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself destroys, and the Lord Himself saves. O mind, seek and remain in the Lord's Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋਈ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਮਨ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਚਿੰਦ ਨਿਸਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: har bin koiee maar jeevaal na sakai man hoi nichi(n)dh nisal hoi raheeaai ||
verses.translation: Other than the Lord, no one can kill or rejuvenate. O mind, do not be anxious - remain fearless.

verses.original: ਉਠਦਿਆ ਬਹਦਿਆ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੨੧॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ
verses.translit: auThadhiaa bahadhiaa sutiaa sadhaa sadhaa har naam dhiaaieeaai jan naanak gurmukh har laheeaai ||21||1|| sudhu
verses.translation: While standing, sitting, and sleeping, forever and ever, meditate on the Lord's Name; O servant Nanak, as Gurmukh, you shall attain the Lord. ||21||1||Sudh||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa pehilaa ghar pehilaa chaupadhe ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, First Mehla, First House, Chau-Padhay:

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਮਰਣਾ ਆਇਆ ਵੇਛੋੜਾ ਸਭਨਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa maranaa aaiaa vechhoRaa sabhanaeh ||
verses.translation: Death comes to all, and all must suffer separation.

verses.original: ਪੁਛਹੁ ਜਾਇ ਸਿਆਣਿਆ ਆਗੈ ਮਿਲਣੁ ਕਿਨਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: puchhahu jai siaaniaa aagai milan kinaeh ||
verses.translation: Go and ask the clever people, whether they shall meet in the world hereafter.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਵਡੜੀ ਵੇਦਨ ਤਿਨਾਹ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jin meraa saahib veesarai vaddaRee vedhan tinaeh ||1||
verses.translation: Those who forget my Lord and Master shall suffer in terrible pain. ||1||

verses.original: ਭੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਹੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhee saalaahih saachaa soi ||
verses.translation: So praise the True Lord,

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kee nadhar sadhaa sukh hoi || rahaau ||
verses.translation: by whose Grace peace ever prevails. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਵਡਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaa kar saalaahanaa hai bhee hosee soi ||
verses.translation: Praise Him as great; He is, and He shall ever be.

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਮਾਣਸ ਦਾਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa dhaataa ek too maanas dhaat na hoi ||
verses.translation: You alone are the Great Giver; mankind cannot give anything.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਰੰਨ ਕਿ ਰੁੰਨੈ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jo tis bhaavai so theeaai ra(n)n k ru(n)nai hoi ||2||
verses.translation: Whatever pleases Him, comes to pass; what good does it do to cry out in protest? ||2||

verses.original: ਧਰਤੀ ਉਪਰਿ ਕੋਟ ਗੜ ਕੇਤੀ ਗਈ ਵਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dharatee upar koT gaR ketee giee vajai ||
verses.translation: Many have proclaimed their sovereignty over millions of fortresses on the earth, but they have now departed.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਅਸਮਾਨਿ ਨ ਮਾਵਨੀ ਤਿਨ ਨਕਿ ਨਥਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jo asamaan na maavanee tin nak nathaa pai ||
verses.translation: And those, whom even the sky could not contain, had ropes put through their noses.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਮਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੂਲੀਆ ਕਾਹੇ ਮਿਠਾ ਖਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: je man jaaneh sooleeaa kaahe miThaa khaeh ||3||
verses.translation: O mind, if you only knew the torment in your future, you would not relish the sweet pleasures of the present. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਉਗੁਣ ਜੇਤੜੇ ਤੇਤੇ ਗਲੀ ਜੰਜੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: naanak aaugun jetaRe tete galee ja(n)jeer ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, as many as are the sins one commits, so many are the chains around his neck.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਹੋਨਿ ਤ ਕਟੀਅਨਿ ਸੇ ਭਾਈ ਸੇ ਵੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: je gun hon ta kaTeean se bhaiee se veer ||
verses.translation: If he possesses virtues, then the chains are cut away; these virtues are his brothers, his true brothers.

verses.original: ਅਗੈ ਗਏ ਨ ਮੰਨੀਅਨਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢਹੁ ਵੇਪੀਰ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: agai ge na ma(n)neean maar kaddahu vepeer ||4||1||
verses.translation: Going to the world hereafter, those who have no Guru are not accepted; they are beaten, and expelled. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa pehilaa ghar pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, First Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਹਾਲੀ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੀ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਰਮੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਤਨੁ ਖੇਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: man haalee kirasaanee karanee saram paanee tan khet ||
verses.translation: Make your mind the farmer, good deeds the farm, modesty the water, and your body the field.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਬੀਜੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸੁਹਾਗਾ ਰਖੁ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਵੇਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: naam beej sa(n)tokh suhaagaa rakh gareebee ves ||
verses.translation: Let the Lord's Name be the seed, contentment the plow, and your humble dress the fence.

verses.original: ਭਾਉ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਜੰਮਸੀ ਸੇ ਘਰ ਭਾਗਠ ਦੇਖੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhaau karam kar ja(n)masee se ghar bhaagaTh dhekh ||1||
verses.translation: Doing deeds of love, the seed shall sprout, and you shall see your home flourish. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: baabaa maiaa saath na hoi ||
verses.translation: O Baba, the wealth of Maya does not go with anyone.

verses.original: ਇਨਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਗੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ein maiaa jag mohiaa viralaa boojhai koi || rahaau ||
verses.translation: This Maya has bewitched the world, but only a rare few understand this. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਾਣੁ ਹਟੁ ਕਰਿ ਆਰਜਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਵਥੁ ॥
verses.translit: haan haT kar aarajaa sach naam kar vath ||
verses.translation: Make your ever-decreasing life your shop, and make the Lord's Name your merchandise.

verses.original: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੋਚ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਂਡਸਾਲ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਰਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: surat soch kar bhaa(n)ddasaal tis vich tis no rakh ||
verses.translation: Make understanding and contemplation your warehouse, and in that warehouse, store the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਸਿਉ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਿ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਮਨ ਹਸੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: vanajaariaa siau vanaj kar lai laahaa man has ||2||
verses.translation: Deal with the Lord's dealers, earn your profits, and rejoice in your mind. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਸਉਦਾਗਰੀ ਸਤੁ ਘੋੜੇ ਲੈ ਚਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: sun saasat saudhaagaree sat ghoRe lai chal ||
verses.translation: Let your trade be listening to scripture, and let Truth be the horses you take to sell.

verses.original: ਖਰਚੁ ਬੰਨੁ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਮਤੁ ਮਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਕਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: kharach ba(n)n cha(n)giaaieeaa mat man jaaneh kal ||
verses.translation: Gather up merits for your travelling expenses, and do not think of tomorrow in your mind.

verses.original: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਕੈ ਦੇਸਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਤਾ ਸੁਖਿ ਲਹਹਿ ਮਹਲੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: nira(n)kaar kai dhes jaeh taa sukh laheh mahal ||3||
verses.translation: When you arrive in the land of the Formless Lord, you shall find peace in the Mansion of His Presence. ||3||

verses.original: ਲਾਇ ਚਿਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਕੰਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: lai chit kar chaakaree ma(n)n naam kar ka(n)m ||
verses.translation: Let your service be the focusing of your consciousness, and let your occupation be the placing of faith in the Naam.

verses.original: ਬੰਨੁ ਬਦੀਆ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਵਣੀ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਧੰਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)n badheeaa kar dhaavanee taa ko aakhai dha(n)n ||
verses.translation: Let your work be restraint from sin; only then will people call you blessed.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਵੇਖੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਚੜੈ ਚਵਗਣ ਵੰਨੁ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak vekhai nadhar kar chaRai chavagan va(n)n ||4||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord shall look upon you with His Glance of Grace, and you shall be blessed with honor four times over. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਃ ੧ ਚਉਤੁਕੇ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa pehilaa chautuke ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, First Mehla, Chau-Thukay:

verses.original: ਮਾਇ ਬਾਪ ਕੋ ਬੇਟਾ ਨੀਕਾ ਸਸੁਰੈ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਜਵਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: mai baap ko beTaa neekaa sasurai chatur javaiee ||
verses.translation: The son is dear to his mother and father; he is the wise son-in-law to his father-in-law.

verses.original: ਬਾਲ ਕੰਨਿਆ ਕੌ ਬਾਪੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਭਾਈ ਕੌ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: baal ka(n)niaa kau baap piaaraa bhaiee kau at bhaiee ||
verses.translation: The father is dear to his son and daughter, and the brother is very dear to his brother.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਭਇਆ ਬਾਹਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਭਈ ਪਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: hukam bhiaa baahar ghar chhoddiaa khin meh bhiee paraiee ||
verses.translation: By the Order of the Lord's Command, he leaves his house and goes outside, and in an instant, everything becomes alien to him.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਨ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਧੂੜਿ ਧੁਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naam dhaan isanaan na manmukh tit tan dhooR dhumaiee ||1||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh does not remember the Name of the Lord, does not give in charity, and does not cleanse his consciousness; his body rolls in the dust. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: man maaniaa naam sakhaiee ||
verses.translation: The mind is comforted by the Comforter of the Naam.

verses.original: ਪਾਇ ਪਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: pai parau gur kai balihaarai jin saachee boojh bujhaiee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: I fall at the Guru's feet - I am a sacrifice to Him; He has given me to understand the true understanding. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਗ ਸਿਉ ਝੂਠ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਵਾਦੁ ਰਚਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jag siau jhooTh preet man bedhiaa jan siau vaadh rachaiee ||
verses.translation: The mind is impressed with the false love of the world; he quarrels with the Lord's humble servant.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਗਨੁ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਮਗੁ ਜੋਹੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲੇਵੈ ਮਰੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa magan ahinis mag johai naam na levai marai bikh khaiee ||
verses.translation: Infatuated with Maya, night and day, he sees only the worldly path; he does not chant the Naam, and drinking poison, he dies.

verses.original: ਗੰਧਣ ਵੈਣਿ ਰਤਾ ਹਿਤਕਾਰੀ ਸਬਦੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: ga(n)dhan vain rataa hitakaaree sabadhai surat na aaiee ||
verses.translation: He is imbued and infatuated with vicious talk; the Word of the Shabad does not come into his consciousness.

verses.original: ਰੰਗਿ ਨ ਰਾਤਾ ਰਸਿ ਨਹੀ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ra(n)g na raataa ras nahee bedhiaa manmukh pat gavaiee ||2||
verses.translation: He is not imbued with the Lord's Love, and he is not impressed by the taste of the Name; the self-willed manmukh loses his honor. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਸਭਾ ਮਹਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਰਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: saadh sabhaa meh sahaj na chaakhiaa jihabaa ras nahee raiee ||
verses.translation: He does not enjoy celestial peace in the Company of the Holy, and there is not even a bit of sweetness on his tongue.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਦਰ ਕੀ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: man tan dhan apunaa kar jaaniaa dhar kee khabar na paiee ||
verses.translation: He calls his mind, body and wealth his own; he has no knowledge of the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਅਖੀ ਮੀਟਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਦਿਸੈ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: akhee meeT chaliaa a(n)dhiaaraa ghar dhar dhisai na bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Closing his eyes, he walks in darkness; he cannot see the home of his own being, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਾਧਾ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕੀਆ ਕਮਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jam dhar baadhaa Thaur na paavai apunaa keeaa kamaiee ||3||
verses.translation: Tied up at Death's door, he finds no place of rest; he receives the rewards of his own actions. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਅਖੀ ਵੇਖਾ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: nadhar kare taa akhee vekhaa kahanaa kathan na jaiee ||
verses.translation: When the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, then I see Him with my own eyes; He is indescribable, and cannot be described.

verses.original: ਕੰਨੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ka(n)nee sun sun sabadh salaahee a(n)mrit ridhai vasaiee ||
verses.translation: With my ears, I continually listen to the Word of the Shabad, and I praise Him; His Ambrosial Name abides within my heart.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: nirabhau nira(n)kaar niravair pooran jot samaiee ||
verses.translation: He is Fearless, Formless and absolutely without vengeance; I am absorbed in His Perfect Light.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਵਿਣੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਭਾਗੈ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak gur vin bharam na bhaagai sach naam vaddiaaiee ||4||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the Guru, doubt is not dispelled; through the True Name, glorious greatness is obtained. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਦੁਤੁਕੇ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa pehilaa dhutuke ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, First Mehla, Dho-Thukay:

verses.original: ਪੁੜੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਪੁੜੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਆਸਣੁ ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਚਉਬਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: puR dharatee puR paanee aasan chaar ku(n)T chaubaaraa ||
verses.translation: In the realm of land, and in the realm of water, Your seat is the chamber of the four directions.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਭਵਣ ਕੀ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਏਕਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਟਕਸਾਲਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sagal bhavan kee moorat ekaa mukh terai Takasaalaa ||1||
verses.translation: Yours is the one and only form of the entire universe; Your mouth is the mint to fashion all. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: mere saahibaa tere choj viddaanaa ||
verses.translation: O my Lord Master, Your play is so wonderful!

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ਆਪੇ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jal thal maheeal bharipur leenaa aape sarab samaanaa || rahaau ||
verses.translation: You are pervading and permeating the water, the land and the sky; You Yourself are contained in all. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਕਿਨੇਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeh jeh dhekhaa teh jot tumaaree teraa roop kinehaa ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, there I see Your Light, but what is Your form?

verses.original: ਇਕਤੁ ਰੂਪਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਪਰਛੰਨਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਜੇਹਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: eikat roop fireh parachha(n)naa koi na kis hee jehaa ||2||
verses.translation: You have one form, but it is unseen; there is none like any other. ||2||

verses.original: ਅੰਡਜ ਜੇਰਜ ਉਤਭੁਜ ਸੇਤਜ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਜੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)ddaj jeraj utabhuj setaj tere keete ja(n)taa ||
verses.translation: The beings born of eggs, born of the womb, born of the earth and born of sweat, all are created by You.

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਪੁਰਬੁ ਮੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਰਵੰਤਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ek purab mai teraa dhekhiaa too sabhanaa maeh rava(n)taa ||3||
verses.translation: I have seen one glory of Yours, that You are pervading and permeating in all. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਮੈ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: tere gun bahute mai ek na jaaniaa mai moorakh kichh dheejai ||
verses.translation: Your virtues are so many, and I do not know even one of them; I am such a fool - please, give me some of them!

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਡੁਬਦਾ ਪਥਰੁ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: pranavat naanak sun mere saahibaa ddubadhaa pathar leejai ||4||4||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, listen, O my Lord Master: I am sinking like a stone - please, save me! ||4||4||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਉ ਪਾਪੀ ਪਤਿਤੁ ਪਰਮ ਪਾਖੰਡੀ ਤੂ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: hau paapee patit param paakha(n)ddee too niramal nira(n)kaaree ||
verses.translation: I am a wicked sinner and a great hypocrite; You are the Immaculate and Formless Lord.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਚਾਖਿ ਪਰਮ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit chaakh param ras raate Thaakur saran tumaaree ||1||
verses.translation: Tasting the Ambrosial Nectar, I am imbued with supreme bliss; O Lord and Master, I seek Your Sanctuary. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਰਤਾ ਤੂ ਮੈ ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: karataa too mai maan nimaane ||
verses.translation: O Creator Lord, You are the honor of the dishonored.

verses.original: ਮਾਣੁ ਮਹਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: maan mahat naam dhan palai saachai sabadh samaane || rahaau ||
verses.translation: In my lap is the honor and glory of the wealth of the Name; I merge into the True Word of the Shabad. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਪੂਰਾ ਹਮ ਊਰੇ ਹੋਛੇ ਤੂ ਗਉਰਾ ਹਮ ਹਉਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: too pooraa ham uoore hochhe too gauraa ham haure ||
verses.translation: You are perfect, while I am worthless and imperfect. You are profound, while I am trivial.

verses.original: ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਨ ਰਾਤੇ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਪਰਭਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tujh hee man raate ahinis parabhaate har rasanaa jap man re ||2||
verses.translation: My mind is imbued with You, day and night and morning, O Lord; my tongue chants Your Name, and my mind meditates on You. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਸਾਚੇ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਰਾਚੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਸਾਚੇ ॥
verses.translit: tum saache ham tum hee raache sabadh bhedh fun saache ||
verses.translation: You are True, and I am absorbed into You; through the mystery of the Shabad, I shall ultimately become True as well.

verses.original: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਸੂਚੇ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੇ ਸੇ ਕਾਚੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ahinis naam rate se sooche mar janame se kaache ||3||
verses.translation: Those who are imbued with the Naam day and night are pure, while those who die to be reborn are impure. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਰੀਕੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: avar na dheesai kis saalaahee tiseh sareek na koiee ||
verses.translation: I do not see any other like the Lord; who else should I praise? No one is equal to Him.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਸੋਈ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: pranavat naanak dhaasan dhaasaa gurmat jaaniaa soiee ||4||5||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, I am the slave of His slaves; by Guru's Instruction, I know Him. ||4||5||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਗੰਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: alakh apaar aga(n)m agochar naa tis kaal na karamaa ||
verses.translation: He is unknowable, infinite, unapproachable and imperceptible. He is not subject to death or karma.

verses.original: ਜਾਤਿ ਅਜਾਤਿ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਸੰਭਉ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਭਰਮਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jaat ajaat ajonee sa(n)bhau naa tis bhaau na bharamaa ||1||
verses.translation: His caste is casteless; He is unborn, self-illumined, and free of doubt and desire. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਚਿਆਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: saache sachiaar viTahu kurabaan ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the Truest of the True.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪ ਵਰਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naa tis roop varan nahee rekhiaa saachai sabadh neesaan || rahaau ||
verses.translation: He has no form, no color and no features; through the True Word of the Shabad, He reveals Himself. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਮੁ ਨ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: naa tis maat pitaa sut ba(n)dhap naa tis kaam na naaree ||
verses.translation: He has no mother, father, sons or relatives; He is free of sexual desire; He has no wife.

verses.original: ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਅਪਰ ਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸਗਲੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: akul nira(n)jan apar para(n)par sagalee jot tumaaree ||2||
verses.translation: He has no ancestry; He is immaculate. He is infinite and endless; O Lord, Your Light is pervading all. ||2||

verses.original: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਲੁਕਾਇਆ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT a(n)tar braham lukaiaa ghaT ghaT jot sabaiee ||
verses.translation: Deep within each and every heart, God is hidden; His Light is in each and every heart.

verses.original: ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bajar kapaaT mukate gurmatee nirabhai taaRee laiee ||3||
verses.translation: The heavy doors are opened by Guru's Instructions; one becomes fearless, in the trance of deep meditation. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇ ਕਾਲੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਜੰਤਾ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ja(n)t upai kaal sir ja(n)taa vasagat jugat sabaiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord created all beings, and placed death over the heads of all; all the world is under His Power.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਛੂਟਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: satigur sev padhaarath paaveh chhooTeh sabadh kamaiee ||4||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, the treasure is obtained; living the Word of the Shabad, one is emancipated. ||4||

verses.original: ਸੂਚੈ ਭਾਡੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੂਚਾਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: soochai bhaaddai saach samaavai virale soochaachaaree ||
verses.translation: In the pure vessel, the True Name is contained; how few are those who practice true conduct.

verses.original: ਤੰਤੈ ਕਉ ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੫॥੬॥
verses.translit: ta(n)tai kau param ta(n)t milaiaa naanak saran tumaaree ||5||6||
verses.translation: The individual soul is united with the Supreme Soul; Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary, Lord. ||5||6||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਮੀਨਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਾਣੀਐ ਤਿਉ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
verses.translit: jiau meenaa bin paaneeaai tiau saakat marai piaas ||
verses.translation: Like a fish without water is the faithless cynic, who dies of thirst.

verses.original: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਰੀਐ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਜੋ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਵੈ ਸਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tiau har bin mareeaai re manaa jo birathaa jaavai saas ||1||
verses.translation: So shall you die, O mind, without the Lord, as your breath goes in vain. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਜਸੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: man re raam naam jas lei ||
verses.translation: O mind, chant the Lord's Name, and praise Him.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਇਹੁ ਰਸੁ ਕਿਉ ਲਹਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur ih ras kiau lahau gur melai har dhei || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, how will you obtain this juice? The Guru shall unite you with the Lord. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲੁ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa mil sa(n)gatee gurmukh teerath hoi ||
verses.translation: For the Gurmukh, meeting with the Society of the Saints is like making a pilgrimage to a sacred shrine.

verses.original: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਮਜਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aThasaTh teerath majanaa gur dharas paraapat hoi ||2||
verses.translation: The benefit of bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage is obtained by the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਤਪੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: jiau jogee jat baaharaa tap naahee sat sa(n)tokh ||
verses.translation: Like the Yogi without abstinence, and like penance without truth and contentment,

verses.original: ਤਿਉ ਨਾਮੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਦੋਖੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tiau naamai bin dhehuree jam maarai a(n)tar dhokh ||3||
verses.translation: so is the body without the Lord's Name; death will slay it, because of the sin within. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: saakat prem na paieeaai har paieeaai satigur bhai ||
verses.translation: The faithless cynic does not obtain the Lord's Love; the Lord's Love is obtained only through the True Guru.

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੭॥
verses.translit: sukh dhukh dhaataa gur milai kahu naanak sifat samai ||4||7||
verses.translation: One who meets with the Guru, the Giver of pleasure and pain, says Nanak, is absorbed in the Lord's Praise. ||4||7||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਤੂ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਨਿ ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਹਮ ਥਾਰੇ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: too prabh dhaataa dhaan mat pooraa ham thaare bhekhaaree jeeau ||
verses.translation: You, God, are the Giver of gifts, the Lord of perfect understanding; I am a mere beggar at Your Door.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਗਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mai kiaa maagau kichh thir na rahaiee har dheejai naam piaaree jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: What should I beg for? Nothing remains permanent; O Lord, please, bless me with Your Beloved Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT rav rahiaa banavaaree ||
verses.translation: In each and every heart, the Lord, the Lord of the forest, is permeating and pervading.

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਗੁਪਤੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jal thal maheeal gupato varatai gur sabadhee dhekh nihaaree jeeau || rahaau ||
verses.translation: In the water, on the land, and in the sky, He is pervading but hidden; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is revealed. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਰਤ ਪਇਆਲ ਅਕਾਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: marat piaal akaas dhikhaio gur satigur kirapaa dhaaree jeeau ||
verses.translation: In this world, in the nether regions of the underworld, and in the Akaashic Ethers, the Guru, the True Guru, has shown me the Lord; He has showered me with His Mercy.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਨੀ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: so braham ajonee hai bhee honee ghaT bheetar dhekh muraaree jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: He is the unborn Lord God; He is, and shall ever be. Deep within your heart, behold Him, the Destroyer of ego. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕਉ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਪੁੜੋ ਇਨਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran kau ih jag bapuRo in dhoojai bhagat visaaree jeeau ||
verses.translation: This wretched world is caught in birth and death; in the love of duality, it has forgotten devotional worship of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਕਤ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: satigur milai ta gurmat paieeaai saakat baajee haaree jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, the Guru's Teachings are obtained; the faithless cynic loses the game of life. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜਿ ਨਿਰਾਰੇ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਗਰਭ ਮਝਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur ba(n)dhan toR niraare bahuR na garabh majhaaree jeeau ||
verses.translation: Breaking my bonds, the True Guru has set me free, and I shall not be cast into the womb of reincarnation again.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੮॥
verses.translit: naanak giaan ratan paragaasiaa har man vasiaa nira(n)kaaree jeeau ||4||8||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the jewel of spiritual wisdom shines forth, and the Lord, the Formless Lord, dwells within my mind. ||4||8||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਜਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਤੁਮ ਜਗਿ ਆਏ ਸੋ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: jis jal nidh kaaran tum jag aae so a(n)mrit gur paahee jeeau ||
verses.translation: The treasure of the Name, for which you have come into the world - that Ambrosial Nectar is with the Guru.

verses.original: ਛੋਡਹੁ ਵੇਸੁ ਭੇਖ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਇਹੁ ਫਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: chhoddahu ves bhekh chaturaiee dhubidhaa ih fal naahee jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: Renounce costumes, disguises and clever tricks; this fruit is not obtained by duplicity. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਥਿਰੁ ਰਹੁ ਮਤੁ ਕਤ ਜਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: man re thir rahu mat kat jaahee jeeau ||
verses.translation: O my mind, remain steady, and do not wander away.

verses.original: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਢੂਢਤ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਘਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਘਟ ਮਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: baahar ddooddat bahut dhukh paaveh ghar a(n)mrit ghaT maahee jeeau || rahaau ||
verses.translation: By searching around on the outside, you shall only suffer great pain; the Ambrosial Nectar is found within the home of your own being. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਵਗੁਣ ਛੋਡਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਕਉ ਧਾਵਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਪਛੁਤਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: avagun chhodd gunaa kau dhaavahu kar avagun pachhutaahee jeeau ||
verses.translation: Renounce corruption, and seek virtue; committing sins, you shall only come to regret and repent.

verses.original: ਸਰ ਅਪਸਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਕੀਚ ਬੁਡਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sar apasar kee saar na jaaneh fir fir keech buddaahee jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: You do not know the difference between good and evil; again and again, you sink into the mud. ||2||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਲੋਭ ਬਹੁ ਝੂਠੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਕਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar mail lobh bahu jhooThe baahar naavahu kaahee jeeau ||
verses.translation: Within you is the great filth of greed and falsehood; why do you bother to wash your body on the outside?

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਸਦ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਤਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: niramal naam japahu sadh gurmukh a(n)tar kee gat taahee jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: Chant the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord always, under Guru's Instruction; only then will your innermost being be emancipated. ||3||
