verses.original: ਪਰਹਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: parahar lobh ni(n)dhaa kooR tiaagahu sach gur bachanee fal paahee jeeau ||
verses.translation: Let greed and slander be far away from you, and renounce falsehood; through the True Word of the Guru's Shabad, you shall obtain the true fruit.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੯॥
verses.translit: jiau bhaavai tiau raakhahu har jeeau jan naanak sabadh salaahee jeeau ||4||9||
verses.translation: As it pleases You, You preserve me, Dear Lord; servant Nanak sings the Praises of Your Shabad. ||4||9||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਪੰਚਪਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa pehilaa pa(n)chapadhe ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, First Mehla, Panch-Padhay:

verses.original: ਅਪਨਾ ਘਰੁ ਮੂਸਤ ਰਾਖਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਹਿ ਕੀ ਪਰ ਘਰੁ ਜੋਹਨ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: apanaa ghar moosat raakh na saakeh kee par ghar johan laagaa ||
verses.translation: You cannot save your own home from being plundered; why do you spy on the houses of others?

verses.original: ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਜੇ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਹਿ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ghar dhar raakheh je ras chaakheh jo gurmukh sevak laagaa ||1||
verses.translation: That Gurmukh who joins himself to the Guru's service, saves his own home, and tastes the Lord's Nectar. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਮਝੁ ਕਵਨ ਮਤਿ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: man re samajh kavan mat laagaa ||
verses.translation: O mind, you must realize what your intellect is focused on.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਲੋਭਾਨੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਹਿ ਅਭਾਗਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naam visaar an ras lobhaane fir pachhutaeh abhaagaa || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one is involved with other tastes; the unfortunate wretch shall come to regret it in the end. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਵਤ ਕਉ ਹਰਖ ਜਾਤ ਕਉ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਇਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਲੇ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: aavat kau harakh jaat kau roveh ih dhukh sukh naale laagaa ||
verses.translation: When things come, he is pleased, but when they go, he weeps and wails; this pain and pleasure remains attached to him.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਭੋਗਿ ਭੋਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋ ਅਨਰਾਗਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aape dhukh sukh bhog bhogaavai gurmukh so anaraagaa ||2||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself causes him to enjoy pleasure and endure pain; the Gurmukh, however, remains unaffected. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਊਪਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੀਆ ਸੋ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: har ras uoopar avar kiaa kaheeaai jin peeaa so tirapataagaa ||
verses.translation: What else can be said to be above the subtle essence of the Lord? One who drinks it in is satisfied and satiated.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿਤ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਰਸੁ ਖੋਇਆ ਜਾ ਸਾਕਤ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: maiaa mohit jin ih ras khoiaa jaa saakat dhuramat laagaa ||3||
verses.translation: One who is lured by Maya loses this juice; that faithless cynic is tied to his evil-mindedness. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਵਨਪਤਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਦੇਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਦੇਉ ਸਮਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: man kaa jeeau pavanapat dhehee dhehee meh dheau samaagaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the life of the mind, the Master of the breath of life; the Divine Lord is contained in the body.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਗਾਈ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: je too dheh ta har ras gaiee man tirapatai har liv laagaa ||4||
verses.translation: If You so bless us, Lord, then we sing Your Praises; the mind is satisfied and fulfilled, lovingly attached to the Lord. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਜਮ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat meh har ras paieeaai gur miliaai jam bhau bhaagaa ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the subtle essence of the Lord is obtained; meeting the Guru, the fear of death departs.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੫॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: naanak raam naam jap gurmukh har paae masatak bhaagaa ||5||10||
verses.translation: O Nanak, chant the Name of the Lord, as Gurmukh; you shall obtain the Lord, and realize your pre-ordained destiny. ||5||10||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਧੁਰਾਹੂ ਬਿਨੁ ਲੇਖੈ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: sarab jeeaa sir lekh dhuraahoo bin lekhai nahee koiee jeeau ||
verses.translation: Destiny, pre-ordained by the Lord, looms over the heads of all beings; no one is without this pre-ordained destiny.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਅਲੇਖੁ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਚਲਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aap alekh kudharat kar dhekhai hukam chalaae soiee jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: Only He Himself is beyond destiny; creating the creation by His creative power, He beholds it, and causes His Command to be followed. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਜਪਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: man re raam japahu sukh hoiee ||
verses.translation: O mind, chant the Name of the Lord, and be at peace.

verses.original: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਸੋਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ahinis gur ke charan sarevahu har dhaataa bhugataa soiee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Day and night, serve at the Guru's feet; the Lord is the Giver, and the Enjoyer. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੋ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo a(n)tar so baahar dhekhahu avar na dhoojaa koiee jeeau ||
verses.translation: He is within - see Him outside as well; there is no one, other than Him.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮੋਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gurmukh ek dhirasaT kar dhekhahu ghaT ghaT jot samoiee jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, look upon all with the single eye of equality; in each and every heart, the Divine Light is contained. ||2||

verses.original: ਚਲਤੌ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਖਹੁ ਘਰਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: chalatau Thaak rakhahu ghar apanai gur miliaai ieh mat hoiee jeeau ||
verses.translation: Restrain your fickle mind, and keep it steady within its own home; meeting the Guru, this understanding is obtained.

verses.original: ਦੇਖਿ ਅਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੁ ਰਹਉ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhekh adhirasaT rahau bisamaadhee dhukh bisarai sukh hoiee jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: Seeing the unseen Lord, you shall be amazed and delighted; forgetting your pain, you shall be at peace. ||3||

verses.original: ਪੀਵਹੁ ਅਪਿਉ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹੋਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: peevahu apiau param sukh paieeaai nij ghar vaasaa hoiee jeeau ||
verses.translation: Drinking in the ambrosial nectar, you shall attain the highest bliss, and dwell within the home of your own self.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭਵ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗਾਈਐ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: janam maran bhav bha(n)jan gaieeaai punarap janam na hoiee jeeau ||4||
verses.translation: So sing the Praises of the Lord, the Destroyer of the fear of birth and death, and you shall not be reincarnated again. ||4||

verses.original: ਤਤੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਸੋਹੰ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: tat nira(n)jan jot sabaiee soha(n) bhedh na koiee jeeau ||
verses.translation: The essence, the immaculate Lord, the Light of all - I am He and He is me - there is no difference between us.

verses.original: ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੋਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: apara(n)par paarabraham paramesar naanak gur miliaa soiee jeeau ||5||11||
verses.translation: The Infinite Transcendent Lord, the Supreme Lord God - Nanak has met with Him, the Guru. ||5||11||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੩
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa pehilaa ghar teejaa
verses.translation: Sorat'h, First Mehla, Third House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਾ ਤਦ ਹੀ ਗਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaa tis bhaavaa tadh hee gaavaa ||
verses.translation: When I am pleasing to Him, then I sing His Praises.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਗਾਵੇ ਕਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: taa gaave kaa fal paavaa ||
verses.translation: Singing His Praises, I receive the fruits of my rewards.

verses.original: ਗਾਵੇ ਕਾ ਫਲੁ ਹੋਈ ॥ ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gaave kaa fal hoiee || jaa aape dhevai soiee ||1||
verses.translation: The rewards of singing His Praises are obtained when He Himself gives them. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: man mere gur bachanee nidh paiee ||
verses.translation: O my mind, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the treasure is obtained;

verses.original: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਸਚ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: taa te sach meh rahiaa samaiee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: this is why I remain immersed in the True Name. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur saakhee a(n)tar jaagee ||
verses.translation: When I awoke within myself to the Guru's Teachings,

verses.original: ਤਾ ਚੰਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: taa cha(n)chal mat tiaagee ||
verses.translation: then I renounced my fickle intellect.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ ਕਾ ਉਜੀਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur saakhee kaa ujeeaaraa ||
verses.translation: When the Light of the Guru's Teachings dawned,

verses.original: ਤਾ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਅੰਧੵਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: taa miTiaa sagal a(n)dhayeaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: and then all darkness was dispelled. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur charanee man laagaa ||
verses.translation: When the mind is attached to the Guru's Feet,

verses.original: ਤਾ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: taa jam kaa maarag bhaagaa ||
verses.translation: then the Path of Death recedes.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhai vich nirabhau paiaa ||
verses.translation: Through the Fear of God, one attains the Fearless Lord;

verses.original: ਤਾ ਸਹਜੈ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: taa sahajai kai ghar aaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: then, one enters the home of celestial bliss. ||3||

verses.original: ਭਣਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: bhanat naanak boojhai ko beechaaree ||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, how rare are those who reflect and understand,

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: eis jag meh karanee saaree ||
verses.translation: the most sublime action in this world.

verses.original: ਕਰਣੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: karanee keerat hoiee ||
verses.translation: The noblest deed is to sing the Lord's Praises,

verses.translit: jaa aape miliaa soiee ||4||1||12||
verses.translation: and so meet the Lord Himself. ||4||1||12||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa teejaa ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Third Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਜਿਨ ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sevak sev kareh sabh teree jin sabadhai saadh aaiaa ||
verses.translation: All of Your servants, who relish the Word of Your Shabad, serve You.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur kirapaa te niramal hoaa jin vichahu aap gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, they become pure, eradicating self-conceit from within.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anadhin gun gaaveh nit saache gur kai sabadh suhaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: Night and day, they continually sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord; they are adorned with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: mere Thaakur ham baarik saran tumaaree ||
verses.translation: O my Lord and Master, I am Your child; I seek Your Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਤੂ ਕੇਵਲੁ ਆਪਿ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: eko sachaa sach too keval aap muraaree || rahaau ||
verses.translation: You are the One and Only Lord, the Truest of the True; You Yourself are the Destroyer of ego. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਾਗਤ ਰਹੇ ਤਿਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਬਦੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jaagat rahe tinee prabh paiaa sabadhe haumai maaree ||
verses.translation: Those who remain wakeful obtain God; through the Word of the Shabad, they conquer their ego.

verses.original: ਗਿਰਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਗਿਆਨ ਤਤ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: girahee meh sadhaa har jan udhaasee giaan tat beechaaree ||
verses.translation: Immersed in family life, the Lord's humble servant ever remains detached; he reflects upon the essence of spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: satigur sev sadhaa sukh paiaa har raakhiaa ur dhaaree ||2||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, he finds eternal peace, and he keeps the Lord enshrined in his heart. ||2||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਧਾਵਦਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: eih manooaa dheh dhis dhaavadhaa dhoojai bhai khuaaiaa ||
verses.translation: This mind wanders in the ten directions; it is consumed by the love of duality.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh mugadh har naam na chetai birathaa janam gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: The foolish self-willed manmukh does not remember the Lord's Name; he wastes away his life in vain.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਤਾ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਏ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: satigur bheTe taa naau paae haumai moh chukaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: But when he meets the True Guru, then he obtains the Name; he sheds egotism and emotional attachment. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: har jan saache saach kamaaveh gur kai sabadh veechaaree ||
verses.translation: The Lord's humble servants are True - they practice Truth, and reflect upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: aape mel le prabh saachai saach rakhiaa ur dhaaree ||
verses.translation: The True Lord God unites them with Himself, and they keep the True Lord enshrined in their hearts.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਏਹਾ ਰਾਸਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak naavahu gat mat paiee ehaa raas hamaaree ||4||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through the Name, I have obtained salvation and understanding; this alone is my wealth. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ ਨਾਉ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat khajaanaa bhagatan kau dheeaa naau har dhan sach soi ||
verses.translation: The True Lord has blessed His devotees with the treasure of devotional worship, and the wealth of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਅਖੁਟੁ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਕਦੇ ਨਿਖੁਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: akhuT naam dhan kadhe nikhuTai naahee kinai na keemat hoi ||
verses.translation: The wealth of the Naam, shall never be exhausted; no one can estimate its worth.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਧਨਿ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਹੋਏ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naam dhan mukh ujale hoe har paiaa sach soi ||1||
verses.translation: With the wealth of the Naam, their faces are radiant, and they attain the True Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man mere gur sabadhee har paiaa jai ||
verses.translation: O my mind, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord is found.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਜਗੁ ਭੁਲਦਾ ਫਿਰਦਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bin sabadhai jag bhuladhaa firadhaa dharageh milai sajai || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the Shabad, the world wanders around, and receives its punishment in the Court of the Lord. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਵਸਹਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: eis dhehee a(n)dhar pa(n)ch chor vaseh kaam karodh lobh moh aha(n)kaaraa ||
verses.translation: Within this body dwell the five thieves: sexual desire, anger, greed, emotional attachment and egotism.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਲੂਟਹਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸੁਣੈ ਪੂਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit looTeh manmukh nahee boojheh koi na sunai pookaaraa ||
verses.translation: They plunder the Nectar, but the self-willed manmukh does not realize it; no one hears his complaint.

verses.original: ਅੰਧਾ ਜਗਤੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhaa jagat a(n)dh varataaraa baajh guroo gubaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: The world is blind, and its dealings are blind as well; without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵਿਗੁਤੇ ਕਿਹੁ ਚਲੈ ਨ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: haumai meraa kar kar vigute kih chalai na chaladhiaa naal ||
verses.translation: Indulging in egotism and possessiveness, they are ruined; when they depart, nothing goes along with them.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hovai su naam dhiaavai sadhaa har naam samaal ||
verses.translation: But one who becomes Gurmukh meditates on the Naam, and ever contemplates the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sachee baanee har gun gaavai nadharee nadhar nihaal ||3||
verses.translation: Through the True Word of Gurbani, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord; blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace, he is enraptured. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਬਾਦਿਸਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: satigur giaan sadhaa ghaT chaanan amar sir baadhisaahaa ||
verses.translation: The spiritual wisdom of the True Guru is a steady light within the heart. The Lord's decree is over the heads of even kings.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin bhagat kareh dhin raatee raam naam sach laahaa ||
verses.translation: Night and day, the Lord's devotees worship Him; night and day, they gather in the true profit of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਹਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak raam naam nisataaraa sabadh rate har paahaa ||4||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through the Lord's Name, one is emancipated; attuned to the Shabad, he finds the Lord. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhaasan dhaas hovai taa har paae vichahu aap gavaiee ||
verses.translation: If one becomes the slave of the Lord's slaves, then he finds the Lord, and eradicates ego from within.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bhagataa kaa kaaraj har ana(n)dh hai anadhin har gun gaiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord of bliss is his object of devotion; night and day, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਇਕ ਰੰਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sabadh rate sadhaa ik ra(n)gee har siau rahe samaiee ||1||
verses.translation: Attuned to the Word of the Shabad, the Lord's devotees remain ever as one, absorbed in the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau saachee nadhar tumaaree ||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord, Your Glance of Grace is True.

verses.original: ਆਪਣਿਆ ਦਾਸਾ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪੈਜ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aapaniaa dhaasaa no kirapaa kar piaare raakhahu paij hamaaree || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Show mercy to Your slave, O Beloved Lord, and preserve my honor. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh salaahee sadhaa hau jeevaa gurmatee bhau bhaagaa ||
verses.translation: Continually praising the Word of the Shabad, I live; under Guru's Instruction, my fear has been dispelled.

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਅਤਿ ਸੁਆਲਿਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: meraa prabh saachaa at suaaliau gur seviaa chit laagaa ||
verses.translation: My True Lord God is so beautiful! Serving the Guru, my consciousness is focused on Him.

verses.original: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੀ ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saachaa sabadh sachee sach baanee so jan anadhin jaagaa ||2||
verses.translation: One who chants the True Word of the Shabad, and the Truest of the True, the Word of His Bani, remains wakeful, day and night. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa ga(n)bheer sadhaa sukhadhaataa tis kaa a(n)t na paiaa ||
verses.translation: He is so very deep and profound, the Giver of eternal peace; no one can find His limit.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕੀਨੀ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: poore gur kee sevaa keenee achi(n)t har ma(n)n vasaiaa ||
verses.translation: Serving the Perfect Guru, one becomes carefree, enshrining the Lord within the mind.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: man tan niramal sadhaa sukh a(n)tar vichahu bharam chukaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: The mind and body become immaculately pure, and a lasting peace fills the heart; doubt is eradicated from within. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸਦਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਵਿਖੜਾ ਕੋ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa maarag sadhaa pa(n)th vikhaRaa ko paae gur veechaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Way of the Lord is always such a difficult path; only a few find it, contemplating the Guru.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਮਾਤਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜੇ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: har kai ra(n)g raataa sabadhe maataa haumai taje vikaaraa ||
verses.translation: Imbued with the Lord's Love, and intoxicated with the Shabad, he renounces ego and corruption.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤਾ ਇਕ ਰੰਗੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak naam rataa ik ra(n)gee sabadh savaaranahaaraa ||4||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, and the Love of the One Lord, he is embellished with the Word of the Shabad. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਨੋ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹੈ ਸਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau tudh no sadhaa saalaahee piaare jichar ghaT a(n)tar hai saasaa ||
verses.translation: Dear Beloved Lord, I praise You continually, as long as there is the breath within my body.

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਪਲੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਤੂ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਾਣਉ ਬਰਸ ਪਚਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: eik pal khin visareh too suaamee jaanau baras pachaasaa ||
verses.translation: If I were to forget You, for a moment, even for an instant, O Lord Master, it would be like fifty years for me.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਸਦਾ ਸੇ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ham mooR mugadh sadhaa se bhaiee gur kai sabadh pragaasaa ||1||
verses.translation: I was always such a fool and an idiot, O Siblings of Destiny, but now, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, my mind is enlightened. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੁਮ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਹੁ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau tum aape dheh bujhaiee ||
verses.translation: Dear Lord, You Yourself bestow understanding.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau tudh viTahu vaariaa sadh hee tere naam viTahu bal jaiee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Dear Lord, I am forever a sacrifice to You; I am dedicated and devoted to Your Name. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਸਬਦਿ ਮੁਏ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲੇ ਭਾਈ ਸਬਦੇ ਹੀ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ham sabadh mue sabadh maar jeevaale bhaiee sabadhe hee mukat paiee ||
verses.translation: I have died in the Word of the Shabad, and through the Shabad, I am dead while yet alive, O Siblings of Destiny; through the Shabad, I have been liberated.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੇ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: sabadhe man tan niramal hoaa har vasiaa man aaiee ||
verses.translation: Through the Shabad, my mind and body have been purified, and the Lord has come to dwell within my mind.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਤਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sabadh gur dhaataa jit man raataa har siau rahiaa samaiee ||2||
verses.translation: The Guru is the Giver of the Shabad; my mind is imbued with it, and I remain absorbed in the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੇ ਅੰਨੇ ਬੋਲੇ ਸੇ ਕਿਤੁ ਆਏ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh na jaaneh se a(n)ne bole se kit aae sa(n)saaraa ||
verses.translation: Those who do not know the Shabad are blind and deaf; why did they even bother to come into the world?

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: har ras na paiaa birathaa janam gavaiaa ja(n)meh vaaro vaaraa ||
verses.translation: They do not obtain the subtle essence of the Lord's elixir; they waste away their lives, and are reincarnated over and over again.

verses.original: ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕੇ ਕੀੜੇ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bisaTaa ke keeRe bisaTaa maeh samaane manmukh mugadh gubaaraa ||3||
verses.translation: The blind, idiotic, self-willed manmukhs are like maggots in manure, and in manure they rot away. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਲਾਏ ਭਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: aape kar vekhai maarag laae bhaiee tis bin avar na koiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself creates us, watches over us, and places us on the Path, O Siblings of Destiny; there is no one other than Him.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਭਾਈ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jo dhur likhiaa su koi na meTai bhaiee karataa kare su hoiee ||
verses.translation: No one can erase that which is pre-ordained, O Siblings of Destiny; whatever the Creator wills, comes to pass.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭਾਈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak naam vasiaa man a(n)tar bhaiee avar na dhoojaa koiee ||4||4||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within the mind; O Siblings of Destiny, there is no other at all. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh bhagat kareh prabh bhaaveh anadhin naam vakhaane ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs practice devotional worship, and become pleasing to God; night and day, they chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਕਰਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਜੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: bhagataa kee saar kareh aap raakheh jo terai man bhaane ||
verses.translation: You Yourself protect and take care of Your devotees, who are pleasing to Your Mind.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: too gunadhaataa sabadh pachhaataa gun keh gunee samaane ||1||
verses.translation: You are the Giver of virtue, realized through the Word of Your Shabad. Uttering Your Glories, we merge with You, O Glorious Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: man mere har jeeau sadhaa samaal ||
verses.translation: O my mind, remember always the Dear Lord.

verses.original: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਬੇਲੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)t kaal teraa belee hovai sadhaa nibahai terai naal || rahaau ||
verses.translation: At the very last moment, He alone shall be your best friend; He shall always stand by you. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਦੁਸਟ ਚਉਕੜੀ ਸਦਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਨਾ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhusaT chaukaRee sadhaa kooR kamaaveh naa boojheh veechaare ||
verses.translation: The gathering of the wicked enemies shall always practice falsehood; they do not contemplate understanding.

verses.original: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਦੁਸਟੀ ਤੇ ਕਿਨਿ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਣਾਖਸ ਨਖਹਿ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: ni(n)dhaa dhusaTee te kin fal paiaa haranaakhas nakheh bidhaare ||
verses.translation: Who can obtain fruit from the slander of evil enemies? Remember that Harnaakhash was torn apart by the Lord's claws.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਜਨੁ ਸਦ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਲਏ ਉਬਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: prahilaadh jan sadh har gun gaavai har jeeau le ubaare ||2||
verses.translation: Prahlaad, the Lord's humble servant, constantly sang the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and the Dear Lord saved him. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਬਹੁ ਭਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮਤਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aapas kau bahu bhalaa kar jaaneh manmukh mat na kaiee ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs see themselves as being very virtuous; they have absolutely no understanding at all.

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਜਾਸਨਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: saadhoo jan kee ni(n)dhaa viaape jaasan janam gavaiee ||
verses.translation: They indulge in slander of the humble spiritual people; they waste their lives away, and then they have to depart.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਦੇ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: raam naam kadhe cheteh naahee a(n)t ge pachhutaiee ||3||
verses.translation: They never think of the Lord's Name, and in the end, they depart, regretting and repenting. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਆਪਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: safal janam bhagataa kaa keetaa gur sevaa aap laae ||
verses.translation: The Lord makes the lives of His devotees fruitful; He Himself links them to the Guru's service.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੇ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sabadhe raate sahaje maate anadhin har gun gaae ||
verses.translation: Imbued with the Word of the Shabad, and intoxicated with celestial bliss, night and day, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਹਉ ਲਾਗਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas kahai bena(n)tee hau laagaa tin kai paae ||4||5||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak utters this prayer: O Lord, please, let me fall at their feet. ||4||5||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਿਖੁ ਸਖਾ ਬੰਧਪੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਜਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਭਾਣੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: so sikh sakhaa ba(n)dhap hai bhaiee j gur ke bhaane vich aavai ||
verses.translation: He alone is a Sikh, a friend, a relative and a sibling, who walks in the Way of the Guru's Will.

verses.original: ਆਪਣੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਭਾਈ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: aapanai bhaanai jo chalai bhaiee vichhuR choTaa khaavai ||
verses.translation: One who walks according to his own will, O Siblings of Destiny, suffers separation from the Lord, and shall be punished.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਭਾਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੋਤਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bin satigur sukh kadhe na paavai bhaiee fir fir pachhotaavai ||1||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, peace is never obtained, O Siblings of Destiny; again and again, he regrets and repents. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har ke dhaas suhele bhaiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord's slaves are happy, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: janam janam ke kilabikh dhukh kaaTe aape mel milaiee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: The sins and sorrows of countless lifetimes are eradicated; the Lord Himself unites them in His Union. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਸਭੁ ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਭਾਈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾ ਸੈਂਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: eih kuTa(n)b sabh jeea ke ba(n)dhan bhaiee bharam bhulaa sai(n)saaraa ||
verses.translation: All of these relatives are like chains upon the soul, O Siblings of Destiny; the world is deluded by doubt.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬੰਧਨ ਟੂਟਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur ba(n)dhan TooTeh naahee gurmukh mokh dhuaaraa ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, the chains cannot be broken; the Gurmukhs find the door of salvation.

verses.original: ਕਰਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: karam kareh gur sabadh na pachhaaneh mar janameh vaaro vaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: One who performs rituals without realizing the Word of the Guru's Shabad, shall die and be reborn, again and again. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਮੇਰਾ ਜਗੁ ਪਲਚਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: hau meraa jag palach rahiaa bhaiee koi na kis hee keraa ||
verses.translation: The world is entangled in egotism and possessiveness, O Siblings of Destiny, but no one belongs to anyone else.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh mahal pain gun gaavan nij ghar hoi baseraa ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs attain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, singing the Glories of the Lord; they dwell in the home of their own inner being.

verses.original: ਐਥੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੁ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aaithai boojhai su aap pachhaanai har prabh hai tis keraa ||3||
verses.translation: One who understands here, realizes himself; the Lord God belongs to him. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਵਿਣੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਕਿਆ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: satiguroo sadhaa dhiaal hai bhaiee vin bhaagaa kiaa paieeaai ||
verses.translation: The True Guru is forever merciful, O Siblings of Destiny; without good destiny, what can anyone obtain?

verses.original: ਏਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਜੇਹਾ ਭਾਉ ਤੇਹਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: ek nadhar kar vekhai sabh uoopar jehaa bhaau tehaa fal paieeaai ||
verses.translation: He looks alike upon all with His Glance of Grace, but people receive the fruits of their rewards according to their love for the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak naam vasai man a(n)tar vichahu aap gavaieeaai ||4||6||
verses.translation: O Nanak, when the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to dwell within the mind, then self-conceit is eradicated from within. ||4||6||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਚੌਤੁਕੇ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa teejaa chauatuke ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Third Mehla, Chau-Thukay:

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਚੀ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: sachee bhagat satigur te hovai sachee hiradhai baanee ||
verses.translation: True devotional worship is obtained only through the True Guru, when the True Word of His Bani is in the heart.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: satigur seve sadhaa sukh paae haumai sabadh samaanee ||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, eternal peace is obtained; egotism is obliterated through the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਹੋਰ ਭੂਲੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਇਆਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur saache bhagat na hovee hor bhoolee firai iaanee ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, there is no true devotion; otherwise, people wander around, deluded by ignorance.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਵਿਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: manmukh fireh sadhaa dhukh paaveh ddoob mue vin paanee ||1||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs wander around, suffering in constant pain; they drown and die, even without water. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਹੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bhaiee re sadhaa rahahu saranaiee ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, remain forever in the Lord's Sanctuary, under His Protection.

verses.original: ਆਪਣੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aapanee nadhar kare pat raakhai har naamo dhe vaddiaaiee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Bestowing His Glance of Grace, He preserves our honor, and blesses us with the glory of the Lord's Name. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: poore gur te aap pachhaataa sabadh sachai veechaaraa ||
verses.translation: Through the Perfect Guru, one comes to understand himself, contemplating the True Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਸਦ ਵਸਿਆ ਤਜਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: hiradhai jagajeevan sadh vasiaa taj kaam karodh aha(n)kaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Lord, the Life of the world, ever abides in his heart, and he renounces sexual desire, anger and egotism.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa hajoor raviaa sabh Thaiee hiradhai naam apaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Lord is ever-present, permeating and pervading all places; the Name of the Infinite Lord is enshrined within the heart.

verses.original: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀ ਨਾਉ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jug jug baanee sabadh pachhaanee naau meeThaa maneh piaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: Throughout the ages, through the Word of His Bani, His Shabad is realized, and the Name becomes so sweet and beloved to the mind. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਗਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sev jin naam pachhaataa safal janam jag aaiaa ||
verses.translation: Serving the Guru, one realizes the Naam, the Name of the Lord; fruitful is his life, and his coming into the world.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਣੀ ਅਘਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har ras chaakh sadhaa man tirapatiaa gun gaavai gunee aghaiaa ||
verses.translation: Tasting the sublime elixir of the Lord, his mind is satisfied and satiated forever; singing the Glories of the Glorious Lord, he is fulfilled and satisfied.

verses.original: ਕਮਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kamal pragaas sadhaa ra(n)g raataa anahadh sabadh vajaiaa ||
verses.translation: The lotus of his heart blossoms forth, he is ever imbued with the Lord's Love, and the unstruck melody of the Shabad resounds within him.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tan man niramal niramal baanee sache sach samaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: His body and mind become immaculately pure; his speech becomes immaculate as well, and he merges in the Truest of the True. ||3||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam kee gat koi na boojhai gurmat ridhai samaiee ||
verses.translation: No one knows the state of the Lord's Name; through the Guru's Teachings, it comes to abide in the heart.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਮਗੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hovai su mag pachhaanai har ras rasan rasaiee ||
verses.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh, understands the Path; his tongue savors the sublime essence of the Lord's Nectar.

verses.original: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jap tap sa(n)jam sabh gur te hovai hiradhai naam vasaiee ||
verses.translation: Meditation, austere self-discipline and self-restraint are all obtained from the Guru; the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to abide within the heart.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੭॥
verses.translit: naanak naam samaaleh se jan sohan dhar saachai pat paiee ||4||7||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those humble beings who praise the Naam are beautiful; they are honored in the Court of the True Lord. ||4||7||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਃ ੩ ਦੁਤੁਕੇ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa teejaa dhutuke ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Third Mehla, Dho-Thukay:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਉਲਟੀ ਭਈ ਭਾਈ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਬੂਝ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur miliaai ulaTee bhiee bhaiee jeevat marai taa boojh pai ||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, one turns away from the world, O Siblings of Destiny; when he remains dead while yet alive, he obtains true understanding.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੋ ਸਿਖੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: so guroo so sikh hai bhaiee jis jotee jot milai ||1||
verses.translation: He alone is the Guru, and he alone is a Sikh, O Siblings of Destiny, whose light merges in the Light. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man re har har setee liv lai ||
verses.translation: O my mind, be lovingly attuned to the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਥਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man har jap meeThaa laagai bhaiee gurmukh paae har thai || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord, it seems so sweet to the mind, O Siblings of Destiny; the Gurmukhs obtain a place in the Court of the Lord. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਭਾਈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur preet na uoopajai bhaiee manmukh dhoojai bhai ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, love for the Lord does not well up, O Siblings of Destiny; the self-willed manmukhs are engrossed in the love of duality.

verses.original: ਤੁਹ ਕੁਟਹਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਭਾਈ ਪਲੈ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tuh kuTeh manmukh karam kareh bhaiee palai kichhoo na pai ||2||
verses.translation: Actions performed by the manmukh are like the threshing of the chaff - they obtain nothing for their efforts. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਸਾਚੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur miliaai naam man raviaa bhaiee saachee preet piaar ||
verses.translation: Meeting the Guru, the Naam comes to permeate the mind, O Siblings of Destiny, with true love and affection.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sadhaa har ke gun ravai bhaiee gur kai het apaar ||3||
verses.translation: He always sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny, with infinite love for the Guru. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਇਆ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਜਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aaiaa so paravaan hai bhaiee j gur sevaa chit lai ||
verses.translation: How blessed and approved is his coming into the world, O Siblings of Destiny, who focuses his mind on serving the Guru.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਮੇਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੮॥
verses.translit: naanak naam har paieeaai bhaiee gur sabadhee melai ||4||8||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Name of the Lord is obtained, O Siblings of Destiny, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and we merge with the Lord. ||4||8||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa teejaa ghar pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Third Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ਤਿਹੀ ਗੁਣੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tihee gunee tirabhavan viaapiaa bhaiee gurmukh boojh bujhai ||
verses.translation: The three worlds are entangled in the three qualities, O Siblings of Destiny; the Guru imparts understanding.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗਿ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਗਿਆਨੀਆ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: raam naam lag chhooTeeaai bhaiee poochhahu giaaneeaa jai ||1||
verses.translation: Attached to the Lord's Name, one is emancipated, O Siblings of Destiny; go and ask the wise ones about this. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਉਥੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man re trai gun chhodd chauthai chit lai ||
verses.translation: O mind, renounce the three qualities, and focus your consciousness on the fourth state.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਭਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau terai man vasai bhaiee sadhaa har ke gun gai || rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Dear Lord abides in the mind, O Siblings of Destiny; ever sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੈ ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਊਪਜੇ ਭਾਈ ਨਾਇ ਵਿਸਰਿਐ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naamai te sabh uoopaje bhaiee nai visariaai mar jai ||
verses.translation: From the Naam, everyone originated, O Siblings of Destiny; forgetting the Naam, they die away.

verses.original: ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਸੂਤੇ ਗਏ ਮੁਹਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: agiaanee jagat a(n)dh hai bhaiee soote ge muhai ||2||
verses.translation: The ignorant world is blind, O Siblings of Destiny; those who sleep are plundered. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਗੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jaage se ubare bhaiee bhavajal paar utaar ||
verses.translation: Those Gurmukhs who remain awake are saved, O Siblings of Destiny; they cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jag meh laahaa har naam hai bhaiee hiradhai rakhiaa ur dhaar ||3||
verses.translation: In this world, the Name of the Lord is the true profit, O Siblings of Destiny; keep it enshrined within your heart. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਉਬਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur saranaiee ubare bhaiee raam naam liv lai ||
verses.translation: In the Guru's Sanctuary, O Siblings of Destiny, you shall be saved; be lovingly attuned to the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਉ ਬੇੜਾ ਨਾਉ ਤੁਲਹੜਾ ਭਾਈ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਗਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਜਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥੯॥
verses.translit: naanak naau beRaa naau tulahaRaa bhaiee jit lag paar jan pai ||4||9||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Name of the Lord is the boat, and the Name is the raft, O Siblings of Destiny; setting out on it, the Lord's humble servant crosses over the world-ocean. ||4||9||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa teejaa ghar pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Third Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਜਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹੋਰ ਥੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sukh saagar jag a(n)tar hor thai sukh naahee ||
verses.translation: The True Guru is the ocean of peace in the world; there is no other place of rest and peace.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਗਤੁ ਦੁਖਿ ਰੋਗਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਰੋਵੈ ਧਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: haumai jagat dhukh rog viaapiaa mar janamai rovai dhaahee ||1||
verses.translation: The world is afflicted with the painful disease of egotism; dying, only to be reborn, it cries out in pain. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: praanee satigur sev sukh pai ||
verses.translation: O mind, serve the True Guru, and obtain peace.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ ਤ ਜਾਹਿਗਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur seveh taa sukh paaveh naeh ta jaahigaa janam gavai || rahaau ||
verses.translation: If you serve the True Guru, you shall find peace; otherwise, you shall depart, after wasting away your life in vain. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਧਾਤੁ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: trai gun dhaat bahu karam kamaaveh har ras saadh na aaiaa ||
verses.translation: Led around by the three qualities, he does many deeds, but he does not come to taste and savor the subtle essence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸੰਧਿਆ ਤਰਪਣੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਗਾਇਤ੍ਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sa(n)dhiaa tarapan kareh gaitree bin boojhe dhukh paiaa ||2||
verses.translation: He says his evening prayers, and makes offerings of water, and recites his morning prayers, but without true understanding, he still suffers in pain. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: satigur seve so vaddabhaagee jis no aap milaae ||
verses.translation: One who serves the True Guru is very fortunate; as the Lord so wills, he meets with the Guru.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀ ਜਨ ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har ras pee jan sadhaa tirapataase vichahu aap gavaae ||3||
verses.translation: Drinking in the sublime essence of the Lord, His humble servants remain ever satisfied; they eradicate self-conceit from within themselves. ||3||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਅੰਧਾ ਸਭੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: eih jag a(n)dhaa sabh a(n)dh kamaavai bin gur mag na paae ||
verses.translation: This world is blind, and all act blindly; without the Guru, no one finds the Path.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਅਖੀ ਵੇਖੈ ਘਰੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: naanak satigur milai ta akhee vekhai gharai a(n)dhar sach paae ||4||10||
verses.translation: O Nanak, meeting with the True Guru, one sees with his eyes, and finds the True Lord within the home of his own being. ||4||10||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਭਰਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur seve bahutaa dhukh laagaa jug chaare bharamaiee ||
verses.translation: Without serving the True Guru, he suffers in terrible pain, and throughout the four ages, he wanders aimlessly.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਦੀਨ ਤੁਮ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਦਾਤੇ ਸਬਦੇ ਦੇਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ham dheen tum jug jug dhaate sabadhe dheh bujhaiee ||1||
verses.translation: I am poor and meek, and throughout the ages, You are the Great Giver - please, grant me the understanding of the Shabad. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau kirapaa karahu tum piaare ||
verses.translation: O Dear Beloved Lord, please show mercy to me.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਆਧਾਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur dhaataa mel milaavahu har naam dhevahu aadhaare || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Unite me in the Union of the True Guru, the Great Giver, and give me the support of the Lord's Name. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: manasaa maar dhubidhaa sahaj samaanee paiaa naam apaaraa ||
verses.translation: Conquering my desires and duality, I have merged in celestial peace, and I have found the Naam, the Name of the Infinite Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har ras chaakh man niramal hoaa kilabikh kaaTanahaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: I have tasted the sublime essence of the Lord, and my soul has become immaculately pure; the Lord is the Destroyer of sins. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰਹੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੀਵਹੁ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਤਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh marahu fir jeevahu sadh hee taa fir maran na hoiee ||
verses.translation: Dying in the Word of the Shabad, you shall live forever, and you shall never die again.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit naam sadhaa man meeThaa sabadhe paavai koiee ||3||
verses.translation: The Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam is ever-sweet to the mind; but how few are those who obtain the Shabad. ||3||

verses.original: ਦਾਤੈ ਦਾਤਿ ਰਖੀ ਹਥਿ ਅਪਣੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhaatai dhaat rakhee hath apanai jis bhaavai tis dheiee ||
verses.translation: The Great Giver keeps His Gifts in His Hand; He gives them to those with whom He is pleased.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਦਰਗਹ ਜਾਪਹਿ ਸੇਈ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: naanak naam rate sukh paiaa dharageh jaapeh seiee ||4||11||
verses.translation: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, they find peace, and in the Court of the Lord, they are exalted. ||4||11||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਾ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਤਦ ਹੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: satigur seve taa sahaj dhun upajai gat mat tadh hee paae ||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, the divine melody wells up within, and one is blessed with wisdom and salvation.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam sachaa man vasiaa naame naam samaae ||1||
verses.translation: The True Name of the Lord comes to abide in the mind, and through the Name, one merges in the Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur sabh jag bauraanaa ||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, the whole world is insane.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਝੂਠੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਨਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh a(n)dhaa sabadh na jaanai jhooThai bharam bhulaanaa || rahaau ||
verses.translation: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not realize the Word of the Shabad; they are deluded by false doubts. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: trai gun maiaa bharam bhulaiaa haumai ba(n)dhan kamaae ||
verses.translation: The three-faced Maya had led them astray in doubt, and they are snared by the noose of egotism.

verses.original: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਊਭਉ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ja(n)man maran sir uoopar uoobhau garabh jon dhukh paae ||2||
verses.translation: Birth and death hang over their heads, and being reborn from the womb, they suffer in pain. ||2||

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: trai gun varateh sagal sa(n)saaraa haumai vich pat khoiee ||
verses.translation: The three qualities permeate the whole world; acting in ego, it loses its honor.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਚਉਥਾ ਪਦੁ ਚੀਨੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hovai chauthaa padh cheenai raam naam sukh hoiee ||3||
verses.translation: But one who becomes Gurmukh comes to realize the fourth state of celestial bliss; he finds peace through the Name of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਜੋ ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: trai gun sabh tere too aape karataa jo too kareh su hoiee ||
verses.translation: The three qualities are all Yours, O Lord; You Yourself created them. Whatever You do, comes to pass.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਖੋਈ ॥੪॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: naanak raam naam nisataaraa sabadhe haumai khoiee ||4||12||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through the Lord's Name, one is emancipated; through the Shabad, he is rid of egotism. ||4||12||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa chauthhaa ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fourth Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਅਪਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape aap varatadhaa piaaraa aape aap apaahu ||
verses.translation: My Beloved Lord Himself pervades and permeates all; He Himself is, all by Himself.

verses.original: ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਜਗੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: vanajaaraa jag aap hai piaaraa aape saachaa saahu ||
verses.translation: My Beloved Himself is the trader in this world; He Himself is the true banker.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਵਣਜੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਆ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਸਚੁ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aape vanaj vaapaareeaa piaaraa aape sach vesaahu ||1||
verses.translation: My Beloved Himself is the trade and the trader; He Himself is the true credit. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: jap man har har naam salaeh ||
verses.translation: O mind, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, and praise His Name.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur kirapaa te paieeaai piaaraa a(n)mrit agam athaeh || rahaau ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, the Beloved, Ambrosial, unapproachable and unfathomable Lord is obtained. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਭ ਵੇਖਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੇ ਆਪਿ ਮੁਹਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape sun sabh vekhadhaa piaaraa mukh bole aap muhaahu ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself sees and hears everything; He Himself speaks through the mouths of all beings.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪਿ ਵਿਖਾਲੇ ਰਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape ujhaR paidhaa piaaraa aap vikhaale raahu ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself leads us into the wilderness, and He Himself shows us the Way.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਸਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aape hee sabh aap hai piaaraa aape veparavaahu ||2||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself is Himself all-in-all; He Himself is carefree. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਧੰਧੜੈ ਲਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape aap upaidhaa piaaraa sir aape dha(n)dhaRai laahu ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself, all by Himself, created everything; He Himself links all to their tasks.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਸਾਖਤੀ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: aap karaae saakhatee piaaraa aap maare mar jaahu ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself creates the Creation, and He Himself destroys it.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਪਤਣੁ ਪਾਤਣੀ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਹੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aape patan paatanee piaaraa aape paar la(n)ghaahu ||3||
verses.translation: He Himself is the wharf, and He Himself is the ferryman, who ferries us across. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਆਪਿ ਚਲਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape saagar bohithaa piaaraa gur khevaT aap chalaahu ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself is the ocean, and the boat; He Himself is the Guru, the boatman who steers it

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਚੜਿ ਲੰਘਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਚੋਜ ਵੇਖੈ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape hee chaR la(n)ghadhaa piaaraa kar choj vekhai paatisaahu ||
verses.translation: . The Beloved Himself sets sail and crosses over; He, the King, beholds His wondrous play.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਹੁ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: aape aap dhiaal hai piaaraa jan naanak bakhas milaahu ||4||1||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself is the Merciful Master; O servant Nanak, He forgives and blends with Himself. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਚਉਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa chauthhaa chauthaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਅੰਡਜ ਜੇਰਜ ਸੇਤਜ ਉਤਭੁਜ ਆਪੇ ਖੰਡ ਆਪੇ ਸਭ ਲੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape a(n)ddaj jeraj setaj utabhuj aape kha(n)dd aape sabh loi ||
verses.translation: He Himself is born of the egg, from the womb, from sweat and from the earth; He Himself is the continents and all the worlds.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸੂਤੁ ਆਪੇ ਬਹੁ ਮਣੀਆ ਕਰਿ ਸਕਤੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਪਰੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape soot aape bahu maneeaa kar sakatee jagat paroi ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the thread, and He Himself is the many beads; through His Almighty Power, He has strung the worlds.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਸੂਤਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸੂਤੁ ਖਿੰਚੇ ਢਹਿ ਢੇਰੀ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aape hee sootadhaar hai piaaraa soot khi(n)che ddeh dderee hoi ||1||
verses.translation: He holds the thread, and when He withdraws the thread, the beads scatter into heaps. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: mere man mai har bin avar na koi ||
verses.translation: O my mind, there is no other than the Lord for me.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਚੋਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur vich naam nidhaan hai piaaraa kar dhiaa a(n)mrit mukh choi || rahaau ||
verses.translation: The treasure of the Beloved Naam is within the True Guru; in His Mercy, he pours the Ambrosial Nectar into my mouth. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਜਲ ਥਲਿ ਸਭਤੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape jal thal sabhat hai piaaraa prabh aape kare su hoi ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself is in all the oceans and lands; whatever God does, comes to pass.

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਮਾਹਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa rijak samaahadhaa piaaraa dhoojaa avar na koi ||
verses.translation: The Beloved brings nourishment to all; there is no other than Him.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲ ਖੇਲਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aape khel khelaidhaa piaaraa aape kare su hoi ||2||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself plays, and whatever He Himself does, comes to pass. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape hee aap niramalaa piaaraa aape niramal soi ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself, all by Himself, is immaculate and pure; He Himself is immaculate and pure.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape keemat paidhaa piaaraa aape kare su hoi ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself determines the value of all; whatever He does comes to pass.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪਿ ਲਖਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aape alakh na lakheeaai piaaraa aap lakhaavai soi ||3||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself is unseen - He cannot be seen; He Himself causes us to see. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape gahir ga(n)bheer hai piaaraa tis jevadd avar na koi ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself is deep and profound and unfathomable; there is no other as great as He.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਘਟ ਆਪੇ ਭੋਗਵੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਾਰੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ghaT aape bhogavai piaaraa vich naaree purakh sabh soi ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself enjoys every heart; He is contained within every woman and man.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gupat varatadhaa piaaraa gurmukh paragaT hoi ||4||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Beloved is pervading everywhere, but He is hidden; through the Guru, He is revealed. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਸਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: aape hee sabh aap hai piaaraa aape thaap uthaapai ||
verses.translation: He Himself, the Beloved, is Himself all-in-all; He Himself establishes and disestablishes.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਚੋਜ ਵੇਖੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: aape vekh vigasadhaa piaaraa kar choj vekhai prabh aapai ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself beholds, and rejoices; God Himself works wonders, and beholds them.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਵਣਿ ਤਿਣਿ ਸਭਤੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aape van tin sabhat hai piaaraa aape gurmukh jaapai ||1||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself is contained in all the woods and meadows; as Gurmukh, He reveals Himself. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਿ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: jap man har har naam ras dhraapai ||
verses.translation: Meditate, O mind, on the Lord, Har, Har; through the sublime essence of Lord's Name, you shall be satisfied.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਚਖਿ ਜਾਪੈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam mahaa ras meeThaa gur sabadhee chakh jaapai || rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, is the sweetest juice; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, its taste is revealed. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਤੁਲਹੜਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: aape teerath tulahaRaa piaaraa aap tarai prabh aapai ||
verses.translation: The Beloved is Himself the place of pilgrimage and the raft; God Himself ferries Himself across.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਲੁ ਵਤਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: aape jaal vataidhaa piaaraa sabh jag machhulee har aapai ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself casts the net over all the world; the Lord Himself is the fish.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਅਭੁਲੁ ਨ ਭੁਲਈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aap abhul na bhuliee piaaraa avar na dhoojaa jaapai ||2||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself is infallible; He makes no mistakes. There is no other like Him to be seen. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਿੰਙੀ ਨਾਦੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਧੁਨਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਜਾਏ ਆਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: aape si(n)n(g)ee naadh hai piaaraa dhun aap vajaae aapai ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself is the Yogi's horn, and the sound current of the Naad; He Himself plays the tune.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਜੋਗੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਤਪੁ ਤਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: aape jogee purakh hai piaaraa aape hee tap taapai ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself is the Yogi, the Primal Being; He Himself practices intense meditation.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਚੇਲਾ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aape satigur aap hai chelaa upadhes karai prabh aapai ||3||
verses.translation: He Himself is the True Guru, and He Himself is the disciple; God Himself imparts the Teachings. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਨਾਉ ਜਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: aape naau japaidhaa piaaraa aape hee jap jaapai ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself inspires us to chant His Name, and He Himself practices meditation.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਰਸੁ ਆਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: aape a(n)mrit aap hai piaaraa aape hee ras aapai ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself is the Ambrosial Nectar; He Himself is the juice of it.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਸਲਾਹਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: aape aap salaahadhaa piaaraa jan naanak har ras dhraapai ||4||3||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself praises Himself; servant Nanak is satisfied, with the sublime essence of the Lord. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕੰਡਾ ਆਪਿ ਤਰਾਜੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਤੋਲਿ ਤੋਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aape ka(n)ddaa aap taraajee prabh aape tol tolaiaa ||
verses.translation: God Himself is the balance scale, He Himself is the weigher, and He Himself weighs with the weights.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aape saahu aape vanajaaraa aape vanaj karaiaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the banker, He Himself is the trader, and He Himself makes the trades.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਪਿਆਰੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਟੰਕੁ ਚੜਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aape dharatee saajeean piaarai pichhai Ta(n)k chaRaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself fashioned the world, and He Himself counter-balances it with a gram. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: mere man har har dhiaai sukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: My mind meditates on the Lord, Har, Har, and finds peace.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam nidhaan hai piaaraa gur poorai meeThaa laiaa || rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Beloved Lord, Har, Har, is a treasure; the Perfect Guru has made it seem sweet to me. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਆਪਿ ਜਲੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aape dharatee aap jal piaaraa aape kare karaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself is the earth, and He Himself is the water; He Himself acts, and causes others to act.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜਲੁ ਮਾਟੀ ਬੰਧਿ ਰਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aape hukam varatadhaa piaaraa jal maaTee ba(n)dh rakhaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself issues His Commands, and keeps the water and the land bound down.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਭਉ ਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਬੰਨਿ ਬਕਰੀ ਸੀਹੁ ਹਢਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aape hee bhau paidhaa piaaraa ba(n)n bakaree seeh haddaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself instills the Fear of God; He binds the tiger and the goat together. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਾਸਟ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਸਟ ਅਗਨਿ ਰਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aape kaasaT aap har piaaraa vich kaasaT agan rakhaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Lord Himself is the firewood, and He Himself keeps the fire within the wood.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਭੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਜਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aape hee aap varatadhaa piaaraa bhai agan na sakai jalaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Lord Himself, all by Himself, permeates them, and because of the Fear of God, the fire cannot burn the wood.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸਾਹ ਲੈਦੇ ਸਭਿ ਲਵਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aape maar jeevaidhaa piaaraa saeh laidhe sabh lavaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself kills and revives; all draw the breath of life, given by Him. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਤਾਣੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aape taan dheebaan hai piaaraa aape kaarai laiaa ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself is power and presence; He Himself engages us in our work.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਆਪਿ ਚਲਾਏ ਤਿਉ ਚਲੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jiau aap chalaae tiau chaleeaai piaare jiau har prabh mere bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: As the Beloved makes me walk, I walk, as it pleases my Lord God.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਜੰਤੀ ਜੰਤੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਜਹਿ ਵਜਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: aape ja(n)tee ja(n)t hai piaaraa jan naanak vajeh vajaiaa ||4||4||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself is the musician, and the musical instrument; servant Nanak vibrates His vibration. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਚੰਦੁ ਚਾਨਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape sirasaT upaidhaa piaaraa kar sooraj cha(n)dh chaanaan ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself created the Universe; He made the light of the sun and the moon.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਨਿਤਾਣਿਆ ਤਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਮਾਣਿਆ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: aap nitaaniaa taan hai piaaraa aap nimaaniaa maan ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself is the power of the powerless; He Himself is the honor of the dishonored.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਰਖਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aap dhiaa kar rakhadhaa piaaraa aape sughaR sujaan ||1||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself grants His Grace and protects us; He Himself is wise and all-knowing. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: mere man jap raam naam neesaan ||
verses.translation: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, and receive His Insignia.

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat mil dhiaai too har har bahuR na aavan jaan || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and meditate on the Lord, Har, Har; you shall not have to come and go in reincarnation again. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਗੁਣ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape hee gun varatadhaa piaaraa aape hee paravaan ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself pervades His Glorious Praises, and He Himself approves them.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਸਚੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape bakhas karaidhaa piaaraa aape sach neesaan ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself grants His forgiveness, and He Himself bestows the Insignia of Truth.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aape hukam varatadhaa piaaraa aape hee furamaan ||2||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself obeys His Will, and He Himself issues His Command. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਦਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape bhagat bha(n)ddaar hai piaaraa aape dhevai dhaan ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself is the treasure of devotion; He Himself gives His gifts.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਵਾਵੈ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape sev karaidhaa piaaraa aap dhivaavai maan ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself commits some to His service, and He Himself blesses them with honor.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aape taaRee laidhaa piaaraa aape gunee nidhaan ||3||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself is absorbed in Samaadhi; He Himself is the treasure of excellence. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਵਡਾ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਪਰਧਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape vaddaa aap hai piaaraa aape hee paradhaan ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself is the greatest; He Himself is supreme.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਤੁਲੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape keemat paidhaa piaaraa aape tul paravaan ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself appraises the value; He Himself is the scale, and the weights.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਤੁਲਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: aape atul tulaidhaa piaaraa jan naanak sadh kurabaan ||4||5||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself is unweighable - He weighs Himself; servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||4||5||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਉਮਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape sevaa laidhaa piaaraa aape bhagat umaahaa ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself commits some to His service; He Himself blesses them with the joy of devotional worship.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape gun gaavaidhaa piaaraa aape sabadh samaahaa ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself causes us to sing His Glorious Praises; He Himself is absorbed in the Word of His Shabad.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਲੇਖਣਿ ਆਪਿ ਲਿਖਾਰੀ ਆਪੇ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਹਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aape lekhan aap likhaaree aape lekh likhaahaa ||1||
verses.translation: He Himself is the pen, and He Himself is the scribe; He Himself inscribes His inscription. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਓਮਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: mere man jap raam naam omaahaa ||
verses.translation: O my mind, joyfully chant the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਨਦੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਲੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਹਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin anadh hovai vaddabhaagee lai gur poorai har laahaa || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Those very fortunate ones are in ecstasy night and day; through the Perfect Guru, they obtain the profit of the Lord's Name. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਗੋਪੀ ਕਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਬਨਿ ਆਪੇ ਗਊ ਚਰਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape gopee kaan hai piaaraa ban aape guoo charaahaa ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself is the milk-maid and Krishna; He Himself herds the cows in the woods.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਵਲ ਸੁੰਦਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਵੰਸੁ ਵਜਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape saaval su(n)dharaa piaaraa aape va(n)s vajaahaa ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself is the blue-skinned, handsome one; He Himself plays on His flute.

verses.original: ਕੁਵਲੀਆ ਪੀੜੁ ਆਪਿ ਮਰਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਲਕ ਰੂਪਿ ਪਚਾਹਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kuvaleeaa peeR aap maraidhaa piaaraa kar baalak roop pachaahaa ||2||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself took the form of a child, and destroyed Kuwalia-peer, the mad elephant. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਅਖਾੜਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਚੋਜਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: aap akhaaRaa paidhaa piaaraa kar vekhai aap chojaahaa ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself sets the stage; He performs the plays, and He Himself watches them.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਬਾਲਕ ਰੂਪ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਚੰਡੂਰੁ ਕੰਸੁ ਕੇਸੁ ਮਾਰਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: kar baalak roop upaidhaa piaaraa cha(n)ddoor ka(n)s kes maaraahaa ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself assumed the form of the child, and killed the demons Chandoor, Kansa and Kaysee.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਬਲੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਬਲੁ ਭੰਨੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧਾਹਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aape hee bal aap hai piaaraa bal bha(n)nai moorakh mugadhaahaa ||3||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself, by Himself, is the embodiment of power; He shatters the power of the fools and idiots. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵਸਿ ਆਪੇ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਹਥਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh aape jagat upaidhaa piaaraa vas aape jugat hathaahaa ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself created the whole world. In His hands He holds the power of the ages.

verses.original: ਗਲਿ ਜੇਵੜੀ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਖਿੰਚੈ ਤਿਉ ਜਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: gal jevaRee aape paidhaa piaaraa jiau prabh khi(n)chai tiau jaahaa ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Himself puts the chains around their necks; as God pulls them, must they go.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਗਰਬੈ ਸੋ ਪਚਸੀ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: jo garabai so pachasee piaare jap naanak bhagat samaahaa ||4||6||
verses.translation: Whoever harbors pride shall be destroyed, O Beloved; meditating on the Lord, Nanak is absorbed in devotional worship. ||4||6||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਃ ੪ ਦੁਤੁਕੇ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa chauthhaa dhutuke ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fourth Mehla, Dho-Thukay:

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਨਮ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: anik janam vichhuRe dhukh paiaa manmukh karam karai aha(n)kaaree ||
verses.translation: Separated from the Lord for countless lifetimes, the self-willed manmukh suffers in pain, engaged in acts of egotism.

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਪਰਸਤ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saadhoo parasat hee prabh paiaa gobidh saran tumaaree ||1||
verses.translation: Beholding the Holy Saint, I found God; O Lord of the Universe, I seek Your Sanctuary. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿਦ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: gobidh preet lagee at piaaree ||
verses.translation: The Love of God is very dear to me.

verses.original: ਜਬ ਸਤਸੰਗ ਭਏ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jab satasa(n)g bhe saadhoo jan hiradhai miliaa saa(n)t muraaree || rahaau ||
verses.translation: When I joined the Sat Sangat, the Company of the Holy People, the Lord, the embodiment of peace, came into my heart. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਵਸਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਬੁਝਹਿ ਗਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: too hiradhai gupat vaseh dhin raatee teraa bhaau na bujheh gavaaree ||
verses.translation: You dwell, hidden, within my heart day and night, Lord; but the poor fools do not understand Your Love.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: satigur purakh miliaa prabh pragaTiaa gun gaavai gun veechaaree ||2||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Almighty True Guru, God was revealed to me; I sing His Glorious Praises, and reflect upon His Glories. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਭਇਆ ਸਾਤਿ ਆਈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh pragaas bhiaa saat aaiee dhuramat budh nivaaree ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, I have become enlightened; peace has come, and evil-mindedness has been dispelled from my mind.

verses.original: ਆਤਮ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aatam braham cheen sukh paiaa satasa(n)gat purakh tumaaree ||3||
verses.translation: Understanding the relationship of the individual soul with God, I have found peace, in Your Sat Sangat, Your True Congregation, O Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਪੁਰਖੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਈ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: purakhai purakh miliaa gur paiaa jin kau kirapaa bhiee tumaaree ||
verses.translation: Those who are blessed by Your Kind Mercy, meet the Almighty Lord, and find the Guru.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੭॥
verses.translit: naanak atul sahaj sukh paiaa anadhin jaagat rahai banavaaree ||4||7||
verses.translation: Nanak has found the immeasurable, celestial peace; night and day, he remains awake to the Lord, the Master of the Forest of the Universe. ||4||7||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har siau preet a(n)tar man bedhiaa har bin rahan na jaiee ||
verses.translation: The inner depths of my mind are pierced by love for the Lord; I cannot live without the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਨੀਰੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਤਿਉ ਨਾਮੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jiau machhulee bin neerai binasai tiau naamai bin mar jaiee ||1||
verses.translation: Just as the fish dies without water, I die without the Lord's Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਲੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: mere prabh kirapaa jal dhevahu har naiee ||
verses.translation: O my God, please bless me with the water of Your Name.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਗਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau a(n)tar naam ma(n)gaa dhin raatee naame hee saa(n)t paiee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: I beg for Your Name, deep within myself, day and night; through the Name, I find peace. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੁ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਲਲਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jiau chaatirak jal bin bilalaavai bin jal piaas na jaiee ||
verses.translation: The song-bird cries out for lack of water - without water, its thirst cannot be quenched.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿਆ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jal paavai sukh sahaje hariaa bhai subhaiee ||2||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh obtains the water of celestial bliss, and is rejuvenated, blossoming forth through the blessed Love of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭੂਖੇ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਡੋਲਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh bhookhe dheh dhis ddoleh bin naavai dhukh paiee ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are hungry, wandering around in the ten directions; without the Name, they suffer in pain.

verses.original: ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਆਵੈ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: janam marai fir jonee aavai dharageh milai sajaiee ||3||
verses.translation: They are born, only to die, and enter into reincarnation again; in the Court of the Lord, they are punished. ||3||

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kirapaa kareh taa har gun gaaveh har ras a(n)tar paiee ||
