verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਰੋਗ ਬਿਦਾਰੀ ॥੫॥੧੭॥੨੮॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak jis masatak likhiaa tis gur mil rog bidhaaree ||5||17||28||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, one who has such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon his forehead, meets with the Guru, and his diseases are cured. ||5||17||28||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਦੁਪਦੇ
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ghar doojaa dhupadhe
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla, Second House, Dho-Padhay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਬਨਸਪਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਦੂਧ ਮਹਿ ਘੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: sagal banasapat meh baisa(n)tar sagal dhoodh meh gheeaa ||
verses.translation: Fire is contained in all firewood, and butter is contained in all milk.

verses.original: ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਮਾਧਉ ਜੀਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: uooch neech meh jot samaanee ghaT ghaT maadhau jeeaa ||1||
verses.translation: God's Light is contained in the high and the low; the Lord is in the hearts of all beings. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਹਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tahu ghaT ghaT rahiaa samaahio ||
verses.translation: O Saints, He is pervading and permeating each and every heart.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਰਬ ਮਹਿ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਆਹਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: pooran poor rahio sarab meh jal thal ramieeaa aahio ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Lord is completely permeating everyone, everywhere; He is diffused in the water and the land. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: gun nidhaan naanak jas gaavai satigur bharam chukaio ||
verses.translation: Nanak sings the Praises of the Lord, the treasure of excellence; the True Guru has dispelled his doubt.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਸਦਾ ਅਲੇਪਾ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੯॥
verses.translit: sarab nivaasee sadhaa alepaa sabh meh rahiaa samaio ||2||1||29||
verses.translation: The Lord is pervading everywhere, permeating all, and yet, He is unattached from all. ||2||1||29||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭੈ ਦੁਖੀ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai simaran hoi ana(n)dhaa binasai janam maran bhai dhukhee ||
verses.translation: Meditating on Him, one is in ecstasy; the pains of birth and death and fear are removed.

verses.original: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: chaar padhaarath nav nidh paaveh bahur na tirasanaa bhukhee ||1||
verses.translation: The four cardinal blessings, and the nine treasures are received; you shall never feel hunger or thirst again. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਤੂ ਸੁਖੀ ॥
verses.translit: jaa ko naam lait too sukhee ||
verses.translation: Chanting His Name, you shall be at peace.

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਉ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਜੀਅਰੇ ਮੁਖੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saas saas dhiaavahu Thaakur kau man tan jeeare mukhee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: With each and every breath, meditate on the Lord and Master, O my soul, with mind, body and mouth. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਮਨ ਸੀਤਲ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧੁਖੀ ॥
verses.translit: saa(n)t paaveh hoveh man seetal agan na a(n)tar dhukhee ||
verses.translation: You shall find peace, and your mind shall be soothed and cooled; the fire of desire shall not burn within you.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਰੁਖੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੩੦॥
verses.translit: gur naanak kau prabhoo dhikhaiaa jal thal tirabhavan rukhee ||2||2||30||
verses.translation: The Guru has revealed God to Nanak, in the three worlds, in the water, the earth and the woods. ||2||2||30||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਝੂਠ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਇਨ ਤੇ ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh lobh jhooTh ni(n)dhaa in te aap chhaddaavahu ||
verses.translation: Sexual desire, anger, greed, falsehood and slander - please, save me from these, O Lord.

verses.original: ਇਹ ਭੀਤਰ ਤੇ ਇਨ ਕਉ ਡਾਰਹੁ ਆਪਨ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਬੁਲਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: eeh bheetar te in kau ddaarahu aapan nikaT bulaavahu ||1||
verses.translation: Please eradicate these from within me, and call me to come close to You. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਪੁਨੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਆਪਿ ਜਨਾਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: apunee bidh aap janaavahu ||
verses.translation: You alone teach me Your Ways.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮੰਗਲ ਗਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har jan ma(n)gal gaavahu ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: With the Lord's humble servants, I sing His Praises. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਬਹੂ ਹੀਏ ਤੇ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: bisar naahee kabahoo he'ee te ieh bidh man meh paavahu ||
verses.translation: May I never forget the Lord within my heart; please, instill such understanding within my mind.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਧਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥੩॥੩੧॥
verses.translit: gur pooraa bheTio vaddabhaagee jan naanak kateh na dhaavahu ||2||3||31||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, servant Nanak has met with the Perfect Guru, and now, he will not go anywhere else. ||2||3||31||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਘਾਲ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai simaran sabh kachh paieeaai birathee ghaal na jaiee ||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance on Him, all things are obtained, and one's efforts shall not be in vain.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਅਵਰ ਕਤ ਰਾਚਹੁ ਜੋ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tis prabh tiaag avar kat raachahu jo sabh meh rahiaa samaiee ||1||
verses.translation: Forsaking God, why do you attach yourself to another? He is contained in everything. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: har har simarahu sa(n)t gopaalaa ||
verses.translation: O Saints, meditate in remembrance on the World-Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g mil naam dhiaavahu pooran hovai ghaalaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; your efforts shall be rewarded. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਲੈ ਨਿਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸਹਿਤ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: saar samaalai nit pratipaalai prem sahit gal laavai ||
verses.translation: He ever preserves and cherishes His servant; with Love, He hugs him close.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਜਗਤ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੪॥੩੨॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak prabh tumare bisarat jagat jeevan kaise paavai ||2||4||32||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, forgetting You, O God, how can the world find life? ||2||4||32||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਜੀਅਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਭ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: abinaasee jeean ko dhaataa simarat sabh mal khoiee ||
verses.translation: He is imperishable, the Giver of all beings; meditating on Him, all filth is removed.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਉ ਬਰਤਨਿ ਬਿਰਲਾ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gun nidhaan bhagatan kau baratan biralaa paavai koiee ||1||
verses.translation: He is the treasure of excellence, the object of His devotees, but rare are those who find Him. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: mere man jap gur gopaal prabh soiee ||
verses.translation: O my mind, meditate on the Guru, and God, the Cherisher of the world.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆਂ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kee saran piaa(n) sukh paieeaai baahuR dhookh na hoiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Seeking His Sanctuary, one finds peace, and he shall not suffer in pain again. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਭੇਟਤ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: vaddabhaagee saadhasa(n)g paraapat tin bheTat dhuramat khoiee ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, one obtains the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Meeting them, evil-mindedness is eliminated.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਬਾਛੈ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਪਰੋਈ ॥੨॥੫॥੩੩॥
verses.translit: tin kee dhoor naanak dhaas baachhai jin har naam ridhai paroiee ||2||5||33||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak yearns for the dust of the feet of those, who have woven the Lord's Name into their hearts. ||2||5||33||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਸੂਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਧਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: janam janam ke dhookh nivaarai sookaa man saadhaarai ||
verses.translation: He dispels the pains of countless incarnations, and lends support to the dry and shrivelled mind.

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dharasan bheTat hot nihaalaa har kaa naam beechaarai ||1||
verses.translation: Beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, one is enraptured, contemplating the Name of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਬੈਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: meraa baidh guroo govi(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: My physician is the Guru, the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਕਾਟੈ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫੰਧਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam aaukhadh mukh dhevai kaaTai jam kee fa(n)dhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He places the medicine of the Naam into my mouth, and cuts away the noose of Death. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਮਰਥ ਪੁਰਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: samarath purakh pooran bidhaate aape karanaihaaraa ||
verses.translation: He is the all-powerful, Perfect Lord, the Architect of Destiny; He Himself is the Doer of deeds.

verses.original: ਅਪੁਨਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਉਬਾਰਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੨॥੬॥੩੪॥
verses.translit: apunaa dhaas har aap ubaariaa naanak naam adhaaraa ||2||6||34||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself saves His slave; Nanak takes the Support of the Naam. ||2||6||34||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਪਾਹਿ ਨਿਬੇਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar kee gat tum hee jaanee tujh hee paeh nibero ||
verses.translation: Only You know the state of my innermost self; You alone can judge me.

verses.original: ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਲਾਖ ਖਤੇ ਕਰਿ ਫੇਰੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bakhas laih saahib prabh apane laakh khate kar fero ||1||
verses.translation: Please forgive me, O Lord God Master; I have committed thousands of sins and mistakes. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨੇਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: prabh jee too mero Thaakur nero ||
verses.translation: O my Dear Lord God Master, You are always near me.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਮੋਹਿ ਚੇਰੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har charan saran moh chero ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O Lord, please bless Your disciple with the shelter of Your feet. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਊਚੋ ਗੁਨੀ ਗਹੇਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: besumaar bea(n)t suaamee uoocho gunee gahero ||
verses.translation: Infinite and endless is my Lord and Master; He is lofty, virtuous and profoundly deep.

verses.original: ਕਾਟਿ ਸਿਲਕ ਕੀਨੋ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਦਾਸਰੋ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਾ ਨਿਹੋਰੋ ॥੨॥੭॥੩੫॥
verses.translit: kaaT silak keeno apuno dhaasaro tau naanak kahaa nihoro ||2||7||35||
verses.translation: Cutting away the noose of death, the Lord has made Nanak His slave, and now, what does he owe to anyone else? ||2||7||35||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: bhe kirapaal guroo govi(n)dhaa sagal manorath paae ||
verses.translation: The Guru, the Lord of the Universe, became merciful to me, and I obtained all of my mind's desires.

verses.original: ਅਸਥਿਰ ਭਏ ਲਾਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: asathir bhe laag har charanee govi(n)dh ke gun gaae ||1||
verses.translation: I have become stable and steady, touching the Lord's Feet, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਲੋ ਸਮੂਰਤੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: bhalo samoorat pooraa ||
verses.translation: It is a good time, a perfectly auspicious time.

verses.original: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਵਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਤੂਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saa(n)t sahaj aana(n)dh naam jap vaaje anahadh tooraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am in celestial peace, tranquility and ecstasy, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the unstruck melody of the sound current vibrates and resounds. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: mile suaamee preetam apune ghar ma(n)dhar sukhadhaiee ||
verses.translation: Meeting with my Beloved Lord and Master, my home has become a mansion filled with happiness.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਗਲੀ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਈ ॥੨॥੮॥੩੬॥
verses.translit: har naam nidhaan naanak jan paiaa sagalee ichh pujaiee ||2||8||36||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has attained the treasure of the Lord's Name; all his desires have been fulfilled. ||2||8||36||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਬਸੇ ਰਿਦ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸੁਭ ਲਖਣ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur ke charan base ridh bheetar subh lakhan prabh keene ||
verses.translation: The Guru's feet abide within my heart; God has blessed me with good fortune.

verses.original: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਮਨਿ ਚੀਨੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhe kirapaal pooran paramesar naam nidhaan man cheene ||1||
verses.translation: The Perfect Transcendent Lord became merciful to me, and I found the treasure of the Naam within my mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਰਖਵਾਰੋ ਮੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: mero gur rakhavaaro meet ||
verses.translation: My Guru is my Saving Grace, my only best friend.

verses.original: ਦੂਣ ਚਊਣੀ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸੋਭਾ ਨੀਤਾ ਨੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhoon chuoonee dhe vaddiaaiee sobhaa neetaa neet ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Over and over again, He blesses me with double, even four-fold, greatness. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t prabh sagal udhaare dharasan dhekhanahaare ||
verses.translation: God saves all beings and creatures, giving them the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਅਚਰਜ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੯॥੩੭॥
verses.translit: gur poore kee acharaj vaddiaaiee naanak sadh balihaare ||2||9||37||
verses.translation: Wondrous is the glorious greatness of the Perfect Guru; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||9||37||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੰਚਨਿ ਕਰਉ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਥਾਤੀ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)chan karau naam dhan niramal thaatee agam apaar ||
verses.translation: I gather in and collect the immaculate wealth of the Naam; this commodity is inaccessible and incomparable.

verses.original: ਬਿਲਛਿ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਆਨੰਦ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਣਹੁ ਖਾਇ ਜੀਵਹੁ ਸਿਖ ਪਰਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bilachh binodh aana(n)dh sukh maanahu khai jeevahu sikh paravaar ||1||
verses.translation: Revel in it, delight in it, be happy and enjoy peace, and live long, O Sikhs and brethren. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਆਧਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: har ke charan kamal aadhaar ||
verses.translation: I have the support of the Lotus Feet of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਚ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਚੜਿ ਲੰਘਉ ਬਿਖੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t prasaadh paio sach bohith chaR la(n)ghau bikh sa(n)saar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By the Grace of the Saints, I have found the boat of Truth; embarking on it, I sail across the ocean of poison. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਆਪਹਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਸਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: bhe kirapaal pooran abinaasee aapeh keenee saar ||
verses.translation: The perfect, imperishable Lord has become merciful; He Himself has taken care of me.

verses.original: ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਗਸਾਨੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁਮਾਰ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੩੮॥
verses.translit: pekh pekh naanak bigasaano naanak naahee sumaar ||2||10||38||
verses.translation: Beholding, beholding His Vision, Nanak has blossomed forth in ecstasy. O Nanak, He is beyond estimation. ||2||10||38||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਉਪਜੀ ਦਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai apanee kal dhaaree sabh ghaT upajee dhiaa ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has revealed His power, and compassion has welled up in every heart.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਕੀਨੀ ਕੁਸਲ ਖੇਮ ਸਭ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aape mel vaddaiee keenee kusal khem sabh bhiaa ||1||
verses.translation: Blending me with Himself, He has blessed me with glorious greatness, and I have found pleasure and happiness. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: satigur pooraa merai naal ||
verses.translation: The Perfect True Guru is always with me.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham jap sadhaa nihaal || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Supreme Lord God, I am forever in ecstasy. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar baahar thaan thana(n)tar jat kat pekhau soiee ||
verses.translation: Inwardly and outwardly, in all places and interspaces, wherever I look, He is there.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੩੯॥
verses.translit: naanak gur paio vaddabhaagee tis jevadd avar na koiee ||2||11||39||
verses.translation: Nanak has found the Guru, by great good fortune; no one else is as great as He. ||2||11||39||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੂਖ ਮੰਗਲ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਨਿਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sookh ma(n)gal kaliaan sahaj dhun prabh ke charan nihaariaa ||
verses.translation: I have been blessed with peace, pleasure, bliss, and the celestial sound current, gazing upon the feet of God.

verses.original: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੈ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਤਾਪੁ ਉਤਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: raakhanahaarai raakhio baarik satigur taap utaariaa ||1||
verses.translation: The Savior has saved His child, and the True Guru has cured his fever. ||1||

verses.original: ਉਬਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aubare satigur kee saranaiee ||
verses.translation: I have been saved, in the True Guru's Sanctuary;

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਜਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kee sev na birathee jaiee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: service to Him does not go in vain. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਸੂਖ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਸੂਖਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: ghar meh sookh baahar fun sookhaa prabh apune bhe dhiaalaa ||
verses.translation: There is peace within the home of one's heart, and there is peace outside as well, when God becomes kind and compassionate.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਊ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਆ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੪੦॥
verses.translit: naanak bighan na laagai kouoo meraa prabh hoaa kirapaalaa ||2||12||40||
verses.translation: O Nanak, no obstacles block my way; my God has become gracious and merciful to me. ||2||12||40||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਉਦਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: saadhoo sa(n)g bhiaa man udham naam ratan jas gaiee ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, my mind became excited, and I sang the Praises of the jewel of the Naam.

verses.original: ਮਿਟਿ ਗਈ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਅਨੰਤਾ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: miT giee chi(n)taa simar ana(n)taa saagar tariaa bhaiee ||1||
verses.translation: My anxiety was dispelled, meditating in remembrance on the Infinite Lord; I have crossed over the world ocean, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: hiradhai har ke charan vasaiee ||
verses.translation: I enshrine the Lord's Feet within my heart.

verses.original: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੀ ਰੋਗਾ ਘਾਣਿ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sukh paiaa sahaj dhun upajee rogaa ghaan miTaiee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: I have found peace, and the celestial sound current resounds within me; countless diseases have been eradicated. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa gun tere aakh vakhaanaa keemat kahan na jaiee ||
verses.translation: Which of Your Glorious Virtues can I speak and describe? Your worth cannot be estimated.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤ ਭਏ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਇਆ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੨॥੧੩॥੪੧॥
verses.translit: naanak bhagat bhe abinaasee apunaa prabh bhiaa sahaiee ||2||13||41||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord's devotees become imperishable and immortal; their God becomes their friend and support. ||2||13||41||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗਏ ਕਲੇਸ ਰੋਗ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: ge kales rog sabh naase prabh apunai kirapaa dhaaree ||
verses.translation: My sufferings have come to an end, and all diseases have been eradicated.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਆਰਾਧਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਘਾਲ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar aaraadhahu suaamee pooran ghaal hamaaree ||1||
verses.translation: God has showered me with His Grace. Twenty-four hours a day, I worship and adore my Lord and Master; my efforts have come to fruition. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੂ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau too sukh sa(n)pat raas ||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord, You are my peace, wealth and capital.

verses.original: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਭਾਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਗੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raakh laih bhaiee mere kau prabh aagai aradhaas || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Please, save me, O my Beloved! I offer this prayer to my God. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਮਾਗਉ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਵਉ ਅਪਨੇ ਖਸਮ ਭਰੋਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo maagau soiee soiee paavau apane khasam bharosaa ||
verses.translation: Whatever I ask for, I receive; I have total faith in my Master.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ॥੨॥੧੪॥੪੨॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak gur pooraa bheTio miTio sagal a(n)dhesaa ||2||14||42||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I have met with the Perfect Guru, and all my fears have been dispelled. ||2||14||42||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਸਗਲਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: simar simar gur satigur apanaa sagalaa dhookh miTaiaa ||
verses.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on my Guru, the True Guru, all pains have been eradicated.

verses.original: ਤਾਪ ਰੋਗ ਗਏ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: taap rog ge gur bachanee man ichhe fal paiaa ||1||
verses.translation: The fever and the disease are gone, through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, and I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: meraa gur pooraa sukhadhaataa ||
verses.translation: My Perfect Guru is the Giver of peace.

verses.original: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: karan kaaran samarath suaamee pooran purakh bidhaataa || rahaau ||
verses.translation: He is the Doer, the Cause of causes, the Almighty Lord and Master, the Perfect Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਨੰਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: ana(n)dh binodh ma(n)gal gun gaavahu gur naanak bhe dhiaalaa ||
verses.translation: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord in bliss, joy and ecstasy; Guru Nanak has become kind and compassionate.

verses.original: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰ ਭਏ ਜਗ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਹੋਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥੨॥੧੫॥੪੩॥
verses.translit: jai jai kaar bhe jag bheetar hoaa paarabraham rakhavaalaa ||2||15||43||
verses.translation: Shouts of cheers and congratulations ring out all over the world; the Supreme Lord God has become my Savior and Protector. ||2||15||43||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਮਰੀ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਗਣੀਆ ਕਾਈ ਅਪਣਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: hamaree ganat na ganeeaa kaiee apanaa biradh pachhaan ||
verses.translation: He did not take my accounts into account; such is His forgiving nature.

verses.original: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖੇ ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: haath dhei raakhe kar apune sadhaa sadhaa ra(n)g maan ||1||
verses.translation: He gave me His hand, and saved me and made me His own; forever and ever, I enjoy His Love. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਦ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਣ ॥
verses.translit: saachaa saahib sadh miharavaan ||
verses.translation: The True Lord and Master is forever merciful and forgiving.

verses.original: ਬੰਧੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹੋਈ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dh paiaa merai satigur poorai hoiee sarab kaliaan || rahaau ||
verses.translation: My Perfect Guru has bound me to Him, and now, I am in absolute ecstasy. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪਾਇ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਦਿਤਾ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਖਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau pai pi(n)dd jin saajiaa dhitaa painan khaan ||
verses.translation: The One who fashioned the body and placed the soul within, who gives you clothing and nourishment

verses.original: ਅਪਣੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਆਪਿ ਪੈਜ ਰਾਖੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥੨॥੧੬॥੪੪॥
verses.translit: apane dhaas kee aap paij raakhee naanak sadh kurabaan ||2||16||44||
verses.translation: - He Himself preserves the honor of His slaves. Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||16||44||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਦੁਰਤੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਉਬਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhurat gavaiaa har prabh aape sabh sa(n)saar ubaariaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord God Himself has rid the whole world of its sins, and saved it.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਅਪਣਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਮਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: paarabraham prabh kirapaa dhaaree apanaa biradh samaariaa ||1||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God extended His mercy, and confirmed His innate nature. ||1||

verses.original: ਹੋਈ ਰਾਜੇ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਰਖਵਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: hoiee raaje raam kee rakhavaalee ||
verses.translation: I have attained the Protective Sanctuary of the Lord, my King.

verses.original: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਹ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sookh sahaj aanadh gun gaavahu man tan dheh sukhaalee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: In celestial peace and ecstasy, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and my mind, body and being are at peace. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: patit udhaaran satigur meraa moh tis kaa bharavaasaa ||
verses.translation: My True Guru is the Savior of sinners; I have placed my trust and faith in Him.

verses.original: ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਸਭਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਾਹਿਬਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਾ ॥੨॥੧੭॥੪੫॥
verses.translit: bakhas le sabh sachai saahib sun naanak kee aradhaasaa ||2||17||45||
verses.translation: The True Lord has heard Nanak's prayer, and He has forgiven everything. ||2||17||45||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਖਸਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਰੋਗ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: bakhasiaa paarabraham paramesar sagale rog bidhaare ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, has forgiven me, and all diseases have been cured.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ਉਬਰੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur poore kee saranee ubare kaaraj sagal savaare ||1||
verses.translation: Those who come to the Sanctuary of the True Guru are saved, and all their affairs are resolved. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨਿ ਸਿਮਰਿਆ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har jan simariaa naam adhaar ||
verses.translation: The Lord's humble servant meditates in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; this is his only support.

verses.original: ਤਾਪੁ ਉਤਾਰਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: taap utaariaa satigur poorai apanee kirapaa dhaar || rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Perfect True Guru extended His Mercy, and the fever has been dispelled. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਕਰਹ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa ana(n)dh kareh mere piaare har govidh gur raakhiaa ||
verses.translation: So celebrate and be happy, my beloveds - the Guru has saved Hargobind.

verses.original: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਤਿ ਭਾਖਿਆ ॥੨॥੧੮॥੪੬॥
verses.translit: vaddee vaddiaaiee naanak karate kee saach sabadh sat bhaakhiaa ||2||18||46||
verses.translation: Great is the glorious greatness of the Creator, O Nanak; True is the Word of His Shabad, and True is the sermon of His Teachings. ||2||18||46||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhe kirapaal suaamee mere tit saachai dharabaar ||
verses.translation: My Lord and Master has become Merciful, in His True Court.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਤਾਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਠਾਂਢਿ ਪਈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: satigur taap gavaiaa bhaiee Thaa(n)dd piee sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has taken away the fever, and the whole world is at peace, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਅਪਣੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖੇ ਜਮਹਿ ਕੀਓ ਹਟਤਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: apane jeea ja(n)t aape raakhe jameh keeo haTataar ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself protects His beings and creatures, and the Messenger of Death is out of work. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਰਿਦੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har ke charan ridhai ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: Enshrine the Lord's feet within your heart.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਦੁਖ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa prabh simareeaai bhaiee dhukh kilabikh kaaTanahaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, meditate in remembrance on God, O Siblings of Destiny. He is the Eradicator of suffering and sins. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ਊਬਰੈ ਭਾਈ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: tis kee saranee uoobarai bhaiee jin rachiaa sabh koi ||
verses.translation: He fashioned all beings, O Siblings of Destiny, and His Sanctuary saves them.

verses.original: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸੋ ਭਾਈ ਸਚੈ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: karan kaaran samarath so bhaiee sachai sachee soi ||
verses.translation: He is the Almighty Creator, the Cause of causes, O Siblings of Destiny; He, the True Lord, is True.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਭਾਈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥੧੯॥੪੭॥
verses.translit: naanak prabhoo dhiaaieeaai bhaiee man tan seetal hoi ||2||19||47||
verses.translation: Nanak: meditate on God, O Siblings of Destiny, and your mind and body shall be cool and calm. ||2||19||47||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tahu har har naam dhiaaiee ||
verses.translation: O Saints, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਵਿਸਰਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਅੜਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sukh saagar prabh visarau naahee man chi(n)dhiaRaa fal paiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Never forget God, the ocean of peace; thus you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਤਾਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: satigur poorai taap gavaiaa apanee kirapaa dhaaree ||
verses.translation: Extending His Mercy, the Perfect True Guru has dispelled the fever.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਸਭ ਪਰਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: paarabraham prabh bhe dhiaalaa dhukh miTiaa sabh paravaaree ||1||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God has become kind and compassionate, and my whole family is now free of pain and suffering. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਮੰਗਲ ਰਸ ਰੂਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: sarab nidhaan ma(n)gal ras roopaa har kaa naam adhaaro ||
verses.translation: The Treasure of absolute joy, sublime elixir and beauty, the Name of the Lord is my only Support.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਉਧਰਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥੨॥੨੦॥੪੮॥
verses.translit: naanak pat raakhee paramesar udhariaa sabh sa(n)saaro ||2||20||48||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Transcendent Lord has preserved my honor, and saved the whole world. ||2||20||48||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਹੋਆ ॥
verses.translit: meraa satigur rakhavaalaa hoaa ||
verses.translation: My True Guru is my Savior and Protector.

verses.original: ਧਾਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਾਥ ਦੇ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਨਵਾ ਨਿਰੋਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhaar kirapaa prabh haath dhe raakhiaa har govidh navaa niroaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Showering us with His Mercy and Grace, God extended His Hand, and saved Hargobind, who is now safe and secure. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਾਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਲਾਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: taap giaa prabh aap miTaiaa jan kee laaj rakhaiee ||
verses.translation: The fever is gone - God Himself eradicated it, and preserved the honor of His servant.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਂਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat te sabh fal paae satigur kai bal jaa(n)iee ||1||
verses.translation: I have obtained all blessings from the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; I am a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੋਵੈ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਹਮਰਾ ਗੁਣੁ ਅਵਗੁਣੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: halat palat prabh dhovai savaare hamaraa gun avagun na beechaariaa ||
verses.translation: God has saved me, both here and hereafter. He has not taken my merits and demerits into account.

verses.original: ਅਟਲ ਬਚਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਫਲ ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੨॥੨੧॥੪੯॥
verses.translit: aTal bachan naanak gur teraa safal kar masatak dhaariaa ||2||21||49||
verses.translation: Your Word is eternal, O Guru Nanak; You placed Your Hand of blessing upon my forehead. ||2||21||49||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਕੀਏ ਸੋਈ ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)tr sabh tis ke ke'ee soiee sa(n)t sahaiee ||
verses.translation: All beings and creatures were created by Him; He alone is the support and friend of the Saints.

verses.original: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਈ ਬਡਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: apune sevak kee aape raakhai pooran bhiee baddaiee ||1||
verses.translation: He Himself preserves the honor of His servants; their glorious greatness becomes perfect. ||1||

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham pooraa merai naal ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Supreme Lord God is always with me.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰੀ ਸਭ ਰਾਖੀ ਹੋਏ ਸਰਬ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai pooree sabh raakhee hoe sarab dhiaal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has perfectly and totally protected me, and now everyone is kind and compassionate to me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin naanak naam dhiaae jeea praan kaa dhaataa ||
verses.translation: Night and day, Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He is the Giver of the soul, and the breath of life itself.

verses.original: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਰਾਖੈ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਪਿਤ ਮਾਤਾ ॥੨॥੨੨॥੫੦॥
verses.translit: apune dhaas kau ka(n)Th lai raakhai jiau baarik pit maataa ||2||22||50||
verses.translation: He hugs His slave close in His loving embrace, like the mother and father hug their child. ||2||22||50||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ਚਉਪਦੇ
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ghar teejaa chaupadhe
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla, Third House, Chau-Padhay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਪੰਚਹੁ ਨਹੀ ਸਹਸਾ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: mil pa(n)chahu nahee sahasaa chukaiaa ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the council, my doubts were not dispelled.

verses.original: ਸਿਕਦਾਰਹੁ ਨਹ ਪਤੀਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sikadhaarahu neh pateeaaiaa ||
verses.translation: The chiefs did not give me satisfaction.

verses.original: ਉਮਰਾਵਹੁ ਆਗੈ ਝੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: aumaraavahu aagai jheraa ||
verses.translation: I presented my dispute to the noblemen as well.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਰਾਜਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mil raajan raam niberaa ||1||
verses.translation: But it was only settled by meeting with the King, my Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਬ ਢੂਢਨ ਕਤਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ab ddooddan katahu na jaiee ||
verses.translation: Now, I do not go searching anywhere else,

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿਦ ਭੇਟੇ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਸਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gobidh bheTe gur gosaiee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: because I have met the Guru, the Lord of the Universe. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: aaiaa prabh dharabaaraa ||
verses.translation: When I came to God's Darbaar, His Holy Court,

verses.original: ਤਾ ਸਗਲੀ ਮਿਟੀ ਪੂਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: taa sagalee miTee pookaaraa ||
verses.translation: then all of my cries and complaints were settled.

verses.original: ਲਬਧਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: labadh aapanee paiee ||
verses.translation: Now that I have attained what I had sought,

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕਤ ਆਵੈ ਕਤ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: taa kat aavai kat jaiee ||2||
verses.translation: where should I come and where should I go? ||2||

verses.original: ਤਹ ਸਾਚ ਨਿਆਇ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: teh saach niaai niberaa ||
verses.translation: There, true justice is administered.

verses.original: ਊਹਾ ਸਮ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਮ ਚੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: uoohaa sam Thaakur sam cheraa ||
verses.translation: There, the Lord Master and His disciple are one and the same.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tarajaamee jaanai ||
verses.translation: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, knows.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੋਲਤ ਆਪਿ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bin bolat aap pachhaanai ||3||
verses.translation: Without our speaking, He understands. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਥਾਨ ਕੋ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: sarab thaan ko raajaa ||
verses.translation: He is the King of all places.

verses.original: ਤਹ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਅਗਾਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: teh anahadh sabadh agaajaa ||
verses.translation: There, the unstruck melody of the Shabad resounds.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: tis peh kiaa chaturaiee ||
verses.translation: Of what use is cleverness when dealing with Him?

verses.original: ਮਿਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੫੧॥
verses.translit: mil naanak aap gavaiee ||4||1||51||
verses.translation: Meeting with Him, O Nanak, one loses his self-conceit. ||4||1||51||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: hiradhai naam vasaih ||
verses.translation: Enshrine the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within your heart;

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਧਿਆਇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: ghar baiThe guroo dhiaaih ||
verses.translation: sitting within your own home, meditate on the Guru.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਚੁ ਕਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai sach kahiaa ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has spoken the Truth;

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਲਹਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: so sukh saachaa lahiaa ||1||
verses.translation: the True Peace is obtained only from the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਪੁਨਾ ਹੋਇਓ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: apunaa hoio gur miharavaanaa ||
verses.translation: My Guru has become merciful.

verses.original: ਅਨਦ ਸੂਖ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਮੰਗਲ ਸਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਕਰਿ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: anadh sookh kaliaan ma(n)gal siau ghar aae kar isanaanaa || rahaau ||
verses.translation: In bliss, peace, pleasure and joy, I have returned to my own home, after my purifying bath. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਚੀ ਗੁਰ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: saachee gur vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: True is the glorious greatness of the Guru;

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: taa kee keemat kahan na jaiee ||
verses.translation: His worth cannot be described.

verses.original: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: sir saahaa paatisaahaa ||
verses.translation: He is the Supreme Overlord of kings.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਤ ਮਨਿ ਓਮਾਹਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur bheTat man omaahaa ||2||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Guru, the mind is enraptured. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਪਰਾਛਤ ਲਾਥੇ ॥
verses.translit: sagal paraachhat laathe ||
verses.translation: All sins are washed away,

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਸਾਥੇ ॥
verses.translit: mil saadhasa(n)gat kai saathe ||
verses.translation: meeting with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: gun nidhaan har naamaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is the treasure of excellence;

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਏ ਕਾਮਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jap pooran hoe kaamaa ||3||
verses.translation: chanting it, one's affairs are perfectly resolved. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur keeno mukat dhuaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Guru has opened the door of liberation,

verses.original: ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਰੈ ਜੈਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh sirasaT karai jaikaaraa ||
verses.translation: and the entire world applauds Him with cheers of victory.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਸਾਥੇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak prabh merai saathe ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, God is always with me;

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭੈ ਲਾਥੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੫੨॥
verses.translit: janam maran bhai laathe ||4||2||52||
verses.translation: my fears of birth and death are gone. ||4||2||52||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai kirapaa dhaaree ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has granted His Grace,

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਲੋਚ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: prabh pooree loch hamaaree ||
verses.translation: and God has fulfilled my desire.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: kar isanaan gireh aae ||
verses.translation: After taking my bath of purification, I returned to my home,

verses.original: ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anadh ma(n)gal sukh paae ||1||
verses.translation: and I found bliss, happiness and peace. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tahu raam naam nisatareeaai ||
verses.translation: O Saints, salvation comes from the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕਰੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: uooThat baiThat har har dhiaaieeaai anadhin sukirat kareeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: While standing up and sitting down, meditate on the Lord's Name. Night and day, do good deeds. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਧਰਮ ਕੀ ਪਉੜੀ ਕੋ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t kaa maarag dharam kee pauRee ko vaddabhaagee paae ||
verses.translation: The way of the Saints is the ladder of righteous living, found only by great good fortune.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਨਾਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: koT janam ke kilabikh naase har charanee chit laae ||2||
verses.translation: The sins of millions of incarnations are washed away, by focusing your consciousness on the Lord's feet. ||2||

verses.original: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਕਲ ਰਾਖੀ ॥
verses.translit: ausatat karahu sadhaa prabh apane jin pooree kal raakhee ||
verses.translation: So sing the Praises of your God forever; His almighty power is perfect.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਭਏ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਖੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t sabh bhe pavitraa satigur kee sach saakhee ||3||
verses.translation: All beings and creatures are purified, listening to the True Teachings of the True Guru. ||3||

verses.original: ਬਿਘਨ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਨਾਸਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bighan binaasan sabh dhukh naasan satigur naam dhiraRaiaa ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me; it is the Eliminator of obstructions, the Destroyer of all pains.

verses.original: ਖੋਏ ਪਾਪ ਭਏ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਵਨ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੫੩॥
verses.translit: khoe paap bhe sabh paavan jan naanak sukh ghar aaiaa ||4||3||53||
verses.translation: All of my sins were erased, and I have been purified; servant Nanak has returned to his home of peace. ||4||3||53||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਗੁਨੀ ਗਹੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: saahib gunee gaheraa ||
verses.translation: O Lord Master, You are the ocean of excellence.

verses.original: ਘਰੁ ਲਸਕਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: ghar lasakar sabh teraa ||
verses.translation: My home and all my possessions are Yours.

verses.original: ਰਖਵਾਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: rakhavaale gur gopaalaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru, the Lord of the world, is my Savior.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sabh jeea bhe dhiaalaa ||1||
verses.translation: All beings have become kind and compassionate to me. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਅਨਦਿ ਰਹਉ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: jap anadh rahau gur charanaa ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Guru's feet, I am in bliss.

verses.original: ਭਉ ਕਤਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhau kateh nahee prabh saranaa || rahaau ||
verses.translation: There is no fear at all, in God's Sanctuary. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੇਰਿਆ ਦਾਸਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: teriaa dhaasaa ridhai muraaree ||
verses.translation: You dwell in the hearts of Your slaves, Lord.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਬਿਚਲ ਨੀਵ ਉਸਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: prabh abichal neev usaaree ||
verses.translation: God has laid the eternal foundation.

verses.original: ਬਲੁ ਧਨੁ ਤਕੀਆ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: bal dhan takeeaa teraa ||
verses.translation: You are my strength, wealth and support.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਭਾਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: too bhaaro Thaakur meraa ||2||
verses.translation: You are my Almighty Lord and Master. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin jin saadhasa(n)g paiaa ||
verses.translation: Whoever finds the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: so prabh aap taraiaa ||
verses.translation: is saved by God Himself.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਦੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa naam ras dheeaa ||
verses.translation: By His Grace, He has blessed me with the sublime essence of the Naam.

verses.original: ਕੁਸਲ ਖੇਮ ਸਭ ਥੀਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kusal khem sabh theeaa ||3||
verses.translation: All joy and pleasure then came to me. ||3||

verses.original: ਹੋਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: hoe prabhoo sahaiee ||
verses.translation: God became my helper and my best friend;

verses.original: ਸਭ ਉਠਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh uTh laagee paiee ||
verses.translation: everyone rises up and bows down at my feet.

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: saas saas prabh dhiaaieeaai ||
verses.translation: With each and every breath, meditate on God;

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੪॥੫੪॥
verses.translit: har ma(n)gal naanak gaieeaai ||4||4||54||
verses.translation: O Nanak, sing the songs of joy to the Lord. ||4||4||54||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: sookh sahaj aana(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: Celestial peace and bliss have come,

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: prabh milio man bhaava(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: meeting God, who is so pleasing to my mind.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: poorai gur kirapaa dhaaree ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru showered me with His Mercy,

verses.original: ਤਾ ਗਤਿ ਭਈ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: taa gat bhiee hamaaree ||1||
verses.translation: and I attained salvation. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: har kee prem bhagat man leenaa ||
verses.translation: My mind is absorbed in loving devotional worship of the Lord,

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਬਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਤ ਬੀਨਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: nit baaje anahat beenaa || rahaau ||
verses.translation: and the unstruck melody of the celestial sound current ever resounds within me. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਸਤਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: har charan kee oT sataanee ||
verses.translation: The Lord's feet are my all-powerful shelter and support;

verses.original: ਸਭ ਚੂਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ਲੋਕਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: sabh chookee kaan lokaanee ||
verses.translation: my dependence on other people is totally finished.

verses.original: ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jagajeevan dhaataa paiaa ||
verses.translation: I have found the Life of the world, the Great Giver;

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har rasak rasak gun gaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: in joyful rapture, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਫਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kaaTiaa jam kaa faasaa ||
verses.translation: God has cut away the noose of death.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: man pooran hoiee aasaa ||
verses.translation: My mind's desires have been fulfilled;

verses.original: ਜਹ ਪੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jeh pekhaa teh soiee ||
verses.translation: wherever I look, He is there.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har prabh bin avar na koiee ||3||
verses.translation: Without the Lord God, there is no other at all. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa prabh raakhe ||
verses.translation: In His Mercy, God has protected and preserved me.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਦੁਖ ਲਾਥੇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh janam janam dhukh laathe ||
verses.translation: I am rid of all the pains of countless incarnations.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: nirabhau naam dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: I have meditated on the Naam, the Name of the Fearless Lord;

verses.original: ਅਟਲ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੫॥੫੫॥
verses.translit: aTal sukh naanak paiaa ||4||5||55||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I have found eternal peace. ||4||5||55||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਠਾਢਿ ਪਾਈ ਕਰਤਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: Thaadd paiee karataare ||
verses.translation: The Creator has brought utter peace to my home;

verses.original: ਤਾਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਰਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: taap chhodd giaa paravaare ||
verses.translation: the fever has left my family.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹੈ ਰਾਖੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai hai raakhee ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has saved us.

verses.original: ਸਰਣਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਤਾਕੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saran sache kee taakee ||1||
verses.translation: I sought the Sanctuary of the True Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੋਆ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: paramesar aap hoaa rakhavaalaa ||
verses.translation: The Transcendent Lord Himself has become my Protector.

verses.original: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਉਪਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਾਲਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saa(n)t sahaj sukh khin meh upaje man hoaa sadhaa sukhaalaa || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Tranquility, intuitive peace and poise welled up in an instant, and my mind was comforted forever. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਦਾਰੂ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam dheeo dhaaroo ||
verses.translation: The Lord, Har, Har, gave me the medicine of His Name,

verses.original: ਤਿਨਿ ਸਗਲਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਬਿਦਾਰੂ ॥
verses.translit: tin sagalaa rog bidhaaroo ||
verses.translation: which has cured all disease.

verses.original: ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: apanee kirapaa dhaaree ||
verses.translation: He extended His Mercy to me,

verses.original: ਤਿਨਿ ਸਗਲੀ ਬਾਤ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tin sagalee baat savaaree ||2||
verses.translation: and resolved all these affairs. ||2||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: prabh apanaa biradh samaariaa ||
verses.translation: God confirmed His loving nature;

verses.original: ਹਮਰਾ ਗੁਣੁ ਅਵਗੁਣੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: hamaraa gun avagun na beechaariaa ||
verses.translation: He did not take my merits or demerits into account.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਭਇਓ ਸਾਖੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sabadh bhio saakhee ||
verses.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad has become manifest,

verses.original: ਤਿਨਿ ਸਗਲੀ ਲਾਜ ਰਾਖੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tin sagalee laaj raakhee ||3||
verses.translation: and through it, my honor was totally preserved. ||3||

verses.original: ਬੋਲਾਇਆ ਬੋਲੀ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: bolaiaa bolee teraa ||
verses.translation: I speak as You cause me to speak;

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: too saahib gunee gaheraa ||
verses.translation: O Lord and Master, You are the ocean of excellence.

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਖੀ ॥
verses.translit: jap naanak naam sach saakhee ||
verses.translation: Nanak chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, according to the Teachings of Truth.

verses.original: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਾਖੀ ॥੪॥੬॥੫੬॥
verses.translit: apune dhaas kee paij raakhee ||4||6||56||
verses.translation: God preserves the honor of His slaves. ||4||6||56||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਵਿਚਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਖਲੋਆ ॥
verses.translit: vich karataa purakh khaloaa ||
verses.translation: The Creator Lord Himself stood between us,

verses.original: ਵਾਲੁ ਨ ਵਿੰਗਾ ਹੋਆ ॥
verses.translit: vaal na vi(n)gaa hoaa ||
verses.translation: and not a hair upon my head was touched.

verses.original: ਮਜਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਆਂਦਾ ਰਾਸੇ ॥
verses.translit: majan gur aa(n)dhaa raase ||
verses.translation: The Guru made my cleansing bath successful;

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਨਾਸੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jap har har kilavikh naase ||1||
verses.translation: meditating on the Lord, Har, Har, my sins were erased. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਸਰੋਵਰੁ ਨੀਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tahu raamadhaas sarovar neekaa ||
verses.translation: O Saints, the purifying pool of Ram Das is sublime.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕੁਲੁ ਤਰਾਵੈ ਉਧਾਰੁ ਹੋਆ ਹੈ ਜੀ ਕਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo naavai so kul taraavai udhaar hoaa hai jee kaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whoever bathes in it, his family and ancestry are saved, and his soul is saved as well. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਜਗੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jai jai kaar jag gaavai ||
verses.translation: The world sings cheers of victory,

verses.original: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਅੜੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: man chi(n)dhiaRe fal paavai ||
verses.translation: and the fruits of his mind's desires are obtained.

verses.original: ਸਹੀ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਨਾਇ ਆਏ ॥ ਅਪਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sahee salaamat nai aae || apanaa prabhoo dhiaae ||2||
verses.translation: Whoever comes and bathes here, and meditates on his God, is safe and sound. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਨਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t sarovar naavai ||
verses.translation: One who bathes in the healing pool of the Saints,

verses.original: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: so jan param gat paavai ||
verses.translation: that humble being obtains the supreme status.

verses.original: ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: marai na aavai jaiee ||
verses.translation: He does not die, or come and go in reincarnation;

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har har naam dhiaaiee ||3||
verses.translation: he meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਚਾਰੁ ਸੁ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: eih braham bichaaru su jaanai ||
verses.translation: He alone knows this about God,

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਭਗਵਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis dhiaal hoi bhagavaanai ||
verses.translation: whom God blesses with His kindness.

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: baabaa naanak prabh saranaiee ||
verses.translation: Baba Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God;

verses.original: ਸਭ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਗਣਤ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥੪॥੭॥੫੭॥
verses.translit: sabh chi(n)taa ganat miTaiee ||4||7||57||
verses.translation: all his worries and anxieties are dispelled. ||4||7||57||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਨਿਬਾਹੀ ਪੂਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham nibaahee pooree ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God has stood by me and fulfilled me,

verses.original: ਕਾਈ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਰਹੀਆ ਊਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaiee baat na raheeaa uooree ||
verses.translation: and nothing is left unfinished.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਲਾਇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur charan lai nisataare ||
verses.translation: Attached to the Guru's feet, I am saved;

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har har naam sam(h)aare ||1||
verses.translation: I contemplate and cherish the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਪਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਾ ਸਦਾ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: apane dhaas kaa sadhaa rakhavaalaa ||
verses.translation: He is forever the Savior of His slaves.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਜਿਉ ਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa apune kar raakhe maat pitaa jiau paalaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Bestowing His Mercy, He made me His own and preserved me; like a mother or father, He cherishes me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: vaddabhaagee satigur paiaa ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, I found the True Guru,

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin jam kaa pa(n)th miTaiaa ||
verses.translation: who obliterated the path of the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: har bhagat bhai chit laagaa ||
verses.translation: My consciousness is focused on loving, devotional worship of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jap jeeveh se vaddabhaagaa ||2||
verses.translation: One who lives in this meditation is very fortunate indeed. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: har a(n)mirat baanee gaavai ||
verses.translation: He sings the Ambrosial Word of the Guru's Bani,

verses.original: ਸਾਧਾ ਕੀ ਧੂਰੀ ਨਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: saadhaa kee dhooree naavai ||
verses.translation: and bathes in the dust of the feet of the Holy.

verses.original: ਅਪੁਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਪੇ ਦੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: apunaa naam aape dheeaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself bestows His Name.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਣਹਾਰ ਰਖਿ ਲੀਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: prabh karanahaar rakh leeaa ||3||
verses.translation: God, the Creator, saves us. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: har dharasan praan adhaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan is the support of the breath of life.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਬਿਮਲ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: eih pooran bimal beechaaraa ||
verses.translation: This is the perfect, pure wisdom.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa a(n)tarajaamee ||
verses.translation: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, has granted His Mercy;

verses.original: ਦਾਸ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੪॥੮॥੫੮॥
verses.translit: dhaas naanak saran suaamee ||4||8||58||
verses.translation: slave Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of his Lord and Master. ||4||8||58||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਚਰਨੀ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai charanee laiaa ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has attached me to His feet.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har sa(n)g sahaiee paiaa ||
verses.translation: I have obtained the Lord as my companion, my support, my best friend.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਜਾਈਐ ਤਹਾ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: jeh jaieeaai tahaa suhele ||
verses.translation: Wherever I go, I am happy there.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮੇਲੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa prabh mele ||1||
verses.translation: By His Kind Mercy, God united me with Himself. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har gun gaavahu sadhaa subhaiee ||
verses.translation: So sing forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord with loving devotion.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man chi(n)dhe sagale fal paavahu jeea kai sa(n)g sahaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You shall obtain all the fruits of your mind's desires, and the Lord shall become the companion and the support of your soul. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: naarain praan adhaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the support of the breath of life.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਰੇਨਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: ham sa(n)t janaa(n) renaaraa ||
verses.translation: I am the dust of the feet of the Holy people.

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: patit puneet kar leene ||
verses.translation: I am a sinner, but the Lord made me pure.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਦੀਨੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa har jas dheene ||2||
verses.translation: By His Kind Mercy, the Lord blessed me with His Praises. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham kare pratipaalaa ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God cherishes and nurtures me.

verses.original: ਸਦ ਜੀਅ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: sadh jeea sa(n)g rakhavaalaa ||
verses.translation: He is always with me, the Protector of my soul.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: har dhin rain keeratan gaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises day and night,

verses.original: ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bahuR na jonee paieeaai ||3||
verses.translation: I shall not be consigned to reincarnation again. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis dhevai purakh bidhaataa ||
verses.translation: One who is blessed by the Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: har ras tin hee jaataa ||
verses.translation: realizes the subtle essence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਮਕੰਕਰੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jamaka(n)kar neR na aaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death does not come near him.

verses.original: ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੯॥੫੯॥
verses.translit: sukh naanak saranee paiaa ||4||9||59||
verses.translation: In the Lord's Sanctuary, Nanak has found peace. ||4||9||59||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਕੀਤੀ ਪੂਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai keetee pooree ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has made me perfect.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: prabh rav rahiaa bharapooree ||
verses.translation: God is totally pervading and permeating everywhere.

verses.original: ਖੇਮ ਕੁਸਲ ਭਇਆ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: khem kusal bhiaa isanaanaa ||
verses.translation: With joy and pleasure, I take my purifying bath.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: paarabraham viTahu kurabaanaa ||1||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the Supreme Lord God. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਕਵਲ ਰਿਦ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur ke charan kaval ridh dhaare ||
verses.translation: I enshrine the lotus feet of the Guru within my heart.

verses.original: ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਿਲ ਕਾ ਕੋਈ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bighan na laagai til kaa koiee kaaraj sagal savaare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Not even the tiniest obstacle blocks my way; all my affairs are resolved. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਖੋਏ ॥
verses.translit: mil saadhoo dhuramat khoe ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Holy Saints, my evil-mindedness was eradicated.

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਸਭ ਹੋਏ ॥
verses.translit: patit puneet sabh hoe ||
verses.translation: All the sinners are purified.

verses.original: ਰਾਮਦਾਸਿ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਨਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: raamadhaas sarovar naate ||
verses.translation: Bathing in the sacred pool of Guru Ram Das,

verses.original: ਸਭ ਲਾਥੇ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਤੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sabh laathe paap kamaate ||2||
verses.translation: all the sins one has committed are washed away. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: gun gobi(n)dh nit gaieeaai ||
verses.translation: So sing forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe;

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g mil dhiaaieeaai ||
verses.translation: joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate on Him.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: man baa(n)chhat fal paae ||
verses.translation: The fruits of your mind's desires are obtained

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur pooraa ridhai dhiaae ||3||
verses.translation: by meditating on the Perfect Guru within your heart. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਆਨੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur gopaal aana(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru, the Lord of the World, is blissful;

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: jap jap jeevai paramaana(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: chanting, meditating on the Lord of supreme bliss, He lives.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jan naanak naam dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਰਖਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੬੦॥
verses.translit: prabh apanaa biradh rakhaiaa ||4||10||60||
verses.translation: God has confirmed His innate nature. ||4||10||60||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: raag soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਮੇਘ ਘਟਾ ਘਟ ਦਾਮਨਿ ਚਮਕਿ ਡਰਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: dheh dhis chhatr megh ghaTaa ghaT dhaaman chamak ddaraio ||
verses.translation: In the ten directions, the clouds cover the sky like a canopy; through the dark clouds, lightning flashes, and I am terrified.

verses.original: ਸੇਜ ਇਕੇਲੀ ਨੀਦ ਨਹੁ ਨੈਨਹ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਰਦੇਸਿ ਸਿਧਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sej ikelee needh nahu naineh pir paradhes sidhaio ||1||
verses.translation: By bed is empty, and my eyes are sleepless; my Husband Lord has gone far away. ||1||

verses.original: ਹੁਣਿ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਦੇਸਰੋ ਮਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: hun nahee sa(n)dhesaro maio ||
verses.translation: Now, I receive no messages from Him, O mother!

verses.original: ਏਕ ਕੋਸਰੋ ਸਿਧਿ ਕਰਤ ਲਾਲੁ ਤਬ ਚਤੁਰ ਪਾਤਰੋ ਆਇਓ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ek kosaro sidh karat laal tab chatur paataro aaio || rahaau ||
verses.translation: When my Beloved used to go even a mile away, He would send me four letters. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਇਹੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: kiau bisarai ih laal piaaro sarab gunaa sukhadhaio ||
verses.translation: How could I forget this Dear Beloved of mine? He is the Giver of peace, and all virtues.

verses.original: ਮੰਦਰਿ ਚਰਿ ਕੈ ਪੰਥੁ ਨਿਹਾਰਉ ਨੈਨ ਨੀਰਿ ਭਰਿ ਆਇਓ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ma(n)dhar char kai pa(n)th nihaarau nain neer bhar aaio ||2||
verses.translation: Ascending to His Mansion, I gaze upon His path, and my eyes are filled with tears. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਭੀਤਿ ਭਇਓ ਹੈ ਬੀਚੋ ਸੁਨਤ ਦੇਸਿ ਨਿਕਟਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: hau hau bheet bhio hai beecho sunat dhes nikaTaio ||
verses.translation: The wall of egotism and pride separates us, but I can hear Him nearby.

verses.original: ਭਾਂਭੀਰੀ ਕੇ ਪਾਤ ਪਰਦੋ ਬਿਨੁ ਪੇਖੇ ਦੂਰਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bhaa(n)bheeree ke paat paradho bin pekhe dhooraio ||3||
verses.translation: There is a veil between us, like the wings of a butterfly; without being able to see Him, He seems so far away. ||3||

verses.original: ਭਇਓ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਸਰਬ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਗਰੋ ਦੂਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: bhio kirapaal sarab ko Thaakur sagaro dhookh miTaio ||
verses.translation: The Lord and Master of all has become merciful; He has dispelled all my sufferings.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉਮੈ ਭੀਤਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਈ ਤਉ ਦਇਆਰੁ ਬੀਠਲੋ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak haumai bheet gur khoiee tau dhiaar beeThalo paio ||4||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, when the Guru tore down the wall of egotism, then, I found my Merciful Lord and Master. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਰਹਿਓ ਅੰਦੇਸਰੋ ਮਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: sabh rahio a(n)dhesaro maio ||
verses.translation: All my fears have been dispelled, O mother!

verses.original: ਜੋ ਚਾਹਤ ਸੋ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: jo chaahat so guroo milaio ||
verses.translation: Whoever I seek, the Guru leads me to find.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਗੁਨਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਰਾਇਓ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧੧॥੬੧॥
verses.translit: sarab gunaa nidh raio || rahaau dhoojaa ||11||61||
verses.translation: The Lord, our King, is the treasure of all virtue. ||Second Pause||11||61||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗਈ ਬਹੋੜੁ ਬੰਦੀ ਛੋੜੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਦੁਖਦਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: giee bahoR ba(n)dhee chhoR nira(n)kaar dhukhadhaaree ||
verses.translation: The Restorer of what was taken away, the Liberator from captivity; the Formless Lord, the Destroyer of pain.

verses.original: ਕਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਲੋਭੀ ਮਾਇਆਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: karam na jaanaa dharam na jaanaa lobhee maiaadhaaree ||
verses.translation: I do not know about karma and good deeds; I do not know about Dharma and righteous living. I am so greedy, chasing after Maya.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਿਓ ਭਗਤੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਇਹ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪੈਜ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naam pario bhagat govi(n)dh kaa ieh raakhahu paij tumaaree ||1||
verses.translation: I go by the name of God's devotee; please, save this honor of Yours. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਨਿਮਾਣਿਆ ਤੂ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau nimaaniaa too maan ||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord, You are the honor of the dishonored.

verses.original: ਨਿਚੀਜਿਆ ਚੀਜ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: nicheejiaa cheej kare meraa govi(n)dh teree kudharat kau kurabaan || rahaau ||
verses.translation: You make the unworthy ones worthy, O my Lord of the Universe; I am a sacrifice to Your almighty creative power. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੈਸਾ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਈ ਲਖ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaisaa baalak bhai subhaiee lakh aparaadh kamaavai ||
verses.translation: Like the child, innocently making thousands of mistakes

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਝਿੜਕੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: kar upadhes jhiRake bahu bhaatee bahuR pitaa gal laavai ||
verses.translation: his father teaches him, and scolds him so many times, but still, he hugs him close in his embrace.

verses.original: ਪਿਛਲੇ ਅਉਗੁਣ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਗੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: pichhale aaugun bakhas le prabh aagai maarag paavai ||2||
verses.translation: Please forgive my past actions, God, and place me on Your path for the future. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਤਾ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: har a(n)tarajaamee sabh bidh jaanai taa kis peh aakh sunaieeaai ||
verses.translation: The Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, knows all about my state of mind; so who else should I go to and speak to?

verses.original: ਕਹਣੈ ਕਥਨਿ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: kahanai kathan na bheejai gobi(n)dh har bhaavai paij rakhaieeaai ||
verses.translation: The Lord, the Lord of the Universe, is not pleased by mere recitation of words; if it is pleasing to His Will, He preserves our honor.

verses.original: ਅਵਰ ਓਟ ਮੈ ਸਗਲੀ ਦੇਖੀ ਇਕ ਤੇਰੀ ਓਟ ਰਹਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: avar oT mai sagalee dhekhee ik teree oT rahaieeaai ||3||
verses.translation: I have seen all other shelters, but Yours alone remains for me. ||3||

verses.original: ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਣੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: hoi dhiaal kirapaal prabh Thaakur aape sunai bena(n)tee ||
verses.translation: Becoming kind and compassionate, God the Lord and Master Himself listens to my prayer.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: pooraa satagur mel milaavai sabh chookai man kee chi(n)tee ||
verses.translation: He unites me in Union with the Perfect True Guru, and all the cares and anxieties of my mind are dispelled.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਵਖਦੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸੰਤੀ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੬੨॥
verses.translit: har har naam avakhadh mukh paiaa jan naanak sukh vasa(n)tee ||4||12||62||
verses.translation: The Lord, Har, Har, has placed the medicine of the Naam into my mouth; servant Nanak abides in peace. ||4||12||62||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਦੁਖ ਕਲੇਸ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਠੇ ॥
verses.translit: simar simar prabh bhe ana(n)dhaa dhukh kales sabh naaThe ||
verses.translation: Remembering, remembering God in meditation, bliss ensues, and one is rid of all suffering and pain.

verses.original: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਧਿਆਵਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਾਂਠੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gun gaavat dhiaavat prabh apanaa kaaraj sagale saa(n)The ||1||
verses.translation: Singing the Glorious Praises of God, and meditating on Him, all my affairs are brought into harmony. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jagajeevan naam tumaaraa ||
verses.translation: Your Name is the Life of the world.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਦੀਓ ਉਪਦੇਸਾ ਜਪਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur poore dheeo upadhesaa jap bhaujal paar utaaraa || rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has taught me, that by meditating, I cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੂਹੈ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਸੁਨਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੂਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: toohai ma(n)tree suneh prabh toohai sabh kichh karanaihaaraa ||
verses.translation: You are Your own advisor; You hear everything, God, and You do everything.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਇਹੁ ਜੰਤੁ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: too aape dhaataa aape bhugataa kiaa ih ja(n)t vichaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the Giver, and You Yourself are the Enjoyer. What can this poor creature do? ||2||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa gun tere aakh vakhaanee keemat kahan na jaiee ||
verses.translation: Which of Your Glorious Virtues should I describe and speak of? Your value cannot be described.

verses.original: ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਵਡਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: pekh pekh jeevai prabh apanaa acharaj tumeh vaddaiee ||3||
verses.translation: I live by beholding, beholding You, O God. Your glorious greatness is wonderful and amazing! ||3||

verses.original: ਧਾਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ ਪਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਪੂਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhaar anugrahu aap prabh savaiaamee pat mat keenee pooree ||
verses.translation: Granting His Grace, God my Lord and Master Himself saved my honor, and my intellect has been made perfect.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਬਾਛਉ ਸੰਤਾ ਧੂਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੬੩॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa naanak balihaaree baachhau sa(n)taa dhooree ||4||13||63||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, Nanak is a sacrifice, longing for the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||4||13||63||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur pooraa namasakaare ||
verses.translation: I bow in reverence to the Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਭੇ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: prabh sabhe kaaj savaare ||
verses.translation: God has resolved all my affairs.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: har apanee kirapaa dhaaree ||
verses.translation: The Lord has showered me with His Mercy.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: prabh pooran paij savaaree ||1||
verses.translation: God has perfectly preserved my honor. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਪਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੋ ਭਇਓ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: apane dhaas ko bhio sahaiee ||
verses.translation: He has become the help and support of His slave.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਕੀਨੇ ਕਰਤੈ ਊਣੀ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sagal manorath keene karatai uoonee baat na kaiee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Creator has achieved all my goals, and now, nothing is lacking. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਰਤੈ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਤਾਲੁ ਦਿਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: karatai purakh taal dhivaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Creator Lord has caused the pool of nectar to be constructed.

verses.original: ਪਿਛੈ ਲਗਿ ਚਲੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: pichhai lag chalee maiaa ||
verses.translation: The wealth of Maya follows in my footsteps,

verses.original: ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: toT na katahoo aavai ||
verses.translation: and now, nothing is lacking at all.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mere poore satagur bhaavai ||2||
verses.translation: This is pleasing to my Perfect True Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: simar simar dhiaalaa ||
verses.translation: Remembering, remembering the Merciful Lord in meditation,

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh jeea bhe kirapaalaa ||
verses.translation: all beings have become kind and compassionate to me.

verses.original: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jai jai kaar gusaiee ||
verses.translation: Hail! Hail to the Lord of the world,

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jin pooree banat banaiee ||3||
verses.translation: who created the perfect creation. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਭਾਰੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੋਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: too bhaaro suaamee moraa ||
verses.translation: You are my Great Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: eih pu(n)n padhaarath teraa ||
verses.translation: These blessings and wealth are Yours.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jan naanak ek dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has meditated on the One Lord;

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਫਲਾ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੬੪॥
verses.translit: sarab falaa pu(n)n paiaa ||4||14||64||
verses.translation: he has obtained the fruitful rewards for all good deeds. ||4||14||64||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ਦੁਪਦੇ
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ghar teejaa dhupadhe
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla, Third House, Dho-Padhay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਸਰੋਵਰਿ ਨਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: raamadhaas sarovar naate ||
verses.translation: Bathing in the nectar tank of Ram Das,

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh utare paap kamaate ||
verses.translation: all sins are erased.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਏ ਕਰਿ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: niramal hoe kar isanaanaa ||
verses.translation: One becomes immaculately pure, taking this cleansing bath.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਕੀਨੇ ਦਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur poorai keene dhaanaa ||1||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has bestowed this gift. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਕੁਸਲ ਖੇਮ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kusal khem prabh dhaare ||
verses.translation: God has blessed all with peace and pleasure.
