verses.original: ਸਹੀ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਸਭਿ ਥੋਕ ਉਬਾਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sahee salaamat sabh thok ubaare gur kaa sabadh veechaare || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Everything is safe and sound, as we contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਥੀ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g mal laathee ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, filth is washed off.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਭਇਓ ਸਾਥੀ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham bhio saathee ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God has become our friend and helper.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: naanak naam dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥੧॥੬੫॥
verses.translit: aadh purakh prabh paiaa ||2||1||65||
verses.translation: He has found God, the Primal Being. ||2||1||65||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਇਆ ॥ ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਦਯਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jit paarabraham chit aaiaa || so ghar dhay vasaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God has established that home, in which He comes to mind.

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥ ਤਾ ਸਹਸਾ ਸਗਲ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sukh saagar gur paiaa || taa sahasaa sagal miTaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: I found the Guru, the ocean of peace, and all my doubts were dispelled. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: har ke naam kee vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: This is the glorious greatness of the Naam.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar gun gaiee ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing His Glorious Praises.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur poore te paiee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: I obtained this from the Perfect Guru. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kee akath kahaanee ||
verses.translation: God's sermon is inexpressible.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: jan boleh a(n)mirat baanee ||
verses.translation: His humble servants speak words of Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas vakhaanee ||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak has spoken.

verses.translit: gur poore te jaanee ||2||2||66||
verses.translation: Through the Perfect Guru, it is known. ||2||2||66||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਗੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: aagai sukh gur dheeaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru has blessed me with peace here,

verses.original: ਪਾਛੈ ਕੁਸਲ ਖੇਮ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: paachhai kusal khem gur keeaa ||
verses.translation: and the Guru has arranged peace and pleasure for me hereafter.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sarab nidhaan sukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: I have all treasures and comforts,

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur apunaa ridhai dhiaaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: meditating on the Guru in my heart. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਪਨੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: apane satigur kee vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: This is the glorious greatness of my True Guru;

verses.original: ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: man ichhe fal paiee ||
verses.translation: I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires.

verses.original: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tahu dhin dhin chaRai savaiee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: O Saints, His Glory increases day by day. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t sabh bhe dhiaalaa prabh apane kar dheene ||
verses.translation: All beings and creatures have become kind and compassionate to me; my God has made them so.

verses.original: ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਤੀਨੇ ॥੨॥੩॥੬੭॥
verses.translit: sahaj subhai mile gopaalaa naanak saach pateene ||2||3||67||
verses.translation: Nanak has met with the Lord of the world with intuitive ease, and with Truth, he is pleased. ||2||3||67||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਖਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sabadh rakhavaare ||
verses.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is my Saving Grace.

verses.original: ਚਉਕੀ ਚਉਗਿਰਦ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: chaukee chaugiradh hamaare ||
verses.translation: It is a guardian posted on all four sides around me.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam man laagaa ||
verses.translation: My mind is attached to the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਜਮੁ ਲਜਾਇ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jam lajai kar bhaagaa ||1||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death has run away in shame. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੋ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: prabh jee too mero sukhadhaataa ||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord, You are my Giver of peace.

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਕਰੇ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan kaaT kare man niramal pooran purakh bidhaataa || rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Lord, the Architect of Destiny, has shattered my bonds, and made my mind immaculately pure. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: naanak prabh abinaasee ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, God is eternal and imperishable.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: taa kee sev na birathee jaasee ||
verses.translation: Service to Him shall never go unrewarded.

verses.original: ਅਨਦ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: anadh kareh tere dhaasaa ||
verses.translation: Your slaves are in bliss;

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਆਸਾ ॥੨॥੪॥੬੮॥
verses.translit: jap pooran hoiee aasaa ||2||4||68||
verses.translation: chanting and meditating, their desires are fulfilled. ||2||4||68||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur apune balihaaree ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to my Guru.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jin pooran paij savaaree ||
verses.translation: He has totally preserved my honor.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: man chi(n)dhiaa fal paiaa ||
verses.translation: I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: prabh apunaa sadhaa dhiaaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: I meditate forever on my God. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tahu tis bin avar na koiee ||
verses.translation: O Saints, without Him, there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: karan kaaran prabh soiee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: He is God, the Cause of causes. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਵਰ ਦੀਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: prabh apanai var dheene ||
verses.translation: My God has given me His Blessing.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਜੀਅ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: sagal jeea vas keene ||
verses.translation: He has made all creatures subject to me.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jan naanak naam dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord,

verses.original: ਤਾ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥੨॥੫॥੬੯॥
verses.translit: taa sagale dhookh miTaiaa ||2||5||69||
verses.translation: and all his sorrows depart. ||2||5||69||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤਾਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: taap gavaiaa gur poore ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has dispelled the fever.

verses.original: ਵਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਤੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: vaaje anahadh toore ||
verses.translation: The unstruck melody of the sound current resounds.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: sarab kaliaan prabh keene ||
verses.translation: God has bestowed all comforts.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਦੀਨੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa aap dheene ||1||
verses.translation: In His Mercy, He Himself has given them. ||1||

verses.original: ਬੇਦਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bedhan satigur aap gavaiee ||
verses.translation: The True Guru Himself has eradicated the disease.

verses.original: ਸਿਖ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸਰਸੇ ਹੋਏ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sikh sa(n)t sabh sarase hoe har har naam dhiaaiee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: All the Sikhs and Saints are filled with joy, meditating on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਸੋ ਲੇਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jo ma(n)geh so leveh ||
verses.translation: They obtain that which they ask for.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਣਿਆ ਸੰਤਾ ਦੇਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: prabh apaniaa sa(n)taa dheveh ||
verses.translation: God gives to His Saints.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: har govidh prabh raakhiaa ||
verses.translation: God saved Hargobind.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੁ ਸੁਭਾਖਿਆ ॥੨॥੬॥੭੦॥
verses.translit: jan naanak saach subhaakhiaa ||2||6||70||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak speaks the Truth. ||2||6||70||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਕਰਾਇ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: soiee karai jo tudh bhaavai ||
verses.translation: You make me do what pleases You.

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: moh siaanap kachhoo na aavai ||
verses.translation: I have no cleverness at all.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤਉ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ham baarik tau saranaiee ||
verses.translation: I am just a child - I seek Your Protection.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: prabh aape paij rakhaiee ||1||
verses.translation: God Himself preserves my honor. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: meraa maat pitaa har raiaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord is my King; He is my mother and father.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਣ ਲਾਗਾ ਕਰਂੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa pratipaalan laagaa kara(n)ee teraa karaiaa || rahaau ||
verses.translation: In Your Mercy, You cherish me; I do whatever You make me do. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t tere dhaare ||
verses.translation: The beings and creatures are Your creation.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਡੋਰੀ ਹਾਥਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: prabh ddoree haath tumaare ||
verses.translation: O God, their reins are in Your hands.

verses.original: ਜਿ ਕਰਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: j karaavai so karanaa ||
verses.translation: Whatever You cause us to do, we do.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾ ॥੨॥੭॥੭੧॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas teree saranaa ||2||7||71||
verses.translation: Nanak, Your slave, seeks Your Protection. ||2||7||71||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਪਰੋਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har naam ridhai paroiaa ||
verses.translation: I have woven the Lord's Name into the fabric of my heart.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਾਜੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਹੋਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kaaj hamaaraa hoiaa ||
verses.translation: All my affairs are resolved.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: prabh charanee man laagaa ||
verses.translation: His mind is attached to God's feet,

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: pooran jaa ke bhaagaa ||1||
verses.translation: whose destiny is perfect. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: mil saadhasa(n)g har dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I meditate on the Lord.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਅਰਾਧਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar araadhio har har man chi(n)dhiaa fal paiaa || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, I worship and adore the Lord, Har, Har; I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਪਰਾ ਪੂਰਬਲਾ ਅੰਕੁਰੁ ਜਾਗਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: paraa poorabalaa a(n)kur jaagiaa ||
verses.translation: The seeds of my past actions have sprouted.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam man laagiaa ||
verses.translation: My mind is attached to the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: man tan har dharas samaavai ||
verses.translation: My mind and body are absorbed into the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੮॥੭੨॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas sache gun gaavai ||2||8||72||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. ||2||8||72||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਚਿਤਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur mil prabhoo chitaariaa ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Guru, I contemplate God.

verses.original: ਕਾਰਜ ਸਭਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: kaaraj sabh savaariaa ||
verses.translation: All of my affairs have been resolved.

verses.original: ਮੰਦਾ ਕੋ ਨ ਅਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)dhaa ko na alaae ||
verses.translation: No one speaks ill of me.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sabh jai jai kaar sunaae ||1||
verses.translation: Everyone congratulates me on my victory. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tahu saachee saran suaamee ||
verses.translation: O Saints, I seek the True Sanctuary of the Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਹਾਥਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਕੈ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t sabh haath tisai kai so prabh a(n)tarajaamee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: All beings and creatures are in His hands; He is God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਰਤਬ ਸਭਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: karatab sabh savaare ||
verses.translation: He has resolved all of my affairs.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਮਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: prabh apunaa biradh samaare ||
verses.translation: God has confirmed His innate nature.

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: patit paavan prabh naamaa ||
verses.translation: God's Name is the Purifier of sinners.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾ ॥੨॥੯॥੭੩॥
verses.translit: jan naanak sadh kurabaanaa ||2||9||73||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||9||73||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham saaj savaariaa ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God created and embellished him.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਲਹੁੜਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਉਬਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: eih lahuRaa guroo ubaariaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru has saved this small child.

verses.original: ਅਨਦ ਕਰਹੁ ਪਿਤ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: anadh karahu pit maataa ||
verses.translation: So celebrate and be happy, father and mother.

verses.original: ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: paramesar jeea kaa dhaataa ||1||
verses.translation: The Transcendent Lord is the Giver of souls. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਭ ਚਿਤਵਨਿ ਦਾਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: subh chitavan dhaas tumaare ||
verses.translation: Your slaves, O Lord, focus on pure thoughts.

verses.original: ਰਾਖਹਿ ਪੈਜ ਦਾਸ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਕਾਰਜ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raakheh paij dhaas apune kee kaaraj aap savaare || rahaau ||
verses.translation: You preserve the honor of Your slaves, and You Yourself arrange their affairs. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: meraa prabh paraupakaaree ||
verses.translation: My God is so benevolent.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਕਲ ਜਿਨਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: pooran kal jin dhaaree ||
verses.translation: His Almighty Power is manifest.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: naanak saranee aaiaa ||
verses.translation: Nanak has come to His Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੭੪॥
verses.translit: man chi(n)dhiaa fal paiaa ||2||10||74||
verses.translation: He has obtained the fruits of his mind's desires. ||2||10||74||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa har jaape ||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, I chant the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਾਲਕ ਰਾਖੇ ਆਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: prabh baalak raakhe aape ||
verses.translation: God Himself has saved my child.

verses.original: ਸੀਤਲਾ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: seetalaa Thaak rahaiee ||
verses.translation: He healed him from the smallpox.

verses.original: ਬਿਘਨ ਗਏ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bighan ge har naiee ||1||
verses.translation: My troubles have been removed through the Lord's Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: meraa prabh hoaa sadhaa dhiaalaa ||
verses.translation: My God is forever Merciful.

verses.original: ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਜੀਅ ਭਇਆ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aradhaas sunee bhagat apune kee sabh jeea bhiaa kirapaalaa || rahaau ||
verses.translation: He heard the prayer of His devotee, and now all beings are kind and compassionate to him. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਾਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: prabh karan kaaran samaraathaa ||
verses.translation: God is Almighty, the Cause of causes.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: har simarat sabh dhukh laathaa ||
verses.translation: Remembering the Lord in meditation, all pains and sorrows vanish.

verses.original: ਅਪਣੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਸੁਣੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: apane dhaas kee sunee bena(n)tee ||
verses.translation: He has heard the prayer of His slave.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਵੰਤੀ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੭੫॥
verses.translit: sabh naanak sukh sava(n)tee ||2||11||75||
verses.translation: O Nanak, now everyone sleeps in peace. ||2||11||75||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਪਨਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: apanaa guroo dhiaae ||
verses.translation: I meditated on my Guru.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਕੁਸਲ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: mil kusal setee ghar aae ||
verses.translation: I met with Him, and returned home in joy.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੈ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: naamai kee vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: This is the glorious greatness of the Naam.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tis keemat kahan na jaiee ||1||
verses.translation: Its value cannot be estimated. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tahu har har har aaraadhahu ||
verses.translation: O Saints, worship and adore the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਿ ਸਭੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਾਧਹੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har aaraadh sabho kichh paieeaai kaaraj sagale saadhahu || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Worship the Lord in adoration, and you shall obtain everything; your affairs shall all be resolved. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: prem bhagat prabh laagee ||
verses.translation: He alone is attached in loving devotion to God,

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: so paae jis vaddabhaagee ||
verses.translation: who realizes his great destiny.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jan naanak naam dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਤਿਨਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੭੬॥
verses.translit: tin sarab sukhaa fal paiaa ||2||12||76||
verses.translation: He obtains the rewards of all joys and peace. ||2||12||76||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਬੰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: paramesar dhitaa ba(n)naa ||
verses.translation: The Transcendent Lord has given me His support.

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਰੋਗ ਕਾ ਡੇਰਾ ਭੰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh rog kaa dderaa bha(n)naa ||
verses.translation: The house of pain and disease has been demolished.

verses.original: ਅਨਦ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਰ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: anadh kareh nar naaree ||
verses.translation: The men and women celebrate.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har har prabh kirapaa dhaaree ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord God, Har, Har, has extended His Mercy. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tahu sukh hoaa sabh thaiee ||
verses.translation: O Saints, there is peace everywhere.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭਨੀ ਜਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham pooran paramesar rav rahiaa sabhanee jaiee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God, the Perfect Transcendent Lord, is pervading everywhere. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhur kee baanee aaiee ||
verses.translation: The Bani of His Word emanated from the Primal Lord.

verses.original: ਤਿਨਿ ਸਗਲੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: tin sagalee chi(n)t miTaiee ||
verses.translation: It eradicates all anxiety.

verses.original: ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhiaal purakh miharavaanaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord is merciful, kind and compassionate.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਖਾਨਾ ॥੨॥੧੩॥੭੭॥
verses.translit: har naanak saach vakhaanaa ||2||13||77||
verses.translation: Nanak chants the Naam, the Name of the True Lord. ||2||13||77||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: aaithai othai rakhavaalaa ||
verses.translation: Here and hereafter, He is our Savior.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: prabh satigur dheen dhiaalaa ||
verses.translation: God, the True Guru, is Merciful to the meek.

verses.original: ਦਾਸ ਅਪਨੇ ਆਪਿ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhaas apane aap raakhe ||
verses.translation: He Himself protects His slaves.

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਭਾਖੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT sabadh subhaakhe ||1||
verses.translation: In each and every heart, the Beautiful Word of His Shabad resounds. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਊਪਰਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur ke charan uoopar bal jaiee ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the Guru's Feet.

verses.original: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਲੀ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhinas rain saas saas samaalee pooran sabhanee thaiee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Day and night, with each and every breath, I remember Him; He is totally pervading and permeating all places. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਹੋਆ ॥
verses.translit: aap sahaiee hoaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself has become my help and support.

verses.original: ਸਚੇ ਦਾ ਸਚਾ ਢੋਆ ॥
verses.translit: sache dhaa sachaa ddoaa ||
verses.translation: True is the support of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: teree bhagat vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: Glorious and great is devotional worship to You.

verses.original: ਪਾਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥੧੪॥੭੮॥
verses.translit: paiee naanak prabh saranaiee ||2||14||78||
verses.translation: Nanak has found God's Sanctuary. ||2||14||78||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: satigur poore bhaanaa ||
verses.translation: When it was pleasing to the Perfect True Guru,

verses.original: ਤਾ ਜਪਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਮਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: taa japiaa naam ramaanaa ||
verses.translation: then I chanted the Naam, the Name of the Pervading Lord.

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: gobi(n)dh kirapaa dhaaree ||
verses.translation: The Lord of the Universe extended His Mercy to me,

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਪੈਜ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: prabh raakhee paij hamaaree ||1||
verses.translation: and God saved my honor. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har ke charan sadhaa sukhadhaiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord's feet are forever peace-giving.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਇਛਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਆਸ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo ichheh soiee fal paaveh birathee aas na jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whatever fruit one desires, he receives; his hopes shall not go in vain. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੋਈ ਸੰਤੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: kirapaa kare jis praanapat dhaataa soiee sa(n)t gun gaavai ||
verses.translation: That Saint, unto whom the Lord of Life, the Great Giver, extends His Mercy - he alone sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਣਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: prem bhagat taa kaa man leenaa paarabraham man bhaavai ||2||
verses.translation: His soul is absorbed in loving devotional worship; his mind is pleasing to the Supreme Lord God. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਜਸੁ ਰਵਣਾ ਬਿਖੈ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਲਾਥੀ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar har kaa jas ravanaa bikhai Thagauree laathee ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, he chants the Praises of the Lord, and the bitter poison does not affect him.

verses.original: ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਲੀਆ ਮੇਰੈ ਕਰਤੈ ਸੰਤ ਸਾਧ ਭਏ ਸਾਥੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sa(n)g milai leeaa merai karatai sa(n)t saadh bhe saathee ||3||
verses.translation: My Creator Lord has united me with Himself, and the Holy Saints have become my companions. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਦੀਨੇ ਆਪਹਿ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kar geh leene sarabas dheene aapeh aap milaiaa ||
verses.translation: Taking me by the hand, He has given me everything, and blended me with Himself.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਬ ਥੋਕ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੭੯॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak sarab thok pooran pooraa satigur paiaa ||4||15||79||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, everything has been perfectly resolved; I have found the Perfect True Guru. ||4||15||79||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗਰੀਬੀ ਗਦਾ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: gareebee gadhaa hamaaree ||
verses.translation: Humility is my spiked club.

verses.original: ਖੰਨਾ ਸਗਲ ਰੇਨੁ ਛਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kha(n)naa sagal ren chhaaree ||
verses.translation: My dagger is to be the dust of all men's feet.

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕੋ ਨ ਟਿਕੈ ਵੇਕਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: eis aagai ko na Tikai vekaaree ||
verses.translation: No evil-doer can withstand these weapons.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਏਹ ਗਲ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur poore eh gal saaree ||1||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has given me this understanding. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਓਟਾ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam sa(n)tan kee oTaa ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the support and shelter of the Saints.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਉਧਰਹਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੋਟਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo simarai tis kee gat hovai udhareh sagale koTaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: One who remembers the Lord in meditation, is emancipated; millions have been saved in this way. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t sa(n)g jas gaiaa ||
verses.translation: In the Society of the Saints, I sing His Praises.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: eih pooran har dhan paiaa ||
verses.translation: I have found this, the perfect wealth of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak aap miTaiaa ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I have eradicated my self-conceit.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥੧੬॥੮੦॥
verses.translit: sabh paarabraham nadharee aaiaa ||2||16||80||
verses.translation: I see the Supreme Lord God everywhere. ||2||16||80||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰੀ ਕੀਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai pooree keenee ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has done it perfectly.

verses.original: ਬਖਸ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: bakhas apunee kar dheenee ||
verses.translation: He blessed me with forgiveness.

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਅਨੰਦ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: nit ana(n)dh sukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: I have found lasting peace and bliss.

verses.original: ਥਾਵ ਸਗਲੇ ਸੁਖੀ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: thaav sagale sukhee vasaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: Everywhere, the people dwell in peace. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਫਲ ਦਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: har kee bhagat fal dhaatee ||
verses.translation: Devotional worship to the Lord is what gives rewards.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਜਾਤੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai kirapaa kar dheenee viralai kin hee jaatee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru, by His Grace, gave it to me; how rare are those who know this. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਗਾਵਹ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gurbaanee gaaveh bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Sing the Word of the Guru's Bani, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਓਹ ਸਫਲ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: oh safal sadhaa sukhadhaiee ||
verses.translation: That is always rewarding and peace-giving.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: naanak naam dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: Nanak has meditated on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.translit: poorab likhiaa paiaa ||2||17||81||
verses.translation: He has realized his pre-ordained destiny. ||2||17||81||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਰਾਧੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur pooraa aaraadhe ||
verses.translation: I worship and adore the Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਾਧੇ ॥
verses.translit: kaaraj sagale saadhe ||
verses.translation: All my affairs have been resolved.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sagal manorath poore ||
verses.translation: All desires have been fulfilled.

verses.original: ਬਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਤੂਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: baaje anahadh toore ||1||
verses.translation: The unstruck melody of the sound current resounds. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tahu raam japat sukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: O Saints, meditating on the Lord, we obtain peace.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਅਸਥਾਨਿ ਬਸੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t asathaan base sukh sahaje sagale dhookh miTaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In the home of the Saints, celestial peace is pervading; all pain and suffering is dispelled. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur poore kee baanee ||
verses.translation: The Word of the Perfect Guru's Bani

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham man bhaanee ||
verses.translation: is pleasing to the Mind of the Supreme Lord God.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas vakhaanee ||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak speaks

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥੨॥੧੮॥੮੨॥
verses.translit: niramal akath kahaanee ||2||18||82||
verses.translation: the Unspoken, immaculate sermon of the Lord. ||2||18||82||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਭੂਖੇ ਖਾਵਤ ਲਾਜ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: bhookhe khaavat laaj na aavai ||
verses.translation: The hungry man is not ashamed to eat.

verses.original: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tiau har jan har gun gaavai ||1||
verses.translation: Just so, the humble servant of the Lord sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਪਨੇ ਕਾਜ ਕਉ ਕਿਉ ਅਲਕਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: apane kaaj kau kiau alakaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Why are you so lazy in your mission (to become one with God)?

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jit simaran dharageh mukh uoojal sadhaa sadhaa sukh paieeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meditation on God leads to your acceptance in God's court and, by engrossing yourself in this meditation, your face shall be radiant having attained everlasting peace and pleasure.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਕਾਮੀ ਕਾਮਿ ਲੁਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jiau kaamee kaam lubhaavai ||
verses.translation: Just as the lustful man is enticed by lust,

verses.original: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tiau har dhaas har jas bhaavai ||2||
verses.translation: so is the Lord's slave pleased with the Lord's Praise. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਮਾਤਾ ਬਾਲਿ ਲਪਟਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jiau maataa baal lapaTaavai ||
verses.translation: Just as the mother holds her baby close,

verses.original: ਤਿਉ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tiau giaanee naam kamaavai ||3||
verses.translation: so does the spiritual person cherish the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur poore te paavai ||
verses.translation: This is obtained from the Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥੪॥੧੯॥੮੩॥
verses.translit: jan naanak naam dhiaavai ||4||19||83||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||19||83||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਂਦਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sukh saa(n)dh ghar aaiaa ||
verses.translation: Safe and sound, I have returned home.

verses.original: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ni(n)dhak kai mukh chhaiaa ||
verses.translation: The slanderer's face is blackened with ashes.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਹਿਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: poorai gur pahiraiaa ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has dressed me in robes of honor.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਸੇ ਦੁਖ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: binase dhukh sabaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: All my pains and sufferings are over. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tahu saache kee vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: O Saints, this is the glorious greatness of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਅਚਰਜ ਸੋਭ ਬਣਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jin acharaj sobh banaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He has created such wonder and glory! ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬੋਲੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: bole saahib kai bhaanai ||
verses.translation: I speak according to the Will of my Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਦਾਸੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhaas baanee braham vakhaanai ||
verses.translation: God's slave chants the Word of His Bani.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: naanak prabh sukhadhaiee ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, God is the Giver of peace.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥੨॥੨੦॥੮੪॥
verses.translit: jin pooree banat banaiee ||2||20||84||
verses.translation: He has created the perfect creation. ||2||20||84||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: prabh apunaa ridhai dhiaae ||
verses.translation: Within my heart, I meditate on God.

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਸਹੀ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: ghar sahee salaamat aae ||
verses.translation: I have returned home safe and sound.

verses.original: ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਭਇਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tokh bhiaa sa(n)saare ||
verses.translation: The world has become contented.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਲੈ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur poorai lai taare ||1||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has saved me. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tahu prabh meraa sadhaa dhiaalaa ||
verses.translation: O Saints, my God is forever merciful.

verses.original: ਅਪਨੇ ਭਗਤ ਕੀ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਗਣਈ ਰਾਖੈ ਬਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: apane bhagat kee ganat na ganiee raakhai baal gupaalaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord of the world does not call His devotee to account; He protects His children. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har naam ridhai ur dhaare ||
verses.translation: I have enshrined the Lord's Name within my heart.

verses.original: ਤਿਨਿ ਸਭੇ ਥੋਕ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: tin sabhe thok savaare ||
verses.translation: He has resolved all my affairs.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਤੁਸਿ ਦੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai tus dheeaa ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru was pleased, and blessed me,

verses.original: ਫਿਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਥੀਆ ॥੨॥੨੧॥੮੫॥
verses.translit: fir naanak dhookh na theeaa ||2||21||85||
verses.translation: and now, Nanak shall never again suffer pain. ||2||21||85||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: har man tan vasiaa soiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord abides in my mind and body.

verses.original: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jai jai kaar kare sabh koiee ||
verses.translation: Everyone congratulates me on my victory.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur poore kee vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: This is the glorious greatness of the Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: taa kee keemat kahee na jaiee ||1||
verses.translation: His value cannot be described. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ਜਾਈ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: hau kurabaan jaiee tere naavai ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to Your Name.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੋ ਜਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jis no bakhas laih mere piaare so jas teraa gaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He alone, whom You have forgiven, O my Beloved, sings Your Praises. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਭਾਰੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) bhaaro suaamee meraa ||
verses.translation: You are my Great Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਸੰਤਾਂ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)taa(n) bharavaasaa teraa ||
verses.translation: You are the support of the Saints.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: naanak prabh saranaiee ||
verses.translation: Nanak has entered God's Sanctuary.

verses.translit: mukh ni(n)dhak kai chhaiee ||2||22||86||
verses.translation: The faces of the slanderers are blackened with ashes. ||2||22||86||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਗੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: aagai sukh mere meetaa ||
verses.translation: Peace in this world, O my friends,

verses.original: ਪਾਛੇ ਆਨਦੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: paachhe aanadh prabh keetaa ||
verses.translation: and bliss in the world hereafter - God has given me this.

verses.original: ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਿ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: paramesur banat banaiee ||
verses.translation: The Transcendent Lord has arranged these arrangements;

verses.original: ਫਿਰਿ ਡੋਲਤ ਕਤਹੂ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: fir ddolat katahoo naahee ||1||
verses.translation: I shall never waver again. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: saache saahib siau man maaniaa ||
verses.translation: My mind is pleased with the True Lord Master.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har sarab nira(n)tar jaaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I know the Lord to be pervading all. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh jeea tere dhiaalaa ||
verses.translation: All beings are Yours, O Merciful Lord.

verses.original: ਅਪਨੇ ਭਗਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: apane bhagat kareh pratipaalaa ||
verses.translation: You cherish Your devotees.

verses.original: ਅਚਰਜੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: acharaj teree vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: Your glorious greatness is wonderful and marvellous.

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੨॥੨੩॥੮੭॥
verses.translit: nit naanak naam dhiaaiee ||2||23||87||
verses.translation: Nanak ever meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||23||87||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਲਿ ਨਰਾਇਣੁ ਮੇਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: naal narain merai ||
verses.translation: The Lord is always with me.

verses.original: ਜਮਦੂਤੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨੇਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: jamadhoot na aavai nerai ||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death does not approach me.

verses.original: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: ka(n)Th lai prabh raakhai ||
verses.translation: God holds me close in His embrace, and protects me.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਖੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: satigur kee sach saakhai ||1||
verses.translation: True are the Teachings of the True Guru. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰੀ ਕੀਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai pooree keetee ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has done it perfectly.

verses.original: ਦੁਸਮਨ ਮਾਰਿ ਵਿਡਾਰੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਦੀਤੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhusaman maar viddaare sagale dhaas kau sumat dheetee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He has beaten and driven off my enemies, and given me, His slave, the sublime understanding of the neutral mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਥਾਨ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: prabh sagale thaan vasaae ||
verses.translation: God has blessed all places with prosperity.

verses.original: ਸੁਖਿ ਸਾਂਦਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: sukh saa(n)dh fir aae ||
verses.translation: I have returned again safe and sound.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: naanak prabh saranaae ||
verses.translation: Nanak has entered God's Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਰੋਗ ਮਿਟਾਏ ॥੨॥੨੪॥੮੮॥
verses.translit: jin sagale rog miTaae ||2||24||88||
verses.translation: It has eradicated all disease. ||2||24||88||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: sarab sukhaa kaa dhaataa satigur taa kee saranee paieeaai ||
verses.translation: The True Guru is the Giver of all peace and comfort - seek His Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਹੋਤ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਗਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dharasan bheTat hot ana(n)dhaa dhookh giaa har gaieeaai ||1||
verses.translation: Beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, bliss ensues, pain is dispelled, and one sings the Lord's Praises. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har ras peevahu bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Drink in the sublime essence of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਨਾਮੋ ਆਰਾਧਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naam japahu naamo aaraadhahu gur poore kee saranaiee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord; worship the Naam in adoration, and enter the Sanctuary of the Perfect Guru. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋਈ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: tiseh paraapat jis dhur likhiaa soiee pooran bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Only one who has such pre-ordained destiny receives it; he alone becomes perfect, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੨॥੨੫॥੮੯॥
verses.translit: naanak kee bena(n)tee prabh jee naam rahaa liv laiee ||2||25||89||
verses.translation: Nanak's prayer, O Dear God, is to remain lovingly absorbed in the Naam. ||2||25||89||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: karan karaavan har a(n)tarajaamee jan apune kee raakhai ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the Cause of Causes, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; He preserves the honor of His servant.

verses.original: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਹੋਤੁ ਜਗ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jai jai kaar hot jag bheetar sabadh guroo ras chaakhai ||1||
verses.translation: He is hailed and congratulated throughout the world, and he tastes the sublime essence of the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਓਟ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: prabh jee teree oT gusaiee ||
verses.translation: Dear God, Lord of the world, You are my only support.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤੁਮੑ ਧਿਆਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: too samarath saran kaa dhaataa aaTh pahar tum(h) dhiaaiee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: You are all-powerful, the Giver of Sanctuary; twenty-four hours a day, I meditate on You. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਭਜਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ ਤਿਸੈ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jo jan bhajan kare prabh teraa tisai a(n)dhesaa naahee ||
verses.translation: That humble being, who vibrates upon You, O God, is not afflicted by anxiety.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਲਗੇ ਭਉ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: satigur charan lage bhau miTiaa har gun gaae man maahee ||2||
verses.translation: Attached to the Feet of the True Guru, his fear is dispelled, and within his mind, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: sookh sahaj aana(n)dh ghanere satigur dheeaa dhilaasaa ||
verses.translation: He abides in celestial peace and utter ecstasy; the True Guru has comforted him.

verses.original: ਜਿਣਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੇਤੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਆਸਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jin ghar aae sobhaa setee pooran hoiee aasaa ||3||
verses.translation: He has returned home victorious, with honor, and his hopes have been fulfilled. ||3||

verses.original: ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਕਾਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: pooraa gur pooree mat jaa kee pooran prabh ke kaamaa ||
verses.translation: Perfect are the Teachings of the Perfect Guru; Perfect are the actions of God.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਲਾਗਿ ਤਰਿਓ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੪॥੨੬॥੯੦॥
verses.translit: gur charanee laag tario bhav saagar jap naanak har har naamaa ||4||26||90||
verses.translation: Grasping hold of the Guru's feet, Nanak has crossed over the terrifying world-ocean, chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||26||90||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਭਇਓ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਥਾਟੀ ॥
verses.translit: bhio kirapaal dheen dhukh bha(n)jan aape sabh bidh thaaTee ||
verses.translation: Becoming merciful, the Destroyer of the pains of the poor has Himself devised all devices.

verses.original: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਓ ਜਨੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਬੇੜੀ ਕਾਟੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: khin meh raakh leeo jan apunaa gur poorai beRee kaaTee ||1||
verses.translation: In an instant, He has saved His humble servant; the Perfect Guru has cut away his bonds. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਸਦ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: mere man gur govi(n)dh sadh dhiaaieeaai ||
verses.translation: O my mind, meditate forever on the Guru, the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sagal kales miTeh is tan te man chi(n)dhiaa fal paieeaai || rahaau ||
verses.translation: All illness shall depart from this body, and you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਊਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t jaa ke sabh keene prabh uoochaa agam apaaraa ||
verses.translation: God created all beings and creatures; He is lofty, inaccessible and infinite.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਭਏ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ॥੨॥੨੭॥੯੧॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g naanak naam dhiaaiaa mukh uoojal bhe dharabaaraa ||2||27||91||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; his face is radiant in the Court of the Lord. ||2||27||91||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਉ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਸਾਂਈ ॥
verses.translit: simarau apunaa saa(n)iee ||
verses.translation: I meditate in remembrance on my Lord.

verses.original: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਸਦ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhinas rain sadh dhiaaiee ||
verses.translation: Day and night, I ever meditate on Him.

verses.original: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
verses.translit: haath dhei jin raakhe ||
verses.translation: He gave me His hand, and protected me.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਮਹਾ ਰਸ ਚਾਖੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har naam mahaa ras chaakhe ||1||
verses.translation: I drink in the most sublime essence of the Lord's Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਪਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: apane gur uoopar kurabaan ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to my Guru.

verses.original: ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਹੋਏ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhe kirapaal pooran prabh dhaate jeea hoe miharavaan || rahaau ||
verses.translation: God, the Great Giver, the Perfect One, has become merciful to me, and now, all are kind to me. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: naanak jan saranaiee ||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has entered His Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jin pooran paij rakhaiee ||
verses.translation: He has perfectly preserved his honor.

verses.original: ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sagale dhookh miTaiee ||
verses.translation: All suffering has been dispelled.

verses.translit: sukh bhu(n)chahu mere bhaiee ||2||28||92||
verses.translation: So enjoy peace, O my Siblings of Destiny! ||2||28||92||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sunahu bina(n)tee Thaakur mere jeea ja(n)t tere dhaare ||
verses.translation: Hear my prayer, O my Lord and Master; all beings and creatures were created by You.

verses.original: ਰਾਖੁ ਪੈਜ ਨਾਮ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: raakh paij naam apune kee karan karaavanahaare ||1||
verses.translation: You preserve the honor of Your Name, O Lord, Cause of causes. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਖਸਮਾਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: prabh jeeau khasamaanaa kar piaare ||
verses.translation: O Dear God, Beloved, please, make me Your own.

verses.original: ਬੁਰੇ ਭਲੇ ਹਮ ਥਾਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bure bhale ham thaare || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whether good or bad, I am Yours. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੁਣੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਸਮਰਥ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sunee pukaar samarath suaamee ba(n)dhan kaaT savaare ||
verses.translation: The Almighty Lord and Master heard my prayer; cutting away my bonds, He has adorned me.

verses.original: ਪਹਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਪਾਉ ਸੇਵਕ ਜਨ ਮੇਲੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪਹਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੨੯॥੯੩॥
verses.translit: pahir sirapaau sevak jan mele naanak pragaT pahaare ||2||29||93||
verses.translation: He dressed me in robes of honor, and blended His servant with Himself; Nanak is revealed in glory throughout the world. ||2||29||93||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਵਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਭਿ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t sabh vas kar dheene sevak sabh dharabaare ||
verses.translation: All beings and creatures are subservient to all those who serve in the Lord's Court.

verses.original: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਭਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)geekaar keeo prabh apune bhav nidh paar utaare ||1||
verses.translation: Their God made them His own, and carried them across the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tan ke kaaraj sagal savaare ||
verses.translation: He resolves all the affairs of His Saints.

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਖਸਮ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dheen dhiaal kirapaal kirapaa nidh pooran khasam hamaare || rahaau ||
verses.translation: He is merciful to the meek, kind and compassionate, the ocean of kindness, my Perfect Lord and Master. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਉ ਬੈਠੁ ਆਦਰੁ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ਊਨ ਨ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: aau baiTh aadhar sabh thaiee uoon na katahoo(n) baataa ||
verses.translation: I am asked to come and be seated, everywhere I go, and I lack nothing.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਸਿਰਪਾਉ ਦੀਓ ਜਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੨॥੩੦॥੯੪॥
verses.translit: bhagat sirapaau dheeo jan apune prataap naanak prabh jaataa ||2||30||94||
verses.translation: The Lord blesses His humble devotee with robes of honor; O Nanak, the Glory of God is manifest. ||2||30||94||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa nauvaa
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: re man raam siau kar preet ||
verses.translation: O mind, love the Lord.

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਨੁ ਸੁਨਉ ਅਰੁ ਗਾਉ ਰਸਨਾ ਗੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sravan gobi(n)dh gun sunau ar gaau rasanaa geet ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: With your ears, hear the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, and with your tongue, sing His song. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਿਮਰੁ ਮਾਧੋ ਹੋਹਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: kar saadhasa(n)gat simar maadho hoh patit puneet ||
verses.translation: Join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and meditate in remembrance on the Lord; even a sinner like yourself will become pure.

verses.original: ਕਾਲੁ ਬਿਆਲੁ ਜਿਉ ਪਰਿਓ ਡੋਲੈ ਮੁਖੁ ਪਸਾਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kaal biaal jiau pario ddolai mukh pasaare meet ||1||
verses.translation: Death is on the prowl, with its mouth wide open, friend. ||1||

verses.original: ਆਜੁ ਕਾਲਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਤੋਹਿ ਗ੍ਰਸਿ ਹੈ ਸਮਝਿ ਰਾਖਉ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: aaj kaal fun toh gras hai samajh raakhau cheet ||
verses.translation: Today or tomorrow, eventually it will seize you; understand this in your consciousness.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਭਜਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਤੁ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਬੀਤ ॥੨॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak raam bhaj lai jaat aausar beet ||2||1||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, meditate, and vibrate upon the Lord; this opportunity is slipping away! ||2||1||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa nauvaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਰਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: man kee man hee maeh rahee ||
verses.translation: The mind remains in the mind.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੇ ਨ ਤੀਰਥ ਸੇਵੇ ਚੋਟੀ ਕਾਲਿ ਗਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naa har bhaje na teerath seve choTee kaal gahee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He does not meditate on the Lord, nor does he perform service at sacred shrines, and so death seizes him by the hair. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦਾਰਾ ਮੀਤ ਪੂਤ ਰਥ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਧਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭ ਮਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhaaraa meet poot rath sa(n)pat dhan pooran sabh mahee ||
verses.translation: Wife, friends, children, carriages, property, total wealth, the entire world

verses.original: ਅਵਰ ਸਗਲ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਏ ਜਾਨਉ ਭਜਨੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਕੋ ਸਹੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: avar sagal mithiaa e jaanau bhajan raam ko sahee ||1||
verses.translation: - know that all of these things are false. The Lord's meditation alone is true. ||1||

verses.original: ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਜੁਗ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਮਾਨਸ ਦੇਹ ਲਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: firat firat bahute jug haario maanas dheh lahee ||
verses.translation: Wandering, wandering around for so many ages, he has grown weary, and finally, he obtained this human body.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਤ ਮਿਲਨ ਕੀ ਬਰੀਆ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕਹਾ ਨਹੀ ॥੨॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak kahat milan kee bareeaa simarat kahaa nahee ||2||2||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, this is the opportunity to meet the Lord; why don't you remember Him in meditation? ||2||2||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa nauvaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਕਉਨੁ ਕੁਮਤਿ ਤੈ ਲੀਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: man re kaun kumat tai leenee ||
verses.translation: O mind, what evil-mindedness have you developed?

verses.original: ਪਰ ਦਾਰਾ ਨਿੰਦਿਆ ਰਸ ਰਚਿਓ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਹਿ ਕੀਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: par dhaaraa ni(n)dhiaa ras rachio raam bhagat neh keenee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You are engrossed in the pleasures of other men's wives, and slander; you have not worshipped the Lord at all. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਤੈ ਨਾਹਨਿ ਧਨ ਜੋਰਨ ਕਉ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: mukat pa(n)th jaanio tai naahan dhan joran kau dhaiaa ||
verses.translation: You do not know the way to liberation, but you run all around chasing wealth.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਿ ਸੰਗ ਕਾਹੂ ਨਹੀ ਦੀਨਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਆਪੁ ਬੰਧਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)t sa(n)g kaahoo nahee dheenaa birathaa aap ba(n)dhaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: In the end, nothing shall go along with you; you have entrapped yourself in vain. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਿਓ ਨ ਗੁਰ ਜਨੁ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਨਹ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਕਛੁ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: naa har bhajio na gur jan sevio neh upajio kachh giaanaa ||
verses.translation: You have not meditated or vibrated upon the Lord; you have not served the Guru, or His humble servants; spiritual wisdom has not welled up within you.

verses.original: ਘਟ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਤੈ ਖੋਜਤ ਉਦਿਆਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ghaT hee maeh nira(n)jan terai tai khojat udhiaanaa ||2||
verses.translation: The Immaculate Lord is within your heart, and yet you search for Him in the wilderness. ||2||

verses.original: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਜਨਮ ਭਰਮਤ ਤੈ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਅਸਥਿਰ ਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bahut janam bharamat tai haario asathir mat nahee paiee ||
verses.translation: You have wandered through many many births; you are exhausted but have still not found a way out of this endless cycle.

verses.original: ਮਾਨਸ ਦੇਹ ਪਾਇ ਪਦ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਤ ਬਤਾਈ ॥੩॥੩॥
verses.translit: maanas dheh pai padh har bhaj naanak baat bataiee ||3||3||
verses.translation: Now that you have obtained this human body, meditate on the Lord's Feet; Nanak advises with this advice. ||3||3||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa nauvaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਬਿਚਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: man re prabh kee saran bichaaro ||
verses.translation: O mind, contemplate the Sanctuary of God.

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਗਨਕਾ ਸੀ ਉਧਰੀ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਜਸੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jeh simarat ganakaa see udharee taa ko jas ur dhaaro ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meditating on Him in remembrance, Ganika the prostitute was saved; enshrine His Praises within your heart. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਟਲ ਭਇਓ ਧ੍ਰੂਅ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਅਰੁ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aTal bhio dhraooa jaa kai simaran ar nirabhai padh paiaa ||
verses.translation: Meditating on Him in remembrance, Dhroo became immortal, and obtained the state of fearlessness.

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਹਰਤਾ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੈ ਕਾਹੇ ਬਿਸਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhukh harataa ieh bidh ko suaamee tai kaahe bisaraiaa ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord and Master removes suffering in this way - why have you forgotten Him? ||1||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਗਜ ਗਰਾਹ ਤੇ ਛੂਟਾ ॥
verses.translit: jab hee saran gahee kirapaa nidh gaj garaeh te chhooTaa ||
verses.translation: As soon as the elephant took to the protective Sanctuary of the Lord, the ocean of mercy, he escaped from the crocodile.

verses.original: ਮਹਮਾ ਨਾਮ ਕਹਾ ਲਉ ਬਰਨਉ ਰਾਮ ਕਹਤ ਬੰਧਨ ਤਿਹ ਤੂਟਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mahamaa naam kahaa lau baranau raam kahat ba(n)dhan teh tooTaa ||2||
verses.translation: How much can I describe the Glorious Praises of the Naam? Whoever chants the Lord's Name, his bonds are broken. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਜਾਮਲੁ ਪਾਪੀ ਜਗੁ ਜਾਨੇ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: ajaamal paapee jag jaane nimakh maeh nisataaraa ||
verses.translation: Ajaamal, known throughout the world as a sinner, was redeemed in an instant.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਤ ਚੇਤ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਨਿ ਤੈ ਭੀ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਪਾਰਾ ॥੩॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak kahat chet chi(n)taaman tai bhee utareh paaraa ||3||4||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, remember the Chintaamani, the jewel which fulfills all desires, and you too shall be carried across and saved. ||3||4||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa nauvaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਕਉਨੁ ਉਪਾਉ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: praanee kaun upaau karai ||
verses.translation: What efforts should the mortal make,

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਮ ਕੋ ਤ੍ਰਾਸੁ ਹਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaa te bhagat raam kee paavai jam ko traas harai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: to attain devotional worship of the Lord, and eradicate the fear of death? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਉਨੁ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਕਹੁ ਕੈਸੀ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਕਰਈ ॥
verses.translit: kaun karam bidhiaa kahu kaisee dharam kaun fun kariee ||
verses.translation: Which actions, what sort of knowledge, and what religion - what Dharma should one practice?

verses.original: ਕਉਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰ ਕਉ ਤਰਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kaun naam gur jaa kai simarai bhav saagar kau tariee ||1||
verses.translation: What Name of the Guru should one remember in meditation, to cross over the terrifying world-ocean? ||1||

verses.original: ਕਲ ਮੈ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਜਪੈ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: kal mai ek naam kirapaa nidh jaeh japai gat paavai ||
verses.translation: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Name of the One Lord is the treasure of mercy; chanting it, one obtains salvation.

verses.original: ਅਉਰ ਧਰਮ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸਮ ਨਾਹਨਿ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਬੇਦੁ ਬਤਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aaur dharam taa kai sam naahan ieh bidh bedh bataavai ||2||
verses.translation: No other religion is comparable to this; so speak the Vedas. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਰਹਤ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਲੇਪੀ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਹਤ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sukh dhukh rahat sadhaa niralepee jaa kau kahat gusaiee ||
verses.translation: He is beyond pain and pleasure, forever unattached; He is called the Lord of the world.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਬਸੈ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਪਨਿ ਨਿਆਈ ॥੩॥੫॥
verses.translit: so tum hee meh basai nira(n)tar naanak dharapan niaaiee ||3||5||
verses.translation: He dwells deep within your inner self, O Nanak, like the image in a mirror. ||3||5||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa nauvaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਈ ਮੈ ਕਿਹਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਲਖਉ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: maiee mai keh bidh lakhau gusaiee ||
verses.translation: O mother, how can I see the Lord of the world?

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹ ਅਗਿਆਨਿ ਤਿਮਰਿ ਮੋ ਮਨੁ ਰਹਿਓ ਉਰਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa moh agiaan timar mo man rahio urajhaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In the utter darkness of emotional attachment and spiritual ignorance, my mind remains entangled. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਜਨਮ ਭਰਮ ਹੀ ਭਰਮ ਖੋਇਓ ਨਹ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sagal janam bharam hee bharam khoio neh asathir mat paiee ||
verses.translation: Deluded by doubt, I have wasted my whole life; I have not obtained a stable intellect.

verses.original: ਬਿਖਿਆਸਕਤ ਰਹਿਓ ਨਿਸ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਨਹ ਛੂਟੀ ਅਧਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bikhiaasakat rahio nis baasur neh chhooTee adhamaiee ||1||
verses.translation: I remain under the influence of corrupting sins, night and day, and I have not renounced wickedness. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਕਬਹੂ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਨਾ ਨਹ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g kabahoo nahee keenaa neh keerat prabh gaiee ||
verses.translation: I never joined the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and I did not sing the Kirtan of God's Praises.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋਊ ਗੁਨੁ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥੨॥੬॥
verses.translit: jan naanak mai naeh kouoo gun raakh leh saranaiee ||2||6||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, I have no virtues at all; keep me in Your Sanctuary, Lord. ||2||6||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa nauvaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਈ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਬਸਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: maiee man mero bas naeh ||
verses.translation: O mother, my mind is out of control.

verses.original: ਨਿਸ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਬਿਖਿਅਨ ਕਉ ਧਾਵਤ ਕਿਹਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਰੋਕਉ ਤਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: nis baasur bikhian kau dhaavat keh bidh rokau taeh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Night and day, it runs after sin and corruption. How can I restrain it? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਕੇ ਮਤ ਸੁਨਿ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਹੀਏ ਬਸਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: bedh puraan simirat ke mat sun nimakh na he'ee basaavai ||
verses.translation: He listens to the teachings of the Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees, but he does not enshrine them in his heart, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਦਾਰਾ ਸਿਉ ਰਚਿਓ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਿਰਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: par dhan par dhaaraa siau rachio birathaa janam siraavai ||1||
verses.translation: Engrossed in the wealth and women of others, his life passes away uselessly. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਦਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਭਇਓ ਬਾਵਰੋ ਸੂਝਤ ਨਹ ਕਛੁ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: madh maiaa kai bhio baavaro soojhat neh kachh giaanaa ||
verses.translation: He has gone insane with the wine of Maya, and does not understand even a bit of spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਘਟ ਹੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬਸਤ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ghaT hee bheetar basat nira(n)jan taa ko maram na jaanaa ||2||
verses.translation: Deep within his heart, the Immaculate Lord dwells, but he does not know this secret. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਆਇਓ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: jab hee saran saadh kee aaio dhuramat sagal binaasee ||
verses.translation: When I came to the Sanctuary of the Holy Saints, all my evil-mindedness was dispelled.

verses.original: ਤਬ ਨਾਨਕ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਨਿ ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥੩॥੭॥
verses.translit: tab naanak chetio chi(n)taaman kaaTee jam kee faasee ||3||7||
verses.translation: Then, O Nanak, I remembered the Chintaamani, the jewel which fulfills all desires, and the noose of Death was snapped. ||3||7||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa nauvaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰੇ ਨਰ ਇਹ ਸਾਚੀ ਜੀਅ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: re nar ieh saachee jeea dhaar ||
verses.translation: O man, grasp this Truth firmly in your soul.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਜਗਤੁ ਹੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਬਿਨਸਤ ਲਗਤ ਨ ਬਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sagal jagat hai jaise supanaa binasat lagat na baar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The whole world is just like a dream; it will pass away in an instant. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਾਰੂ ਭੀਤਿ ਬਨਾਈ ਰਚਿ ਪਚਿ ਰਹਤ ਨਹੀ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: baaroo bheet banaiee rach pach rahat nahee dhin chaar ||
verses.translation: Like a wall of sand, built up and plastered with great care, which does not last even a few days,

verses.original: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਇਹ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਉਰਝਿਓ ਕਹਾ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: taise hee ieh sukh maiaa ke urajhio kahaa gavaar ||1||
verses.translation: just so are the pleasures of Maya. Why are you entangled in them, you ignorant fool? ||1||

verses.original: ਅਜਹੂ ਸਮਝਿ ਕਛੁ ਬਿਗਰਿਓ ਨਾਹਿਨਿ ਭਜਿ ਲੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: ajahoo samajh kachh bigario naahin bhaj le naam muraar ||
verses.translation: Understand this today - it is not yet too late! Chant and vibrate the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਜ ਮਤੁ ਸਾਧਨ ਕਉ ਭਾਖਿਓ ਤੋਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੮॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak nij mat saadhan kau bhaakhio toh pukaar ||2||8||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, this is the subtle wisdom of the Holy Saints, which I proclaim out loud to you. ||2||8||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa nauvaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehla:

verses.original: ਇਹ ਜਗਿ ਮੀਤੁ ਨ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: eeh jag meet na dhekhio koiee ||
verses.translation: In this world, I have not found any true friend.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਜਗਤੁ ਅਪਨੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਲਾਗਿਓ ਦੁਖ ਮੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sagal jagat apanai sukh laagio dhukh mai sa(n)g na hoiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The whole world is attached to its own pleasures, and when trouble comes, no one is with you. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦਾਰਾ ਮੀਤ ਪੂਤ ਸਨਬੰਧੀ ਸਗਰੇ ਧਨ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhaaraa meet poot sanaba(n)dhee sagare dhan siau laage ||
verses.translation: Wives, friends, children and relatives - all are attached to wealth.

verses.original: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਨਿਰਧਨ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਨਰ ਕਉ ਸੰਗੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਸਭ ਭਾਗੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jab hee niradhan dhekhio nar kau sa(n)g chhaadd sabh bhaage ||1||
verses.translation: When they see a poor man, they all forsake his company and run away. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਹਂਉ ਕਹਾ ਯਿਆ ਮਨ ਬਉਰੇ ਕਉ ਇਨ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਲਗਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: kaha(n)au kahaa yiaa man baure kau in siau neh lagaio ||
verses.translation: So what should I say to this crazy mind, which is affectionately attached to them?

verses.original: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਸਕਲ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਜਸੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਬਿਸਰਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dheenaa naath sakal bhai bha(n)jan jas taa ko bisaraio ||2||
verses.translation: The Lord is the Master of the meek, the Destroyer of all fears, and I have forgotten to praise Him. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੁਆਨ ਪੂਛ ਜਿਉ ਭਇਓ ਨ ਸੂਧਉ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਜਤਨੁ ਮੈ ਕੀਨਉ ॥
verses.translit: suaan poochh jiau bhio na soodhau bahut jatan mai keenau ||
verses.translation: Like a dog's tail, which will never straighten out, the mind will not change, no matter how many things are tried.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਾਜ ਬਿਰਦ ਕੀ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਹਾਰਉ ਲੀਨਉ ॥੩॥੯॥
verses.translit: naanak laaj biradh kee raakhahu naam tuhaarau leenau ||3||9||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, please, Lord, uphold the honor of Your innate nature; I chant Your Name. ||3||9||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa nauvaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਗਹਿਓ ਨ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: man re gahio na gur upadhes ||
verses.translation: O mind, you have not accepted the Guru's Teachings.

verses.original: ਕਹਾ ਭਇਓ ਜਉ ਮੂਡੁ ਮੁਡਾਇਓ ਭਗਵਉ ਕੀਨੋ ਭੇਸੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kahaa bhio jau moodd muddaio bhagavau keeno bhes ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: What is the use of shaving your head, and wearing saffron robes? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਚ ਛਾਡਿ ਕੈ ਝੂਠਹ ਲਾਗਿਓ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਕਾਰਥੁ ਖੋਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: saach chhaadd kai jhooTheh laagio janam akaarath khoio ||
verses.translation: Abandoning Truth, you cling to falsehood; your life is uselessly wasting away.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਪਰਪੰਚ ਉਦਰ ਨਿਜ ਪੋਖਿਓ ਪਸੁ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ਸੋਇਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kar parapa(n)ch udhar nij pokhio pas kee niaaiee soio ||1||
verses.translation: Practicing hypocrisy, you fill your belly, and then sleep like an animal. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਭਜਨ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਹਾਥਿ ਬਿਕਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: raam bhajan kee gat nahee jaanee maiaa haath bikaanaa ||
verses.translation: You do not know the Way of the Lord's meditation; you have sold yourself into Maya's hands.

verses.original: ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਬਿਖਿਅਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਉਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਬਿਸਰਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aurajh rahio bikhian sa(n)g bauraa naam ratan bisaraanaa ||2||
verses.translation: The madman remains entangled in vice and corruption; he has forgotten the jewel of the Naam. ||2||

verses.original: ਰਹਿਓ ਅਚੇਤੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਅਉਧ ਸਿਰਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: rahio achet na chetio gobi(n)dh birathaa aaudh siraanee ||
verses.translation: He remains thoughtless, not thinking of the Lord of the Universe; his life is uselessly passing away.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਪਛਾਨਉ ਭੂਲੇ ਸਦਾ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥੩॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak har biradh pachhaanau bhoole sadhaa paraanee ||3||10||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, O Lord, please, confirm your innate nature; this mortal is continually making mistakes. ||3||10||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa nauvaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਦੁਖ ਮੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: jo nar dhukh mai dhukh nahee maanai ||
verses.translation: That man, who in the midst of pain, does not feel pain,

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਸਨੇਹੁ ਅਰੁ ਭੈ ਨਹੀ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕੰਚਨ ਮਾਟੀ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sukh saneh ar bhai nahee jaa kai ka(n)chan maaTee maanai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: who is not affected by pleasure, affection or fear, and who looks alike upon gold and dust;||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਹ ਨਿੰਦਿਆ ਨਹ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: neh ni(n)dhiaa neh usatat jaa kai lobh moh abhimaanaa ||
verses.translation: Who is not swayed by either slander or praise, nor affected by greed, attachment or pride;

verses.original: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਆਰਉ ਨਾਹਿ ਮਾਨ ਅਪਮਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: harakh sog te rahai niaarau naeh maan apamaanaa ||1||
verses.translation: who remains unaffected by joy and sorrow, honor and dishonor;||1||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗੈ ਜਗ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa manasaa sagal tiaagai jag te rahai niraasaa ||
verses.translation: who renounces all hopes and desires and remains desireless in the world;

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਜਿਹ ਪਰਸੈ ਨਾਹਨਿ ਤਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh jeh parasai naahan teh ghaT braham nivaasaa ||2||
verses.translation: who is not touched by sexual desire or anger - within his heart, God dwells. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਹ ਨਰ ਕਉ ਕੀਨੀ ਤਿਹ ਇਹ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਪਛਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur kirapaa jeh nar kau keenee teh ieh jugat pachhaanee ||
verses.translation: That man, blessed by Guru's Grace, understands this way.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਲੀਨ ਭਇਓ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਪਾਨੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਨੀ ॥੩॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: naanak leen bhio gobi(n)dh siau jiau paanee sa(n)g paanee ||3||11||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he merges with the Lord of the Universe, like water with water. ||3||11||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa nauvaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਜਾਨਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: preetam jaan leh man maahee ||
verses.translation: O dear friend, know this in your mind.

verses.original: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਿਉ ਹੀ ਜਗੁ ਫਾਂਧਿਓ ਕੋ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: apane sukh siau hee jag faa(n)dhio ko kaahoo ko naahee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The world is entangled in its own pleasures; no one is for anyone else. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਮੈ ਆਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਬੈਠਤ ਰਹਤ ਚਹੂ ਦਿਸਿ ਘੇਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: sukh mai aan bahut mil baiThat rahat chahoo dhis gherai ||
verses.translation: In good times, many come and sit together, surrounding you on all four sides.

verses.original: ਬਿਪਤਿ ਪਰੀ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਸੰਗੁ ਛਾਡਿਤ ਕੋਊ ਨ ਆਵਤ ਨੇਰੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bipat paree sabh hee sa(n)g chhaaddit kouoo na aavat nerai ||1||
verses.translation: But when hard times come, they all leave, and no one comes near you. ||1||

verses.original: ਘਰ ਕੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਹਿਤੁ ਜਾ ਸਿਉ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਤ ਸੰਗ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: ghar kee naar bahut hit jaa siau sadhaa rahat sa(n)g laagee ||
verses.translation: Your wife, whom you love so much, and who has remained ever attached to you,

verses.original: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਹੰਸ ਤਜੀ ਇਹ ਕਾਂਇਆ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਗੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jab hee ha(n)s tajee ieh kaa(n)iaa pret pret kar bhaagee ||2||
verses.translation: runs away crying, ""Ghost! Ghost!"", as soon as the swan-soul leaves this body. ||2||

verses.original: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ਬਨਿਓ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਲਗਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: eeh bidh ko biauhaar banio hai jaa siau neh lagaio ||
verses.translation: This is the way they act - those whom we love so much.

verses.original: ਅੰਤ ਬਾਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਕੋਊ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ॥੩॥੧੨॥੧੩੯॥
verses.translit: a(n)t baar naanak bin har jee kouoo kaam na aaio ||3||12||139||
verses.translation: At the very last moment, O Nanak, no one is any use at all, except the Dear Lord. ||3||12||139||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਚਉਤੁਕੀ
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa pehilaa ghar pehilaa asaTapadheeaa chautukee
verses.translation: Sorat'h, First Mehla, First House, Ashtpadheeyaa, Chau-Thukay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨ ਪੜਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਪੂਜਉ ਮੜੈ ਮਸਾਣਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhubidhaa na paRau har bin hor na poojau maRai masaan na jaiee ||
verses.translation: I am not torn by duality, because I do not worship any other than the Lord; I do not visit tombs or crematoriums.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਰਾਚਿ ਨ ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਵਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: tirasanaa raach na par ghar jaavaa tirasanaa naam bujhaiee ||
verses.translation: I do not enter the houses of strangers, engrossed in desire. The Naam, the Name of the Lord, has satisfied my desires.

verses.original: ਘਰ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਘਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਤੇ ਮਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ghar bheetar ghar guroo dhikhaiaa sahaj rate man bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Deep within my heart, the Guru has shown me the home of my being, and my mind is imbued with peace and poise, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਦਾਨਾ ਆਪੇ ਬੀਨਾ ਤੂ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਮਤਿ ਸਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: too aape dhaanaa aape beenaa too dheveh mat saiee ||1||
verses.translation: You Yourself are all-knowing, and You Yourself are all-seeing; You alone bestow intelligence, O Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗਿ ਰਤਉ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: man bairaag ratau bairaagee sabadh man bedhiaa meree maiee ||
verses.translation: My mind is detached, imbued with detachment; the Word of the Shabad has pierced my mind, O my mother.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar jot nira(n)tar baanee saache saahib siau liv laiee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: God's Light shines continually within the nucleus of my deepest self; I am lovingly attached to the Bani, the Word of the True Lord Master. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਸੰਖ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਕਹਹਿ ਬੈਰਾਗ ਸੋ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਜਿ ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: asa(n)kh bairaagee kaheh bairaag so bairaagee j khasamai bhaavai ||
verses.translation: Countless detached renunciates talk of detachment and renunciation, but he alone is a true renunciate, who is pleasing to the Lord Master.

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਭੈ ਰਚਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: hiradhai sabadh sadhaa bhai rachiaa gur kee kaar kamaavai ||
verses.translation: The Word of the Shabad is ever in his heart; he is absorbed in the Fear of God, and he works to serve the Guru.

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਚੇਤੈ ਮਨੂਆ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਵਰਜਿ ਰਹਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: eko chetai manooaa na ddolai dhaavat varaj rahaavai ||
verses.translation: He remembers the One Lord, his mind does not waver, and he restrains its wanderings.

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sahaje maataa sadhaa ra(n)g raataa saache ke gun gaavai ||2||
verses.translation: He is intoxicated with celestial bliss, and is ever imbued with the Lord's Love; he sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨੂਆ ਪਉਣੁ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਸੁਖਵਾਸੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਸੈ ਸੁਖ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: manooaa paun bi(n)dh sukhavaasee naam vasai sukh bhaiee ||
verses.translation: The mind is like the wind, but if it comes to rest in peace, even for an instant, then he shall abide in the peace of the Name, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਜਿਹਬਾ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਸੋਤ੍ਰ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਜਲਿ ਬੂਝੀ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jihabaa netr sotr sach raate jal boojhee tujheh bujhaiee ||
verses.translation: His tongue, eyes and ears are imbued with Truth; O Lord, You quench the fires of desire.

verses.original: ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਰਹੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aas niraas rahai bairaagee nij ghar taaRee laiee ||
verses.translation: In hope, the renunciate remains free of hopes; in the home of his own inner self, he is absorbed in the trance of deep meditation.

verses.original: ਭਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਜੇ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਪੀਆਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bhikhiaa naam raje sa(n)tokhee a(n)mrit sahaj peeaaiee ||3||
verses.translation: He remains content, satisfied with the charity of the Naam; he drinks in the Ambrosial Amrit with ease. ||3||
