verses.original: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਦੂਜੀ ਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhubidhaa vich bairaag na hovee jab lag dhoojee raiee ||
verses.translation: There is no renunciation in duality, as long as there is even a particle of duality.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਏਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh jag teraa too eko dhaataa avar na dhoojaa bhaiee ||
verses.translation: The whole world is Yours, Lord; You alone are the Giver. There is not any other, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜੰਤ ਦੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh ja(n)t dhukh sadhaa nivaasee gurmukh dhe vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh dwells in misery forever, while the Lord bestows greatness upon the Gurmukh.

verses.original: ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਗੰਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਕਹਣੈ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: apar apaar aga(n)m agochar kahanai keem na paiee ||4||
verses.translation: God is infinite, endless, inaccessible and unfathomable; His worth cannot be described. ||4||

verses.original: ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਮਹਾ ਪਰਮਾਰਥੁ ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਣ ਪਤਿ ਨਾਮੰ ॥
verses.translit: su(n)n samaadh mahaa paramaarath teen bhavan pat naama(n) ||
verses.translation: The consciousness in deep Samaadhi, the Supreme Being, the Lord of the three worlds - these are Your Names, Lord.

verses.original: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਜੀਆ ਜਗਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਸਹਾਮੰ ॥
verses.translit: masatak lekh jeeaa jag jonee sir sir lekh sahaama(n) ||
verses.translation: The creatures born into this world have their destiny inscribed upon their foreheads; they experience according to their destinies.

verses.original: ਕਰਮ ਸੁਕਰਮ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਮੰ ॥
verses.translit: karam sukaram karaae aape aape bhagat dhiraRaama(n) ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself causes them to do good and bad deeds; He Himself makes them steadfast in devotional worship.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਜੂਠਿ ਲਹੈ ਭੈ ਮਾਨੰ ਆਪੇ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਅਗਾਮੰ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: man mukh jooTh lahai bhai maana(n) aape giaan agaama(n) ||5||
verses.translation: The filth of their mind and mouth is washed off when they live in the Fear of God; the inaccessible Lord Himself blesses them with spiritual wisdom. ||5||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸੇਈ ਸਾਦੁ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਜਿਉ ਗੁੰਗੇ ਮਿਠਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: jin chaakhiaa seiee saadh jaanan jiau gu(n)ge miThiaaiee ||
verses.translation: Only those who taste it know its sweet taste, like the mute, who eats the candy, and only smiles.

verses.original: ਅਕਥੈ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਥੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਚਾਲਉ ਸਦਾ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: akathai kaa kiaa katheeaai bhaiee chaalau sadhaa rajaiee ||
verses.translation: How can I describe the indescribable, O Siblings of Destiny? I shall follow His Will forever.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਮੇਲੇ ਤਾ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਮਤਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur dhaataa mele taa mat hovai nigure mat na kaiee ||
verses.translation: If one meets with the Guru, the Generous Giver, then he understands; those who have no Guru cannot understand this.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਚਲਾਏ ਤਿਉ ਚਾਲਹ ਭਾਈ ਹੋਰ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: jiau chalaae tiau chaaleh bhaiee hor kiaa ko kare chaturaiee ||6||
verses.translation: As the Lord causes us to act, so do we act, O Siblings of Destiny. What other clever tricks can anyone try? ||6||

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਇਕਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: eik bharam bhulaae ik bhagatee raate teraa khel apaaraa ||
verses.translation: Some are deluded by doubt, while others are imbued with devotional worship; Your play is infinite and endless.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਲਾਏ ਤੇਹਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੂ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਚਲਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jit tudh laae tehaa fal paiaa too hukam chalaavanahaaraa ||
verses.translation: As You engage them, they receive the fruits of their rewards; You alone are the One who issues Your Commands.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੀ ਜੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਪਣਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sevaa karee je kichh hovai apanaa jeeau pi(n)dd tumaaraa ||
verses.translation: I would serve You, if anything were my own; my soul and body are Yours.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਨੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: satigur miliaai kirapaa keenee a(n)mirat naam adhaaraa ||7||
verses.translation: One who meets with the True Guru, by His Grace, takes the Support of the Ambrosial Naam. ||7||

verses.original: ਗਗਨੰਤਰਿ ਵਾਸਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨੰ ॥
verses.translit: gagana(n)tar vaasiaa gun paragaasiaa gun meh giaan dhiaana(n) ||
verses.translation: He dwells in the heavenly realms, and his virtues radiantly shine forth; meditation and spiritual wisdom are found in virtue.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਤਤੋ ਤਤੁ ਵਖਾਨੰ ॥
verses.translit: naam man bhaavai kahai kahaavai tato tat vakhaana(n) ||
verses.translation: The Naam is pleasing to his mind; he speaks it, and causes others to speak it as well. He speaks the essential essence of wisdom.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੀਰਾ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਜਗੁ ਬਉਰਾਨੰ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh gur peeraa gahir ga(n)bheeraa bin sabadhai jag bauraana(n) ||
verses.translation: The Word of the Shabad is his Guru and spiritual teacher, profound and unfathomable; without the Shabad, the world is insane.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਗੀ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੰ ॥੮॥੧॥
verses.translit: pooraa bairaagee sahaj subhaagee sach naanak man maana(n) ||8||1||
verses.translation: He is a perfect renunciate, naturally at ease, O Nanak, whose mind is pleased with the True Lord. ||8||1||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਤਿਤੁਕੀ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa pehilaa titukee ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, First Mehla, Thi-Thukay:

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਬੰਧਨੀ ਭਾਈ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਬੰਧਕਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa manasaa ba(n)dhanee bhaiee karam dharam ba(n)dhakaaree ||
verses.translation: Hope and desire are entrapments, O Siblings of Destiny. Religious rituals and ceremonies are traps.

verses.original: ਪਾਪਿ ਪੁੰਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਜਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: paap pu(n)n jag jaiaa bhaiee binasai naam visaaree ||
verses.translation: Because of good and bad deeds, one is born into the world, O Siblings of Destiny; forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he is ruined.

verses.original: ਇਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਗਿ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਭਾਈ ਕਰਮ ਸਭੇ ਵੇਕਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: eeh maiaa jag mohanee bhaiee karam sabhe vekaaree ||1||
verses.translation: This Maya is the enticer of the world, O Siblings of Destiny; all such actions are corrupt. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: sun pa(n)ddit karamaa kaaree ||
verses.translation: Listen, O ritualistic Pandit:

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਕਰਮਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਭਾਈ ਸੁ ਆਤਮ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jit karam sukh uoopajai bhaiee su aatam tat beechaaree || rahaau ||
verses.translation: that religious ritual which produces happiness, O Siblings of Destiny, is contemplation of the essence of the soul. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਸਤੁ ਬੇਦੁ ਬਕੈ ਖੜੋ ਭਾਈ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: saasat bedh bakai khaRo bhaiee karam karahu sa(n)saaree ||
verses.translation: You may stand and recite the Shaastras and the Vedas, O Siblings of Destiny, but these are just worldly actions.

verses.original: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਚੂਕਈ ਭਾਈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: paakha(n)dd mail na chookiee bhaiee a(n)tar mail vikaaree ||
verses.translation: Filth cannot be washed away by hypocrisy, O Siblings of Destiny; the filth of corruption and sin is within you.

verses.original: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਡੂਬੀ ਮਾਕੁਰੀ ਭਾਈ ਊਂਡੀ ਸਿਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ein bidh ddoobee maakuree bhaiee uoo(n)ddee sir kai bhaaree ||2||
verses.translation: This is how the spider is destroyed, O Siblings of Destiny, by falling head-long in its own web. ||2||

verses.original: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਘਣੀ ਵਿਗੂਤੀ ਭਾਈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhuramat ghanee vigootee bhaiee dhoojai bhai khuaaiee ||
verses.translation: So many are destroyed by their own evil-mindedness, O Siblings of Destiny; in the love of duality, they are ruined.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਭਾਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur naam na paieeaai bhaiee bin naamai bharam na jaiee ||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, the Name is not obtained, O Siblings of Destiny; without the Name, doubt does not depart.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਭਾਈ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: satigur seve taa sukh paae bhaiee aavan jaan rahaiee ||3||
verses.translation: If one serves the True Guru, then he obtains peace, O Siblings of Destiny; his comings and goings are ended. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਾਚੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਊਪਜੈ ਭਾਈ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: saach sahaj gur te uoopajai bhaiee man niramal saach samaiee ||
verses.translation: True celestial peace comes from the Guru, O Siblings of Destiny; the immaculate mind is absorbed into the True Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur seve so boojhai bhaiee gur bin mag na paiee ||
verses.translation: One who serves the Guru, understands, O Siblings of Destiny; without the Guru, the way is not found.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਕਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਭਾਈ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jis a(n)tar lobh k karam kamaavai bhaiee kooR bol bikh khaiee ||4||
verses.translation: What can anyone do, with greed within? O Siblings of Destiny, by telling lies, they eat poison. ||4||

verses.original: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਦਹੀ ਵਿਲੋਈਐ ਭਾਈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਤਥੁ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ddit dhahee viloieeaai bhaiee vichahu nikalai tath ||
verses.translation: O Pandit, by churning cream, butter is produced.

verses.original: ਜਲੁ ਮਥੀਐ ਜਲੁ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਏਹਾ ਵਥੁ ॥
verses.translit: jal matheeaai jal dhekheeaai bhaiee ih jag ehaa vath ||
verses.translation: By churning water, you shall only see water, O Siblings of Destiny; this world is like that.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਵਿਗੂਚੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਦੇਉ ਅਲਖੁ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: gur bin bharam vigoocheeaai bhaiee ghaT ghaT dheau alakh ||5||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, he is ruined by doubt, O Siblings of Destiny; the unseen Divine Lord is in each and every heart. ||5||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਤਾਗੋ ਸੂਤ ਕੋ ਭਾਈ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਬਾਧੋ ਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eih jag taago soot ko bhaiee dheh dhis baadho mai ||
verses.translation: This world is like a thread of cotton, O Siblings of Destiny, which Maya has tied on all ten sides.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਾਠਿ ਨ ਛੂਟਈ ਭਾਈ ਥਾਕੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur gaaTh na chhooTiee bhaiee thaake karam kamai ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, the knots cannot be untied, O Siblings of Destiny; I am so tired of religious rituals.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: eih jag bharam bhulaiaa bhaiee kahanaa kichhoo na jai ||6||
verses.translation: This world is deluded by doubt, O Siblings of Destiny; no one can say anything about it. ||6||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਭਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਭਾਈ ਭੈ ਮਰਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur miliaai bhau man vasai bhaiee bhai maranaa sach lekh ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Guru, the Fear of God comes to abide in the mind; to die in the Fear of God is one's true destiny.

verses.original: ਮਜਨੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਭਾਈ ਦਰਗਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸੇਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: majan dhaan cha(n)giaaieeaa bhaiee dharageh naam visekh ||
verses.translation: In the Court of the Lord, the Naam is far superior to ritualistic cleansing baths, charity and good deeds, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਕਸੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਚੂਕਾ ਭੇਖੁ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: gur a(n)kas jin naam dhiraRaiaa bhaiee man vasiaa chookaa bhekh ||7||
verses.translation: One who implants the Naam within himself, through the Guru's halter - O Siblings of Destiny, the Lord dwells in his mind, and he is free of hypocrisy. ||7||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਾਟੁ ਸਰਾਫ ਕੋ ਭਾਈ ਵਖਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: eih tan haaT saraaf ko bhaiee vakhar naam apaar ||
verses.translation: This body is the jeweller's shop, O Siblings of Destiny; the incomparable Naam is the merchandise.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਸੋ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੈ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: eih vakhar vaapaaree so dhiraRai bhaiee gur sabadh kare veechaar ||
verses.translation: The merchant secures this merchandise, O Siblings of Destiny, by contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਭਾਈ ਮੇਲਿ ਕਰੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥੮॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhan vaapaaree naanakaa bhaiee mel kare vaapaar ||8||2||
verses.translation: Blessed is the merchant, O Nanak, who meets the Guru, and engages in this trade. ||8||2||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਕੇ ਸਾਥ ਤਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h)ee satigur seviaa piaare tin(h) ke saath tare ||
verses.translation: Those who serve the True Guru, O Beloved, their companions are saved as well.

verses.original: ਤਿਨੑਾ ਠਾਕ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸਨ ਹਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: tin(h)aa Thaak na paieeaai piaare a(n)mirat rasan hare ||
verses.translation: No one blocks their way, O Beloved, and the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar is on their tongue.

verses.original: ਬੂਡੇ ਭਾਰੇ ਭੈ ਬਿਨਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤਾਰੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: boodde bhaare bhai binaa piaare taare nadhar kare ||1||
verses.translation: Without the Fear of God, they are so heavy that they sink and drown, O Beloved; but the Lord, casting His Glance of Grace, carries them across. ||1||

verses.original: ਭੀ ਤੂਹੈ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਭੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਾਲਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: bhee toohai saalaahanaa piaare bhee teree saalaeh ||
verses.translation: I ever praise You, O Beloved, I ever sing Your Praises.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਭੈ ਡੁਬੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕੰਧੀ ਪਾਇ ਕਹਾਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: vin bohith bhai ddubeeaai piaare ka(n)dhee pai kahaeh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the boat, one is drowned in the sea of fear, O Beloved; how can I reach the distant shore? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: saalaahee saalaahanaa piaare dhoojaa avar na koi ||
verses.translation: I praise the Praiseworthy Lord, O Beloved; there is no other one to praise.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਲਾਹਨਿ ਸੇ ਭਲੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: mere prabh saalaahan se bhale piaare sabadh rate ra(n)g hoi ||
verses.translation: Those who praise my God are good, O Beloved; they are imbued with the Word of the Shabad, and His Love.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਸੁ ਲੈ ਤਤੁ ਵਿਲੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tis kee sa(n)gat je milai piaare ras lai tat viloi ||2||
verses.translation: If I join them, O Beloved, I can churn the essence and so find joy. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ਸਾਚ ਕਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: pat paravaanaa saach kaa piaare naam sachaa neesaan ||
verses.translation: The gateway to honor is Truth, O Beloved; it bears the Insignia of the True Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਆਇਆ ਲਿਖਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਵਣਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: aaiaa likh lai jaavanaa piaare hukamee hukam pachhaan ||
verses.translation: We come into the world, and we depart, with our destiny written and pre-ordained, O Beloved; realize the Command of the Commander.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur bin hukam na boojheeaai piaare saache saachaa taan ||3||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, this Command is not understood, O Beloved; True is the Power of the True Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਿੰਮਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਉਦਰ ਮਝਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: hukamai a(n)dhar ni(n)miaa piaare hukamai udhar majhaar ||
verses.translation: By His Command, we are conceived, O Beloved, and by His Command, we grow in the womb.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੰਮਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਊਧਉ ਸਿਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: hukamai a(n)dhar ja(n)miaa piaare uoodhau sir kai bhaar ||
verses.translation: By His Command, we are born, O Beloved, head-first, and upside-down.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਚਲੈ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gurmukh dharageh jaaneeaai piaare chalai kaaraj saar ||4||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is honored in the Court of the Lord, O Beloved; he departs after resolving his affairs. ||4||

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਜਾਦੋ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: hukamai a(n)dhar aaiaa piaare hukame jaadho jai ||
verses.translation: By His Command, one comes into the world, O Beloved, and by His Will, he goes.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਬੰਨਿੑ ਚਲਾਈਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਲਹੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: hukame ba(n)ni(h) chalaieeaai piaare manmukh lahai sajai ||
verses.translation: By His Will, some are bound and gagged and driven away, O Beloved; the self-willed manmukhs suffer their punishment.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: hukame sabadh pachhaaneeaai piaare dharageh paidhaa jai ||5||
verses.translation: By His Command, the Word of the Shabad, is realized, O Beloved, and one goes to the Court of the Lord robed in honor. ||5||

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਗਣਤ ਗਣਾਈਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: hukame ganat ganaieeaai piaare hukame haumai dhoi ||
verses.translation: By His Command, some accounts are accounted for, O Beloved; by His Command, some suffer in egotism and duality.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਭਵੈ ਭਵਾਈਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਅਵਗਣਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਰੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: hukame bhavai bhavaieeaai piaare avagan muThee roi ||
verses.translation: By His Command, one wanders in reincarnation, O Beloved; deceived by sins and demerits, he cries out in his suffering.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਿਞਾਪੈ ਸਾਹ ਕਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: hukam sin(j)aapai saeh kaa piaare sach milai vaddiaaiee hoi ||6||
verses.translation: If he comes to realize the Command of the Lord's Will, O Beloved, then he is blessed with Truth and Honor. ||6||

verses.original: ਆਖਣਿ ਅਉਖਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aakhan aaukhaa aakheeaai piaare kiau suneeaai sach naau ||
verses.translation: It is so difficult to speak it, O Beloved; how can we speak, and hear, the True Name?

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਉ ਤਿਨੑ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h)ee so saalaahiaa piaare hau tin(h) balihaarai jaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who praise the Lord, O Beloved.

verses.original: ਨਾਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆਂ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਦਰੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: naau milai sa(n)tokheeaa(n) piaare nadharee mel milaau ||7||
verses.translation: I have obtained the Name, and I am satisfied, O Beloved; by His Grace, I am united in His Union. ||7||

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਜੇ ਥੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਸਵਾਣੀ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa kaagadh je theeaai piaare man masavaanee dhaar ||
verses.translation: If my body were to become the paper, O Beloved, and my mind the inkpot;

verses.original: ਲਲਤਾ ਲੇਖਣਿ ਸਚ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਲਿਖਹੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: lalataa lekhan sach kee piaare har gun likhahu veechaar ||
verses.translation: and if my tongue became the pen, O Beloved, I would write, and contemplate, the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਲੇਖਾਰੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਲਿਖੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੮॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhan lekhaaree naanakaa piaare saach likhai ur dhaar ||8||3||
verses.translation: Blessed is that scribe, O Nanak, who writes the True Name, and enshrines it within his heart. ||8||3||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਪਹਿਲਾ ਦੁਤੁਕੀ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa pehilaa pahilaa dhutukee ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, First Mehla, Dho-Thukay:

verses.original: ਤੂ ਗੁਣਦਾਤੌ ਨਿਰਮਲੋ ਭਾਈ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: too gunadhaatau niramalo bhaiee niramal naa man hoi ||
verses.translation: You are the Giver of virtue, O Immaculate Lord, but my mind is not immaculate, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਨਿਰਗੁਣੇ ਭਾਈ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਗੁਣੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ham aparaadhee niragune bhaiee tujh hee te gun soi ||1||
verses.translation: I am a worthless sinner, O Siblings of Destiny; virtue is obtained from You alone, Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: mere preetamaa too karataa kar vekh ||
verses.translation: O my Beloved Creator Lord, You create, and You behold.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਪਾਪੀ ਪਾਖੰਡੀਆ ਭਾਈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਸੇਖੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau paapee paakha(n)ddeeaa bhaiee man tan naam visekh || rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am a hypocritical sinner, O Siblings of Destiny. Bless my mind and body with Your Name, O Lord. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਚਿਤੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bikh maiaa chit mohiaa bhaiee chaturaiee pat khoi ||
verses.translation: The poisonous Maya has enticed the consciousness, O Siblings of Destiny; through clever tricks, one loses his honor.

verses.original: ਚਿਤ ਮਹਿ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਚਿ ਵਸੈ ਭਾਈ ਜੇ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਮੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: chit meh Thaakur sach vasai bhaiee je gur giaan samoi ||2||
verses.translation: The True Lord and Master abides in the consciousness, O Siblings of Destiny, if the Guru's spiritual wisdom permeates it. ||2||

verses.original: ਰੂੜੌ ਰੂੜੌ ਆਖੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਰੂੜੌ ਲਾਲ ਚਲੂਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: rooRau rooRau aakheeaai bhaiee rooRau laal chalool ||
verses.translation: Beautiful, beautiful, the Lord is called, O Siblings of Destiny; beautiful, like the deep crimson color of the poppy.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਅਭੂਲੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: je man har siau bairaageeaai bhaiee dhar ghar saach abhool ||3||
verses.translation: If man loves the Lord with detachment, O Siblings of Destiny, he is judged to be true and infallible in the Lord's court and home. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਾਤਾਲੀ ਆਕਾਸਿ ਤੂ ਭਾਈ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਤੂ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: paataalee aakaas too bhaiee ghar ghar too gun giaan ||
verses.translation: You are pervading the realms of the underworld and the heavenly skies; Your wisdom and glories are in each and every heart.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਚੂਕਾ ਮਨਹੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gur miliaai sukh paiaa bhaiee chookaa manahu gumaan ||4||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Guru, one finds peace, O Siblings of Destiny, and pride is dispelled from the mind. ||4||

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਮਾਜੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਭੀ ਮੈਲਾ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jal mal kaiaa maajeeaai bhaiee bhee mailaa tan hoi ||
verses.translation: Scrubbing with water, the body can be cleaned, O Siblings of Destiny, but the body becomes dirty again.

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨਿ ਮਹਾ ਰਸਿ ਨਾਈਐ ਭਾਈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: giaan mahaa ras naieeaai bhaiee man tan niramal hoi ||5||
verses.translation: Bathing in the supreme essence of spiritual wisdom, O Siblings of Destiny, the mind and body become pure. ||5||

verses.original: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵਾ ਪੂਜੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਗਉ ਕਿਆ ਦੇਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhevee dhevaa poojeeaai bhaiee kiaa maagau kiaa dheh ||
verses.translation: Why worship gods and goddesses, O Siblings of Destiny? What can we ask of them? What can they give us?

verses.original: ਪਾਹਣੁ ਨੀਰਿ ਪਖਾਲੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਬੂਡਹਿ ਤੇਹਿ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: paahan neer pakhaaleeaai bhaiee jal meh booddeh teh ||6||
verses.translation: The stone gods are washed with water, O Siblings of Destiny, but they just sink in the water. ||6||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਜਗੁ ਬੂਡੈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur bin alakh na lakheeaai bhaiee jag booddai pat khoi ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, the unseen Lord cannot be seen, O Siblings of Destiny; the world is drowning, having lost its honor.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਾਥਿ ਵਡਾਈਆ ਭਾਈ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: mere Thaakur haath vaddaieeaa bhaiee jai bhaavai tai dhei ||7||
verses.translation: Greatness is in the hands of my Lord and Master, O Siblings of Destiny; as He is pleased, He gives. ||7||

verses.original: ਬਈਅਰਿ ਬੋਲੈ ਮੀਠੁਲੀ ਭਾਈ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bieear bolai meeThulee bhaiee saach kahai pir bhai ||
verses.translation: That soul-bride, who talks sweetly and speaks the Truth, O Siblings of Destiny, becomes pleasing to her Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਬਿਰਹੈ ਬੇਧੀ ਸਚਿ ਵਸੀ ਭਾਈ ਅਧਿਕ ਰਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: birahai bedhee sach vasee bhaiee adhik rahee har nai ||8||
verses.translation: Pierced by His Love, she abides in Truth, O Siblings of Destiny, deeply imbued with the Lord's Name. ||8||

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬੁਝੈ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ko aakhai aapanaa bhaiee gur te bujhai sujaan ||
verses.translation: Everyone calls God his own, O Siblings of Destiny, but the all-knowing Lord is known only through the Guru.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਬੀਧੇ ਸੇ ਊਬਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚਾ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: jo beedhe se uoobare bhaiee sabadh sachaa neesaan ||9||
verses.translation: Those who are pierced by His Love are saved, O Siblings of Destiny; they bear the Insignia of the True Word of the Shabad. ||9||

verses.original: ਈਧਨੁ ਅਧਿਕ ਸਕੇਲੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਰੰਚਕ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: e'eedhan adhik sakeleeaai bhaiee paavak ra(n)chak pai ||
verses.translation: A large pile of firewood, O Siblings of Destiny, will burn if a small fire is applied.

verses.original: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸੈ ਭਾਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲਣੁ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੧੦॥੪॥
verses.translit: khin pal naam ridhai vasai bhaiee naanak milan subhai ||10||4||
verses.translation: In the same way, if the Naam, the Name of the Lord, dwells in the heart for a moment, even for an instant, O Siblings of Destiny, then one meets the Lord with ease, O Nanak. ||10||4||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਤਿਤੁਕੀ
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa teejaa ghar pehilaa titukee
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Third Mehla, First House, Thi-Thukay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਭਗਤਾ ਦੀ ਸਦਾ ਤੂ ਰਖਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਤੂ ਰਖਦਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhagataa dhee sadhaa too rakhadhaa har jeeau dhur too rakhadhaa aaiaa ||
verses.translation: You always preserve the honor of Your devotees, O Dear Lord; You have protected them from the very beginning of time.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦ ਜਨ ਤੁਧੁ ਰਾਖਿ ਲਏ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਹਰਣਾਖਸੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਚਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: prahilaadh jan tudh raakh le har jeeau haranaakhas maar pachaiaa ||
verses.translation: You protected Your servant Prahlaad, O Dear Lord, and annihilated Harnaakhash.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gurmukhaa no parateet hai har jeeau manmukh bharam bhulaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs place their faith in the Dear Lord, but the self-willed manmukhs are deluded by doubt. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਏਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: har jee eh teree vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord, this is Your Glory.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੁ ਤੂ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhagataa kee paij rakh too suaamee bhagat teree saranaiee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: You preserve the honor of Your devotees, O Lord Master; Your devotees seek Your Sanctuary. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਭਗਤਾ ਨੋ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਨੇੜੈ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bhagataa no jam joh na saakai kaal na neRai jaiee ||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death cannot touch Your devotees; death cannot even approach them.

verses.original: ਕੇਵਲ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: keval raam naam man vasiaa naame hee mukat paiee ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord alone abides in their minds; through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they find liberation.

verses.original: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਸਭ ਭਗਤਾ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ridh sidh sabh bhagataa charanee laagee gur kai sahaj subhaiee ||2||
verses.translation: Wealth and all the spiritual powers of the Siddhis fall at the feet of the Lord's devotees; they obtain peace and poise from the Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: manmukhaa no parateet na aavee a(n)tar lobh suaau ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs have no faith; they are filled with greed and self-interest.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਭੇਦਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਾਗਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hiradhai sabadh na bhedhio har naam na laagaa bhaau ||
verses.translation: They are not Gurmukh - they do not understand the Word of the Shabad in their hearts; they do not love the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕੂੜ ਕਪਟ ਪਾਜੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਸੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫੀਕਾ ਅਲਾਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kooR kapaT paaj leh jaasee manmukh feekaa alaau ||3||
verses.translation: Their masks of falsehood and hypocrisy shall fall off; the self-willed manmukhs speak with insipid words. ||3||

verses.original: ਭਗਤਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਹੂ ਤੂ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: bhagataa vich aap varatadhaa prabh jee bhagatee hoo too jaataa ||
verses.translation: You are pervading through Your devotees, O Dear God; through Your devotees, You are known.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਸਭ ਲੋਕ ਹੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਏਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh sabh lok hai teree too eko purakh bidhaataa ||
verses.translation: All the people are enticed by Maya; they are Yours, Lord - You alone are the Architect of Destiny.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: haumai maar manasaa maneh samaanee gur kai sabadh pachhaataa ||4||
verses.translation: Overcoming my egotism and quieting the desires within my mind, I have come to realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||4||

verses.original: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: achi(n)t ka(n)m kareh prabh tin ke jin har kaa naam piaaraa ||
verses.translation: God automatically does the work of those who love the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh sadhaa man vasiaa sabh kaaj savaaranahaaraa ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, he ever dwells in their minds, and He resolves all their affairs.

verses.original: ਓਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੀਸ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਵਿਗੁਚੈ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੈ ਰਖਵਾਰਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: onaa kee rees kare su viguchai jin har prabh hai rakhavaaraa ||5||
verses.translation: Whoever challenges them is destroyed; they have the Lord God as their Savior. ||5||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭਉਕਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਲਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur seve kinai na paiaa manmukh bhauk mue bilalaiee ||
verses.translation: Without serving the True Guru, no one finds the Lord; the self-willed manmukhs die crying out in pain.

verses.original: ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦੁਖ ਮਹਿ ਦੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aaveh jaaveh Thaur na paaveh dhukh meh dhukh samaiee ||
verses.translation: They come and go, and find no place of rest; in pain and suffering, they perish.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hovai su a(n)mrit peevai sahaje saach samaiee ||6||
verses.translation: But one who becomes Gurmukh drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar, and is easily absorbed in the True Name. ||6||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਜੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur seve janam na chhoddai je anek karam karai adhikaiee ||
verses.translation: Without serving the True Guru, one cannot escape reincarnation, even by performing numerous rituals.

verses.original: ਵੇਦ ਪੜਹਿ ਤੈ ਵਾਦ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: vedh paReh tai vaadh vakhaaneh bin har pat gavaiee ||
verses.translation: Those who read the Vedas, and argue and debate without the Lord, lose their honor.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਚੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਜਿ ਛੂਟਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: sachaa satigur saachee jis baanee bhaj chhooTeh gur saranaiee ||7||
verses.translation: True is the True Guru, and True is the Word of His Bani; in the Guru's Sanctuary, one is saved. ||7||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jin har man vasiaa se dhar saache dhar saachai sachiaaraa ||
verses.translation: Those whose minds are filled with the Lord are judged as true in the Court of the Lord; they are hailed as true in the True Court.

verses.original: ਓਨਾ ਦੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਹੋਈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: onaa dhee sobhaa jug jug hoiee koi na meTanahaaraa ||
verses.translation: Their praises echo throughout the ages, and no one can erase them.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਾ ॥੮॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak tin kai sadh balihaarai jin har raakhiaa ur dhaaraa ||8||1||
verses.translation: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to those who enshrine the Lord within their hearts. ||8||1||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਦੁਤੁਕੀ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa teejaa dhutukee ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Third Mehla, Dho-Thukay:

verses.original: ਨਿਗੁਣਿਆ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਭਾਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: niguniaa no aape bakhas le bhaiee satigur kee sevaa lai ||
verses.translation: He Himself forgives the worthless, O Siblings of Destiny; He commits them to the service of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਊਤਮ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: satigur kee sevaa uootam hai bhaiee raam naam chit lai ||1||
verses.translation: Service to the True Guru is sublime, O Siblings of Destiny; through it, one's consciousness is attached to the Lord's Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau aape bakhas milai ||
verses.translation: The Dear Lord forgives, and unites with Himself.

verses.original: ਗੁਣਹੀਣ ਹਮ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਭਾਈ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਲਏ ਰਲਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gunaheen ham aparaadhee bhaiee poorai satigur le ralai || rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sinner, totally without virtue, O Siblings of Destiny; the Perfect True Guru has blended me. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਉਣ ਕਉਣ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਬਖਸਿਅਨੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: kaun kaun aparaadhee bakhasian piaare saachai sabadh veechaar ||
verses.translation: So many, so many sinners have been forgiven, O beloved one, by contemplating the True Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਭਾਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੇੜੈ ਚਾੜਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bhaujal paar utaarian bhaiee satigur beRai chaaR ||2||
verses.translation: They got on board the boat of the True Guru, who carried them across the terrifying world-ocean, O Siblings of Destiny. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨੂਰੈ ਤੇ ਕੰਚਨ ਭਏ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: manoorai te ka(n)chan bhe bhaiee gur paaras mel milai ||
verses.translation: I have been transformed from rusty iron into gold, O Siblings of Destiny, united in Union with the Guru, the Philosopher's Stone.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਨਾਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aap chhodd naau man vasiaa bhaiee jotee jot milai ||3||
verses.translation: Eliminating my self-conceit, the Name has come to dwell within my mind, O Siblings of Destiny; my light has merged in the Light. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਣੈ ਭਾਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau vaaree hau vaaranai bhaiee satigur kau sadh balihaarai jaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, I am a sacrifice, O Siblings of Destiny, I am forever a sacrifice to my True Guru.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naam nidhaan jin dhitaa bhaiee gurmat sahaj samaau ||4||
verses.translation: He has given me the treasure of the Naam; O Siblings of Destiny, through the Guru's Teachings, I am absorbed in celestial bliss. ||4||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਭਾਈ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਗਿਆਨੀਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur bin sahaj na uoopajai bhaiee poochhahu giaaneeaa jai ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, celestial peace is not produced, O Siblings of Destiny; go and ask the spiritual teachers about this.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: satigur kee sevaa sadhaa kar bhaiee vichahu aap gavai ||5||
verses.translation: Serve the True Guru forever, O Siblings of Destiny, and eradicate self-conceit from within. ||5||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਭਉ ਊਪਜੈ ਭਾਈ ਭਉ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmatee bhau uoopajai bhaiee bhau karanee sach saar ||
verses.translation: Under Guru's Instruction, the Fear of God is produced, O Siblings of Destiny; true and excellent are the deeds done in the Fear of God.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਭਾਈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: prem padhaarath paieeaai bhaiee sach naam aadhaar ||6||
verses.translation: Then, one is blessed with the treasure of the Lord's Love, O Siblings of Destiny, and the Support of the True Name. ||6||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਭਾਈ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jo satigur seveh aapanaa bhaiee tin kai hau laagau pai ||
verses.translation: I fall at the feet of those who serve their True Guru, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਭਾਈ ਕੁਲੁ ਭੀ ਲਈ ਬਖਸਾਇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: janam savaaree aapanaa bhaiee kul bhee liee bakhasai ||7||
verses.translation: I have fulfilled my life, O Siblings of Destiny, and my family has been saved as well. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sach baanee sach sabadh hai bhaiee gur kirapaa te hoi ||
verses.translation: The True Word of the Guru's Bani, and the True Word of the Shabad, O Siblings of Destiny, are obtained only by Guru's Grace.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਭਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੮॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam har man vasai bhaiee tis bighan na laagai koi ||8||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, with the Name of the Lord abiding in one's mind, no obstacles stand in one's way, O Siblings of Destiny. ||8||2||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਬਦੇ ਜਾਪਦਾ ਭਾਈ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau sabadhe jaapadhaa bhaiee poorai bhaag milai ||
verses.translation: The Dear Lord is realized through the Word of His Shabad, O Siblings of Destiny, which is found only by perfect destiny.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਭਾਈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਤੀਆ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sukh sohaaganee bhaiee anadhin rateeaa ra(n)g lai ||1||
verses.translation: The happy soul-brides are forever in peace, O Siblings of Destiny; night and day, they are attuned to the Lord's Love. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har jee too aape ra(n)g chaRai ||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord, You Yourself color us in Your Love.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਹੁ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਿਹੋ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gaavahu gaavahu ra(n)g raatiho bhaiee har setee ra(n)g lai || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Sing, continually sing His Praises, imbued with His Love, O Siblings of Destiny; be in love with the Lord. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਭਾਈ ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee kaar kamaavanee bhaiee aap chhodd chit lai ||
verses.translation: Work to serve the Guru, O Siblings of Destiny; abandon self-conceit, and focus your consciousness.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਹਜੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sahaj fir dhukh na lagiee bhaiee har aap vasai man aai ||2||
verses.translation: You shall be in peace forever, and you shall not suffer in pain any longer, O Siblings of Destiny; the Lord Himself shall come and abide in your mind. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਭਾਈ ਸਾ ਕੁਲਖਣੀ ਕੁਨਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: pir kaa hukam na jaaniee bhaiee saa kulakhanee kunaar ||
verses.translation: She who does not know the Will of her Husband Lord, O Siblings of Destiny, is an ill-mannered and bitter bride.

verses.original: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਭਾਈ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: manahaTh kaar kamaavanee bhaiee vin naavai kooRiaar ||3||
verses.translation: She does things with a stubborn mind, O Siblings of Destiny; without the Name, she is false. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੇ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਭਾਇ ਸਚੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: se gaaveh jin masatak bhaag hai bhaiee bhai sachai bairaag ||
verses.translation: They alone sing the Lord's Praises, who have such pre-ordained destiny written upon their foreheads, O Siblings of Destiny; through the Love of the True Lord, they find detachment.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹਿ ਭਾਈ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਗੁਰ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: anadhin raate gun raveh bhaiee nirabhau gur liv laag ||4||
verses.translation: Night and day, they are imbued with His Love; they utter His Glorious Praises, O Siblings of Destiny, and they lovingly focus their consciousness on the Fearless Guru. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲਦਾ ਭਾਈ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa maar jeevaaladhaa bhaiee so sevahu dhin raat ||
verses.translation: He kills and revives all, O Siblings of Destiny; serve Him, day and night.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡੀ ਹੈ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: so kiau manahu visaareeaai bhaiee jis dhee vaddee hai dhaat ||5||
verses.translation: How can we forget Him from our minds, O Siblings of Destiny? His gifts are glorious and great. ||5||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੈਲੀ ਡੁੰਮਣੀ ਭਾਈ ਦਰਗਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh mailee ddu(n)manee bhaiee dharageh naahee thaau ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh is filthy and double-minded, O Siblings of Destiny; the finds no place of rest in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਤ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਭਾਈ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hovai ta gun ravai bhaiee mil preetam saach samaau ||6||
verses.translation: But if she becomes Gurmukh, then she chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny; the meets her True Beloved, and merges in Him. ||6||

verses.original: ਏਤੁ ਜਨਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਭਾਈ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: et janam har na chetio bhaiee kiaa muh dhesee jai ||
verses.translation: In this life, she has not focused her consciousness on the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny; how can she show her face when she leaves?

verses.original: ਕਿੜੀ ਪਵੰਦੀ ਮੁਹਾਇਓਨੁ ਭਾਈ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਨੋ ਲੋਭਾਇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: kiRee pava(n)dhee muhaion bhaiee bikhiaa no lobhai ||7||
verses.translation: In spite of the warning calls which were sounded, she has been plundered, O Siblings of Destiny; she yearned only for corruption. ||7||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਹਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਭਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: naam samaaleh sukh vaseh bhaiee sadhaa sukh saa(n)t sareer ||
verses.translation: Those who dwell upon the Naam, O Siblings of Destiny, their bodies are ever peaceful and tranquil.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂ ਭਾਈ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰ ॥੮॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak naam samaal too bhaiee apara(n)par gunee gaheer ||8||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, dwell upon the Naam; the Lord is infinite, virtuous and unfathomable, O Siblings of Destiny. ||8||3||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ghar pehilaa asaTapadheeaa
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla, First House, Ashtpadheeyaa:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਿਨਹਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabh jag jineh upaiaa bhaiee karan kaaran samarath ||
verses.translation: The One who created the whole world, O Siblings of Destiny, is the Almighty Lord, the Cause of causes.

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਅਪਣੀ ਵਥੁ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau pi(n)dd jin saajiaa bhaiee dhe kar apanee vath ||
verses.translation: He fashioned the soul and the body, O Siblings of Destiny, by His own power.

verses.original: ਕਿਨਿ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਕਰਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਅਕਥੁ ॥
verses.translit: kin kaheeaai kiau dhekheeaai bhaiee karataa ek akath ||
verses.translation: How can He be described? How can He be seen, O Siblings of Destiny? The Creator is One; He is indescribable.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਜਾਪੈ ਤਥੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur govi(n)dh salaaheeaai bhaiee jis te jaapai tath ||1||
verses.translation: Praise the Guru, the Lord of the Universe, O Siblings of Destiny; through Him, the essence is known. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: mere man japeeaai har bhagava(n)taa ||
verses.translation: O my mind, meditate on the Lord, the Lord God.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਜਨ ਅਪਨੇ ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਕਾ ਹੰਤਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naam dhaan dhei jan apane dhookh dharadh kaa ha(n)taa || rahaau ||
verses.translation: He blesses His servant with the gift of the Naam; He is the Destroyer of pain and suffering. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai ghar sabh kichh hai bhaiee nau nidh bhare bha(n)ddaar ||
verses.translation: Everything is in His home, O Siblings of Destiny; His warehouse is overflowing with the nine treasures.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਭਾਈ ਊਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: tis kee keemat naa pavai bhaiee uoochaa agam apaar ||
verses.translation: His worth cannot be estimated, O Siblings of Destiny; He is lofty, inaccessible and infinite.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਦਾ ਭਾਈ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਕਰਦਾ ਸਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t pratipaaladhaa bhaiee nit nit karadhaa saar ||
verses.translation: He cherishes all beings and creatures, O Siblings of Destiny; he continually takes care of them.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਹਾਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: satigur pooraa bheTeeaai bhaiee sabadh milaavanahaar ||2||
verses.translation: So meet with the Perfect True Guru, O Siblings of Destiny, and merge in the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਚੇ ਚਰਣ ਸਰੇਵੀਅਹਿ ਭਾਈ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: sache charan sareve'eeh bhaiee bhram bhau hovai naas ||
verses.translation: Adoring the feet of the True Guru, O Siblings of Destiny, doubt and fear are dispelled.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਂਜੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: mil sa(n)t sabhaa man maa(n)jeeaai bhaiee har kai naam nivaas ||
verses.translation: Joining the Society of the Saints, cleanse your mind, O Siblings of Destiny, and dwell in the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਮਿਟੈ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਅਗਿਆਨਤਾ ਭਾਈ ਕਮਲ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: miTai a(n)dheraa agiaanataa bhaiee kamal hovai paragaas ||
verses.translation: The darkness of ignorance shall be dispelled, O Siblings of Destiny, and the lotus of your heart shall blossom forth.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਭਾਈ ਸਭਿ ਫਲ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur bachanee sukh uoopajai bhaiee sabh fal satigur paas ||3||
verses.translation: By the Guru's Word, peace wells up, O Siblings of Destiny; all fruits are with the True Guru. ||3||

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਛੋਡੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਹੋਈਐ ਸਭ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: meraa teraa chhoddeeaai bhaiee hoieeaai sabh kee dhoor ||
verses.translation: Give up your sense of mine and yours, O Siblings of Destiny, and become the dust of the feet of all.

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਪੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੈ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT braham pasaariaa bhaiee pekhai sunai hajoor ||
verses.translation: In each and every heart, God is contained, O Siblings of Destiny; He sees, and hears, and is ever-present with us.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਭਾਈ ਤਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਮਰੀਐ ਝੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jit dhin visarai paarabraham bhaiee tit dhin mareeaai jhoor ||
verses.translation: On that day when one forgets the Supreme Lord God, O Siblings of Destiny, on that day, one ought to die crying out in pain.

verses.original: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਸਮਰਥੋ ਭਾਈ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: karan karaavan samaratho bhaiee sarab kalaa bharapoor ||4||
verses.translation: He is the all-powerful Cause of Causes, O Siblings of Destiny; he is totally filled with all powers. ||4||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: prem padhaarath naam hai bhaiee maiaa moh binaas ||
verses.translation: The Love of the Name is the greatest treasure, O Siblings of Destiny; through it, emotional attachment to Maya is dispelled.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਭਾਈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: tis bhaavai taa mel le bhaiee hiradhai naam nivaas ||
verses.translation: If it is pleasing to His Will, then He unites us in His Union, O Siblings of Destiny; the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to abide in the mind.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਰਿਦੈ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh kamal pragaaseeaai bhaiee ridhai hovai paragaas ||
verses.translation: The heart-lotus of the Gurmukh blossoms forth, O Siblings of Destiny, and the heart is illumined.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਭਇਆ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਈ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਧਰਤਿ ਅਕਾਸੁ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: pragaT bhiaa parataap prabh bhaiee mauliaa dharat akaas ||5||
verses.translation: The Glory of God has been revealed, O Siblings of Destiny, and the earth and sky have blossomed forth. ||5||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸੰਤੋਖਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai sa(n)tokhiaa bhaiee ahinis laagaa bhaau ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has blessed me with contentment, O Siblings of Destiny; day and night, I remain attached to the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਭਾਈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਦੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: rasanaa raam ravai sadhaa bhaiee saachaa saadh suaau ||
verses.translation: My tongue continually chants the Lord's Name, O Siblings of Destiny; this is the true taste, and the object of human life.

verses.original: ਕਰਨੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਥਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: karanee sun sun jeeviaa bhaiee nihachal paiaa thaau ||
verses.translation: Listening with my ears, I hear and so I live, O Siblings of Destiny; I have obtained the unchanging, unmoving state.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਭਾਈ ਸੋ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: jis parateet na aaviee bhaiee so jeeaRaa jal jaau ||6||
verses.translation: That soul,which does not place its faith in the Lord shall burn, O Siblings of Destiny. ||6||

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬੈ ਭਾਈ ਹਉ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bahu gun mere saahibai bhaiee hau tis kai bal jaau ||
verses.translation: My Lord and Master has so many virtues, O Siblings of Destiny; I am a sacrifice to Him.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਨਿਰਗੁਣੀਆਰੇ ਪਾਲਦਾ ਭਾਈ ਦੇਇ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਥਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: oh niraguneeaare paaladhaa bhaiee dhei nithaave thaau ||
verses.translation: He nurtures even the most worthless, O Siblings of Destiny, and gives home to the homeless.

verses.original: ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹੇ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਭਾਈ ਗੂੜਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: rijak sa(n)baahe saas saas bhaiee gooRaa jaa kaa naau ||
verses.translation: He gives us nourishment with each and every breath, O Siblings of Destiny; His Name is everlasting.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਪੂਰਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਰਮਾਉ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: jis gur saachaa bheTeeaai bhaiee pooraa tis karamaau ||7||
verses.translation: One who meets with the True Guru, O Siblings of Destiny, does so only by perfect destiny. ||7||

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜੀਵੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: tis bin ghaRee na jeeveeaai bhaiee sarab kalaa bharapoor ||
verses.translation: Without Him, I cannot live, even for an instant, O Siblings of Destiny; He is totally filled with all powers.

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਭਾਈ ਪੇਖਉ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: saas giraas na visarai bhaiee pekhau sadhaa hajoor ||
verses.translation: With every breath and morsel of food, I will not forget Him, O Siblings of Destiny; I behold Him ever-present.

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਸਰਬ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: saadhoo sa(n)g milaiaa bhaiee sarab rahiaa bharapoor ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I meet Him, O Siblings of Destiny; He is totally pervading and permeating everywhere.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਲਗੀਆ ਭਾਈ ਸੇ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਮਰਦੇ ਝੂਰਿ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: jinaa preet na lageeaa bhaiee se nit nit maradhe jhoor ||8||
verses.translation: Those who do not embrace love for the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny, always die crying out in pain. ||8||

verses.original: ਅੰਚਲਿ ਲਾਇ ਤਰਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)chal lai taraiaa bhaiee bhaujal dhukh sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: Grasping hold of the hem of His robe, O Siblings of Destiny, we are carried across the world-ocean of fear and pain.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਅੰਗੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa nadhar nihaaliaa bhaiee keeton a(n)g apaar ||
verses.translation: By His Glance of Grace, He has blessed us, O Siblings of Destiny; He shall be with us until the very end.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: man tan seetal hoiaa bhaiee bhojan naam adhaar ||
verses.translation: My mind and body are soothed and calmed, O Siblings of Destiny, nourished by the food of the Naam.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਭਾਈ ਜਿ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੯॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak tis saranaagatee bhaiee j kilabikh kaaTanahaar ||9||1||
verses.translation: Nanak has entered His Sanctuary, O Siblings of Destiny; the Lord is the Destroyer of sins. ||9||1||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਦੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੋ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤਹ ਅਪਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: maat garabh dhukh saagaro piaare teh apanaa naam japaiaa ||
verses.translation: The womb of the mother is an ocean of pain, O Beloved; even there, the Lord causes His Name to be chanted.

verses.original: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਪਸਰੀਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: baahar kaadd bikh pasareeaa piaare maiaa moh vadhaiaa ||
verses.translation: When he emerges, he finds corruption pervading everywhere, O Beloved, and he becomes increasingly attached to Maya.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕੀਤੋ ਕਰਮੁ ਆਪਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jis no keeto karam aap piaare tis pooraa guroo milaiaa ||
verses.translation: One whom the Lord blesses with His kind favor, O Beloved, meets the Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: so aaraadhe saas saas piaare raam naam liv laiaa ||1||
verses.translation: He worships the Lord in adoration with each and every breath, O Beloved; he is lovingly attached to the Lord's Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
verses.translit: man tan teree Tek hai piaare man tan teree Tek ||
verses.translation: You are the support of my mind and body, O Beloved; You are the support of my mind and body.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਨਹਾਰੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਏਕ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tudh bin avar na karanahaar piaare a(n)tarajaamee ek || rahaau ||
verses.translation: There is no other Creator except for You, O Beloved; You alone are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਇਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: koT janam bhram aaiaa piaare anik jon dhukh pai ||
verses.translation: After wandering in doubt for millions of incarnations, he comes into the world, O Beloved; for uncounted lifetimes, he has suffered in pain.

verses.original: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: saachaa saahib visariaa piaare bahutee milai sajai ||
verses.translation: He has forgotten his True Lord and Master, O Beloved, and so he suffers terrible punishment.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਭੇਟੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੇ ਲਾਗੇ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jin bheTai pooraa satiguroo piaare se laage saachai nai ||
verses.translation: Those who meet with the Perfect True Guru, O Beloved, are attached to the True Name.

verses.original: ਤਿਨਾ ਪਿਛੈ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੋ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tinaa pichhai chhuTeeaai piaare jo saachee saranai ||2||
verses.translation: We are saved by following those, O Beloved, who seek the Sanctuary of the True Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਿਠਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਖਾਇਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: miThaa kar kai khaiaa piaare tin tan keetaa rog ||
verses.translation: He thinks that his food is so sweet, O Beloved, but it makes his body ill.

verses.original: ਕਉੜਾ ਹੋਇ ਪਤਿਸਟਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: kauRaa hoi patisaTiaa piaare tis te upajiaa sog ||
verses.translation: It turns out to be bitter, O Beloved, and it produces only sadness.

verses.original: ਭੋਗ ਭੁੰਚਾਇ ਭੁਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਉਤਰੈ ਨਹੀ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhog bhu(n)chai bhulaian piaare utarai nahee vijog ||
verses.translation: The Lord leads him astray in the enjoyment of pleasures, O Beloved, and so his sense of separation does not depart.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਉਧਾਰਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਧੁਰੇ ਪਇਆ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jo gur mel udhaariaa piaare tin dhure piaa sa(n)jog ||3||
verses.translation: Those who meet the Guru are saved, O Beloved; this is their pre-ordained destiny. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਅਟਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਮੂਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa laalach aTiaa piaare chit na aaveh mool ||
verses.translation: He is filled with longing for Maya, O Beloved, and so the Lord does not ever come into his mind.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਤੂ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੇ ਤਨ ਹੋਏ ਧੂੜਿ ॥
verses.translit: jin too visareh paarabraham suaamee se tan hoe dhooR ||
verses.translation: Those who forget You, O Supreme Lord Master, their bodies turn to dust.

verses.original: ਬਿਲਲਾਟ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਉਤਰੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੂਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: bilalaaT kareh bahuteriaa piaare utarai naahee sool ||
verses.translation: They cry out and scream horribly, O Beloved, but their torment does not end.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਰਹਿਆ ਮੂਲੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jo gur mel savaariaa piaare tin kaa rahiaa mool ||4||
verses.translation: Those who meet the Guru, and reform themselves, O Beloved, their capital remains intact. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਕੀਜਈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੇ ਕਾ ਪਾਰਿ ਵਸਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: saakat sa(n)g na keejiee piaare je kaa paar vasai ||
verses.translation: As far as possible, do not associate with the faithless cynics, O Beloved.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੋੁ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jis miliaai har visarai piaare suo muh kaalai uTh jai ||
verses.translation: Meeting with them, the Lord is forgotten, O Beloved, and you rise and depart with a blackened face.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਢੋਈ ਨਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh ddoiee neh milai piaare dharageh milai sajai ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh finds no rest or shelter, O Beloved; in the Court of the Lord, they are punished.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤਿਨਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: jo gur mel savaariaa piaare tinaa pooree pai ||5||
verses.translation: Those who meet with the Guru, and reform themselves, O Beloved, their affairs are resolved. ||5||

verses.original: ਸੰਜਮ ਸਹਸ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਇਕ ਨ ਚਲੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)jam sahas siaanapaa piaare ik na chalee naal ||
verses.translation: One may have thousands of clever tricks and techniques of austere self-discipline, O Beloved, but not even one of them will go with him.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਬੇਮੁਖ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਤੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੁਲਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਗਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: jo bemukh gobi(n)dh te piaare tin kul laagai gaal ||
verses.translation: Those who turn their backs on the Lord of the Universe, O Beloved, their families are stained with disgrace.

verses.original: ਹੋਦੀ ਵਸਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਤੀਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕੂੜੁ ਨ ਚਲੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: hodhee vasat na jaateeaa piaare kooR na chalee naal ||
verses.translation: They do not realize that they do have Him , O Beloved; falsehood will not go with them.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਿਲਾਇਓਨੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: satigur jinaa milaion piaare saachaa naam samaal ||6||
verses.translation: Those who meet with the True Guru, O Beloved, dwell upon the True Name. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sat sa(n)tokh giaan dhiaan piaare jis no nadhar kare ||
verses.translation: When the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, O Beloved, one is blessed with Truth, contentment, wisdom and meditation.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪੂਰ ਭਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin keeratan gun ravai piaare a(n)mirat poor bhare ||
verses.translation: Night and day, he sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, O Beloved, totally filled with Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਿਨ ਲੰਘਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh saagar tin la(n)ghiaa piaare bhavajal paar pare ||
verses.translation: He crosses over the sea of pain, O Beloved, and swims across the terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੇਈ ਸਦਾ ਖਰੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: jis bhaavai tis mel laih piaare seiee sadhaa khare ||7||
verses.translation: One who is pleasing to His Will, He unites with Himself, O Beloved; he is forever true. ||7||

verses.original: ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਦੇਉ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਭਗਤਾ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)mrath purakh dhiaal dheau piaare bhagataa tis kaa taan ||
verses.translation: The all-powerful Divine Lord is compassionate, O Beloved; He is the Support of His devotees.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਢਹਿ ਪਏ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਿ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: tis saranaiee ddeh pe piaare j a(n)tarajaamee jaan ||
verses.translation: I seek His Sanctuary, O Beloved; He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

verses.original: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਸਚੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: halat palat savaariaa piaare masatak sach neesaan ||
verses.translation: He has adorned me in this world and the next, O Beloved; He has placed the Emblem of Truth upon my forehead.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥੮॥੨॥
verses.translit: so prabh kadhe na veesarai piaare naanak sadh kurabaan ||8||2||
verses.translation: I shall never forget that God, O Beloved; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||8||2||

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ
verses.translit: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ghar doojaa asaTapadheeaa
verses.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla, Second House, Ashtpadheeyaa:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਪਾਠੁ ਪੜਿਓ ਅਰੁ ਬੇਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਨਿਵਲਿ ਭੁਅੰਗਮ ਸਾਧੇ ॥
verses.translit: paaTh paRio ar bedh beechaario nival bhua(n)gam saadhe ||
verses.translation: They read scriptures, and contemplate the Vedas; they practice the inner cleansing techniques of Yoga, and control of the breath.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਛੁਟਕਿਓ ਅਧਿਕ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਬਾਧੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch janaa siau sa(n)g na chhuTakio adhik aha(n)budh baadhe ||1||
verses.translation: But they cannot escape from the company of the five passions; they are increasingly bound to egotism. ||1||

verses.original: ਪਿਆਰੇ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਮੈ ਕੀਏ ਕਰਮ ਅਨੇਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: piaare in bidh milan na jaiee mai ke'ee karam anekaa ||
verses.translation: O Beloved, this is not the way to meet the Lord; I have performed these rituals so many times.

verses.original: ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੈ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਦੀਜੈ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਬੇਕਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: haar pario suaamee kai dhuaarai dheejai budh bibekaa || rahaau ||
verses.translation: I have collapsed, exhausted, at the Door of my Lord Master; I pray that He may grant me a discerning intellect. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੋਨਿ ਭਇਓ ਕਰਪਾਤੀ ਰਹਿਓ ਨਗਨ ਫਿਰਿਓ ਬਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: mon bhio karapaatee rahio nagan firio ban maahee ||
verses.translation: One may remain silent and use his hands as begging bowls, and wander naked in the forest.

verses.original: ਤਟ ਤੀਰਥ ਸਭ ਧਰਤੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਓ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਛੁਟਕੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: taT teerath sabh dharatee bhramio dhubidhaa chhuTakai naahee ||2||
verses.translation: He may make pilgrimages to river banks and sacred shrines all over the world, but his sense of duality will not leave him. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਤੀਰਥ ਜਾਇ ਬਸਿਓ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਵਤ ਧਰਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: man kaamanaa teerath jai basio sir karavat dharaae ||
verses.translation: His mind's desires may lead him to go and dwell at sacred places of pilgrimage, and offer his head to be sawn off;

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਜੇ ਲਖ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: man kee mail na utarai ieh bidh je lakh jatan karaae ||3||
verses.translation: but this will not cause the filth of his mind to depart, even though he may make thousands of efforts. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਨਿਕ ਕਾਮਿਨੀ ਹੈਵਰ ਗੈਵਰ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kanik kaaminee haivar gaivar bahu bidh dhaan dhaataaraa ||
verses.translation: He may give gifts of all sorts - gold, women, horses and elephants.

verses.original: ਅੰਨ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਭੂਮਿ ਬਹੁ ਅਰਪੇ ਨਹ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: a(n)n basatr bhoom bahu arape neh mileeaai har dhuaaraa ||4||
verses.translation: He may make offerings of corn, clothes and land in abundance, but this will not lead him to the Lord's Door. ||4||

verses.original: ਪੂਜਾ ਅਰਚਾ ਬੰਦਨ ਡੰਡਉਤ ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਰਤੁ ਰਹਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: poojaa arachaa ba(n)dhan dda(n)ddaut khaT karamaa rat rahataa ||
verses.translation: He may remain devoted to worship and adoration, bowing his forehead to the floor, practicing the six religious rituals.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ ਬੰਧਨ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਿਆ ਨਹ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਇਹ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: hau hau karat ba(n)dhan meh pariaa neh mileeaai ieh jugataa ||5||
verses.translation: He indulges in egotism and pride, and falls into entanglements, but he does not meet the Lord by these devices. ||5||

verses.original: ਜੋਗ ਸਿਧ ਆਸਣ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਏ ਭੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jog sidh aasan chauraaseeh e bhee kar kar rahiaa ||
verses.translation: He practices the eighty-four postures of Yoga, and acquires the supernatural powers of the Siddhas, but he gets tired of practicing these.

verses.original: ਵਡੀ ਆਰਜਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਗਹਿਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: vaddee aarajaa fir fir janamai har siau sa(n)g na gahiaa ||6||
verses.translation: He lives a long life, but is reincarnated again and again; he has not met with the Lord. ||6||

verses.original: ਰਾਜ ਲੀਲਾ ਰਾਜਨ ਕੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਕਰਿਆ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਅਫਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: raaj leelaa raajan kee rachanaa kariaa hukam afaaraa ||
verses.translation: He may enjoy princely pleasures, and regal pomp and ceremony, and issue unchallenged commands.

verses.original: ਸੇਜ ਸੋਹਨੀ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਚੋਆ ਨਰਕ ਘੋਰ ਕਾ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: sej sohanee cha(n)dhan choaa narak ghor kaa dhuaaraa ||7||
verses.translation: He may lie on beautiful beds, perfumed with sandalwood oil, but this will led him only to the gates of the most horrible hell. ||7||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਮਨ ਕੈ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: har keerat saadhasa(n)gat hai sir karaman kai karamaa ||
verses.translation: Singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is the highest of all actions.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਇਓ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਪੁਰਬ ਲਿਖੇ ਕਾ ਲਹਨਾ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak tis bhio paraapat jis purab likhe kaa lahanaa ||8||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, he alone obtains it, who is pre-destined to receive it. ||8||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਇਹ ਰੰਗਿ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: tero sevak ieh ra(n)g maataa ||
verses.translation: Your slave is intoxicated with this Love of Yours.

verses.original: ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥੩॥
verses.translit: bhio kirapaal dheen dhukh bha(n)jan har har keeratan ih man raataa || rahaau dhoojaa ||1||3||
verses.translation: The Destroyer of the pains of the poor has become merciful to me, and this mind is imbued with the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||Second Pause||1||3||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲੇ ੪ ਕੀ
verses.translit: raag soraTh vaar mahale 4 kee
verses.translation: Vaar Of Raag Sorat'h, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਜੇ ਸਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh sadhaa suhaavanee je sachaa man hoi ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h is always beautiful, if it brings the True Lord to dwell in the mind of the soul-bride.

verses.original: ਦੰਦੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਕਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਜੀਭੈ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)dhee mail na kat man jeebhai sachaa soi ||
verses.translation: Her teeth are clean and her mind is not split by duality; the Name of the True Lord is on her tongue.

verses.original: ਸਸੁਰੈ ਪੇਈਐ ਭੈ ਵਸੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਨਿਸੰਗ ॥
verses.translit: sasurai peieeaai bhai vasee satigur sev nisa(n)g ||
verses.translation: Here and hereafter, she abides in the Fear of God, and serves the True Guru without hesitation.

verses.original: ਪਰਹਰਿ ਕਪੜੁ ਜੇ ਪਿਰ ਮਿਲੈ ਖੁਸੀ ਰਾਵੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: parahar kapaR je pir milai khusee raavai pir sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: Discarding worldly adornments, she meets her Husband Lord, and she celebrates joyfully with Him.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸੀਗਾਰੀ ਨਾਉ ਮਨਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਮੈਲੁ ਪਤੰਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa seegaaree naau man kadhe na mail pata(n)g ||
verses.translation: She is adorned forever with the Name in her mind, and she does not have even an iota of filth.

verses.original: ਦੇਵਰ ਜੇਠ ਮੁਏ ਦੁਖਿ ਸਸੂ ਕਾ ਡਰੁ ਕਿਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhevar jeTh mue dhukh sasoo kaa ddar kis ||
verses.translation: Her husband's younger and elder brothers, the corrupt desires, have died, suffering in pain; and now, who fears Maya, the mother-in-law?

verses.original: ਜੇ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਕਰਮ ਮਣੀ ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: je pir bhaavai naanakaa karam manee sabh sach ||1||
verses.translation: If she becomes pleasing to her Husband Lord, O Nanak, she bears the jewel of good karma upon her forehead, and everything is Truth to her. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਤਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਢੰਢੋਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: soraTh taam suhaavanee jaa har naam dda(n)ddole ||
verses.translation: Sorat'h is beautiful only when it leads the soul-bride to seek the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਨਾਵੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur purakh manaavai aapanaa gurmatee har har bole ||
verses.translation: She pleases her Guru and God; under Guru's Instruction, she speaks the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਕਸਾਈ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਚੋਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: har prem kasaiee dhinas raat har ratee har ra(n)g chole ||
verses.translation: She is attracted to the Lord's Name, day and night, and her body is drenched in the color of the Love of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੈਸਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਜਗਤੁ ਮੈ ਟੋਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: har jaisaa purakh na labhiee sabh dhekhiaa jagat mai Tole ||
verses.translation: No other being like the Lord God can be found; I have looked and searched over the whole world.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਡੋਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur satigur naam dhiraRaiaa man anat na kaahoo ddole ||
verses.translation: The Guru, the True Guru, has implanted the Naam within me; my mind does not waver any more.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਗੋਲ ਗੋਲੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak har kaa dhaas hai gur satigur ke gol gole ||2||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak is the Lord's slave, the slave of the slaves of the Guru, the True Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: too aape sisaT karataa sirajanahaariaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the Creator, the Fashioner of the world.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: tudh aape khel rachai tudh aap savaariaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself have arranged the play, and You Yourself arrange it.

verses.original: ਦਾਤਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਭੋਗਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhaataa karataa aap aap bhoganahaariaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the Giver and the Creator; You Yourself are the Enjoyer.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਉਪਾਵਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh teraa sabadh varatai upaavanahaariaa ||
verses.translation: The Word of Your Shabad is pervading everywhere, O Creator Lord.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hau gurmukh sadhaa salaahee gur kau vaariaa ||1||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, I ever praise the Lord; I am a sacrifice to the Guru. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਲਤੇ ਜਲਿ ਮੁਏ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਏ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: haumai jalate jal mue bhram aae dhoojai bhai ||
verses.translation: In the flames of egotism, he is burnt to death; he wanders in doubt and the love of duality.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਆਪਣੈ ਪੰਨੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: poorai satigur raakh le'ee aapanai pa(n)nai pai ||
verses.translation: The Perfect True Guru saves him, making him His own.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਲਤਾ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eih jag jalataa nadharee aaiaa gur kai sabadh subhai ||
verses.translation: This world is burning; through the Sublime Word of the Guru's Shabad, this comes to be seen.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਸੀਤਲ ਭਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sabadh rate se seetal bhe naanak sach kamai ||1||
verses.translation: Those who are attuned to the Shabad are cooled and soothed; O Nanak, they practice Truth. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਫਲਿਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: safalio satigur seviaa dha(n)n janam paravaan ||
verses.translation: Service to the True Guru is fruitful and rewarding; blessed and acceptable is such a life.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਮੁਇਆ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸੇਈ ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਜਾਣ ॥
verses.translit: jinaa satigur jeevadhiaa muiaa na visarai seiee purakh sujaan ||
verses.translation: Those who do not forget the True Guru, in life and in death, are truly wise people.

verses.original: ਕੁਲੁ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: kul udhaare aapanaa so jan hovai paravaan ||
verses.translation: Their families are saved, and they are approved by the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਏ ਜੀਵਦੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹਹਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh mue jeevadhe paravaan heh manmukh janam maraeh ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs are approved in death as in life, while the self-willed manmukhs continue the cycle of birth and death.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁਏ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਜਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak mue na aakhe'eeh j gur kai sabadh samaeh ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they are not described as dead, who are absorbed in the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: har purakh nira(n)jan sev har naam dhiaaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Serve the Immaculate Lord God, and meditate on the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਲਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat saadhoo lag har naam samaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Join the Society of the Holy Saints, and be absorbed in the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡੀ ਕਾਰ ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: har teree vaddee kaar mai moorakh laieeaai ||
verses.translation: O Lord, glorious and great is service to You; I am so foolish

verses.original: ਹਉ ਗੋਲਾ ਲਾਲਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਮੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: hau golaa laalaa tudh mai hukam furamaieeaai ||
verses.translation: - please, commit me to it. I am Your servant and slave; command me, according to Your Will.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਾ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: hau gurmukh kaar kamaavaa j gur samajhaieeaai ||2||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, I shall serve You, as Guru has instructed me. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਜਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਲਿਖਿਆਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: poorab likhiaa kamaavanaa j karatai aap likhiaas ||
verses.translation: He acts according to pre-ordained destiny, written by the Creator Himself.

verses.original: ਮੋਹ ਠਗਉਲੀ ਪਾਈਅਨੁ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: moh Thagaulee paieean visariaa gunataas ||
verses.translation: Emotional attachment has drugged him, and he has forgotten the Lord, the treasure of virtue.

verses.original: ਮਤੁ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਵਦਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਮੁਇਆਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: mat jaanahu jag jeevadhaa dhoojai bhai muiaas ||
verses.translation: Don't think that he is alive in the world - he is dead, through the love of duality.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਸੇ ਬਹਣਿ ਨ ਮਿਲਨੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: jinee gurmukh naam na chetio se bahan na milanee paas ||
verses.translation: Those who do not meditate on the Lord, as Gurmukh, are not permitted to sit near the Lord.

verses.original: ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਬਹੁ ਅਤਿ ਘਣਾ ਪੁਤੁ ਕਲਤੁ ਨ ਸਾਥਿ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh laagaa bahu at ghanaa put kalat na saath koiee jaas ||
verses.translation: They suffer the most horrible pain and suffering, and neither their sons nor their wives go along with them.

verses.original: ਲੋਕਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਮੁਹੁ ਕਾਲਾ ਹੋਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਉਭੇ ਸਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: lokaa vich muh kaalaa hoaa a(n)dhar ubhe saas ||
verses.translation: Their faces are blackened among men, and they sigh in deep regret.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਕੋ ਨ ਵਿਸਹੀ ਚੁਕਿ ਗਇਆ ਵੇਸਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: manmukhaa no ko na visahee chuk giaa vesaas ||
verses.translation: No one places any reliance in the self-willed manmukhs; trust in them is lost.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਅਗਲਾ ਜਿਨਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukhaa no sukh agalaa jinaa a(n)tar naam nivaas ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs live in absolute peace; the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides within them. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੇ ਸੈਣ ਸੇ ਸਜਣਾ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: se sain se sajanaa j gurmukh mileh subhai ||
verses.translation: They alone are relatives, and they alone are friends, who, as Gurmukh, join together in love.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kaa bhaanaa anadhin kareh se sach rahe samai ||
verses.translation: Night and day, they act according to the True Guru's Will; they remain absorbed in the True Name.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਲਗੇ ਸਜਣ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਵੇਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bhai lage sajan na aakhe'eeh j abhimaan kareh vekaar ||
verses.translation: Those who are attached to the love of duality are not called friends; they practice egotism and corruption.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਆਪ ਸੁਆਰਥੀ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh aap suaarathee kaaraj na sakeh savaar ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are selfish; they cannot resolve anyone's affairs.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak poorab likhiaa kamaavanaa koi na meTanahaar ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they act according to their pre-ordained destiny; no one can erase it. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਆਪਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tudh aape jagat upai kai aap khel rachaiaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself created the world, and You Yourself arranged the play of it.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਆਪਿ ਸਿਰਜਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: trai gun aap sirajiaa maiaa moh vadhaiaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself created the three qualities, and fostered emotional attachment to Maya.

verses.original: ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: vich haumai lekhaa ma(n)geeaai fir aavai jaiaa ||
verses.translation: He is called to account for his deeds done in egotism; he continues coming and going in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jinaa har aap kirapaa kare se gur samajhaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru instructs those whom the Lord Himself blesses with Grace.

verses.original: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਘੁਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: balihaaree gur aapane sadhaa sadhaa ghumaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to my Guru; forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
