verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਣੁ ਦੰਤਾ ਜਗੁ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa mamataa mohanee jin vin dha(n)taa jag khaiaa ||
verses.translation: The love of Maya is enticing; without teeth, it has eaten up the world.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਖਾਧੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh khaadhe gurmukh ubare jinee sach naam chit laiaa ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are eaten away, while the Gurmukhs are saved; they focus their consciousness on the True Name.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜਗੁ ਕਮਲਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bin naavai jag kamalaa firai gurmukh nadharee aaiaa ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, the world wanders around insane; the Gurmukhs come to see this.

verses.original: ਧੰਧਾ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਨਿਹਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਨ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)dhaa karatiaa nihafal janam gavaiaa sukhadhaataa man na vasaiaa ||
verses.translation: Involved in worldly affairs, he wastes his life in vain; the peace-giving Lord does not come to abide in his mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak naam tinaa kau miliaa jin kau dhur likh paiaa ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they alone obtain the Name, who have such pre-ordained destiny. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ਹੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ghar hee meh a(n)mrit bharapoor hai manmukhaa saadh na paiaa ||
verses.translation: The home within is filled with Ambrosial Nectar, but the self-willed manmukh does not get to taste it.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਕਸਤੂਰੀ ਮਿਰਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਭ੍ਰਮਦਾ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jiau kasatooree mirag na jaanai bhramadhaa bharam bhulaiaa ||
verses.translation: He is like the deer, who does not recognize its own musk-scent; it wanders around, deluded by doubt.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤਜਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit taj bikh sa(n)grahai karatai aap khuaaiaa ||
verses.translation: The manmukh forsakes the Ambrosial Nectar, and instead gathers poison; the Creator Himself has fooled him.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ ਤਿਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh virale sojhee piee tinaa a(n)dhar braham dhikhaiaa ||
verses.translation: How rare are the Gurmukhs, who obtain this understanding; they behold the Lord God within themselves.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇਆ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tan man seetal hoiaa rasanaa har saadh aaiaa ||
verses.translation: Their minds and bodies are cooled and soothed, and their tongues enjoy the sublime taste of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੇ ਹੀ ਨਾਉ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabadhe hee naau uoopajai sabadhe mel milaiaa ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Shabad, the Name wells up; through the Shabad, we are united in the Lord's Union.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bin sabadhai sabh jag bauraanaa birathaa janam gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: Without the Shabad, the whole world is insane, and it loses its life in vain.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਏਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit eko sabadh hai naanak gurmukh paiaa ||2||
verses.translation: The Shabad alone is Ambrosial Nectar; O Nanak, the Gurmukhs obtain it. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: so har purakh aga(n)m hai kahu kit bidh paieeaai ||
verses.translation: The Lord God is inaccessible; tell me, how can we find Him?

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਅਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੁ ਕਹੁ ਜਨ ਕਿਉ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: tis roop na rekh adhirasaT kahu jan kiau dhiaaieeaai ||
verses.translation: He has no form or feature, and He cannot be seen; tell me, how can we meditate on Him?

verses.original: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: nira(n)kaar nira(n)jan har agam kiaa keh gun gaieeaai ||
verses.translation: The Lord is formless, immaculate and inaccessible; which of His Virtues should we speak of and sing?

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: jis aap bujhaae aap su har maarag paieeaai ||
verses.translation: They alone walk on the Lord's Path, whom the Lord Himself instructs.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਵੇਖਾਲਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gur poorai vekhaaliaa gur sevaa paieeaai ||4||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has revealed Him to me; serving the Guru, He is found. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਤਨੁ ਕੋਲੂ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਰਤੁ ਨ ਭੋਰੀ ਡੇਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jiau tan koloo peeReeaai rat na bhoree ddeh ||
verses.translation: It is as if my body has been crushed in the oil-press, without yielding even a drop of blood;

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਵੰਞੈ ਚਉ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਸਚੇ ਸੰਦੜੈ ਨੇਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau va(n)n(j)ai chau kha(n)neeaai sache sa(n)dhaRai neh ||
verses.translation: it is as if my soul has been cut apart into pieces for the sake of the Love of the True Lord;

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਰਾਤੀ ਅਤੈ ਡੇਹ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak mel na chukiee raatee atai ddeh ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, still, night and day, my Union with the Lord is not broken. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਜਣੁ ਮੈਡਾ ਰੰਗੁਲਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ ਮਨੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: sajan maiddaa ra(n)gulaa ra(n)g laae man lei ||
verses.translation: My Friend is so full of joy and love; He colors my mind with the color of His Love,

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਮਾਜੀਠੈ ਕਪੜੇ ਰੰਗੇ ਭੀ ਪਾਹੇਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jiau maajeeThai kapaRe ra(n)ge bhee paaheh ||
verses.translation: like the fabric which is treated to retain the color of the dye.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਬਿਆ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਕੇਹ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak ra(n)g na utarai biaa na lagai keh ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, this color does not depart, and no other color can be imparted to this fabric. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਲਾਇਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: har aap varatai aap har aap bulaidhaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself is pervading everywhere; the Lord Himself causes us to chant His Name.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: har aape sirasaT savaar sir dha(n)dhai laidhaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself created the creation; He commits all to their tasks.

verses.original: ਇਕਨਾ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਇ ਇਕਿ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਇਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: eikanaa bhagatee lai ik aap khuaaidhaa ||
verses.translation: He engages some in devotional worship, and others, He causes to stray.

verses.original: ਇਕਨਾ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਇ ਇਕਿ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: eikanaa maarag pai ik ujhaR paidhaa ||
verses.translation: He places some on the Path, while He leads others into the wilderness.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: jan naanak naam dhiaae gurmukh gun gaidhaa ||5||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; as Gurmukh, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kee sevaa safal hai je ko kare chit lai ||
verses.translation: Service to the True Guru is fruitful and rewarding, if one performs it with his mind focused on it.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਣਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man chi(n)dhiaa fal paavanaa haumai vichahu jai ||
verses.translation: The fruits of the mind's desires are obtained, and egotism departs from within.

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਚੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan toRai mukat hoi sache rahai samai ||
verses.translation: His bonds are broken, and he is liberated; he remains absorbed in the True Lord.

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਲਭੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: eis jag meh naam alabh hai gurmukh vasai man aai ||
verses.translation: It is so difficult to obtain the Naam in this world; it comes to dwell in the mind of the Gurmukh.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak jo gur seveh aapanaa hau tin balihaarai jaau ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to one who serves his True Guru. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੰਨੁ ਅਜਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh ma(n)n ajit hai dhoojai lagai jai ||
verses.translation: The mind of the self-willed manmukh is so very stubborn; it is stuck in the love of duality.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਨਹੀ ਦੁਖੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tis no sukh supanai nahee dhukhe dhukh vihai ||
verses.translation: He does not find peace, even in dreams; he passes his life in misery and suffering.

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਥਕੇ ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ghar ghar paR paR pa(n)ddit thake sidh samaadh lagai ||
verses.translation: The Pandits have grown weary of going door to door, reading and reciting their scriptures; the Siddhas have gone into their trances of Samaadhi.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਥਕੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eih man vas na aaviee thake karam kamai ||
verses.translation: This mind cannot be controlled; they are tired of performing religious rituals.

verses.original: ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਿ ਥਕੇ ਅਠਿਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhekhadhaaree bhekh kar thake aThisaTh teerath nai ||
verses.translation: The impersonators have grown weary of wearing false costumes, and bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man kee saar na jaananee haumai bharam bhulai ||
verses.translation: They do not know the state of their own minds; they are deluded by doubt and egotism.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਭਉ ਪਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee bhau piaa vaddabhaag vasiaa man aai ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, the Fear of God is obtained; by great good fortune, the Lord comes to abide in the mind.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਪਇਐ ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਹੋਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhai piaai man vas hoaa haumai sabadh jalai ||
verses.translation: When the Fear of God comes, the mind is restrained, and through the Word of the Shabad, the ego is burnt away.

verses.original: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sach rate se niramale jotee jot milai ||
verses.translation: Those who are imbued with Truth are immaculate; their light merges in the Light.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: satigur miliaai naau paiaa naanak sukh samai ||2||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, one obtains the Name; O Nanak, he is absorbed in peace. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਏਹ ਭੂਪਤਿ ਰਾਣੇ ਰੰਗ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: eh bhoopat raane ra(n)g dhin chaar suhaavanaa ||
verses.translation: The pleasures of kings and emperors are pleasing, but they last for only a few days.

verses.original: ਏਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਵਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: eh maiaa ra(n)g kasu(n)bh khin meh leh jaavanaa ||
verses.translation: These pleasures of Maya are like the color of the safflower, which wears off in a moment.

verses.original: ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਪਾਪ ਲੈ ਜਾਵਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: chaladhiaa naal na chalai sir paap lai jaavanaa ||
verses.translation: They do not go with him when he departs; instead, he carries the load of sins upon his head.

verses.original: ਜਾਂ ਪਕੜਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ਕਾਲਿ ਤਾਂ ਖਰਾ ਡਰਾਵਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaa(n) pakaR chalaiaa kaal taa(n) kharaa ddaraavanaa ||
verses.translation: When death seizes him, and marches him away, then he looks absolutely hideous.

verses.original: ਓਹ ਵੇਲਾ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਣਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: oh velaa hath na aavai fir pachhutaavanaa ||6||
verses.translation: That lost opportunity will not come into his hands again, and in the end, he regrets and repents. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਮੁਹ ਫਿਰੇ ਸੇ ਬਧੇ ਦੁਖ ਸਹਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: satigur te jo muh fire se badhe dhukh sahaeh ||
verses.translation: Those who turn their faces away from the True Guru, suffer in sorrow and bondage.

verses.original: ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਿਲਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਤੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: fir fir milan na painee ja(n)meh tai mar jaeh ||
verses.translation: Again and again, they are born only to die; they cannot meet their Lord.

verses.original: ਸਹਸਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਈ ਦੁਖ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: sahasaa rog na chhoddiee dhukh hee meh dhukh paeh ||
verses.translation: The disease of doubt does not depart, and they find only pain and more pain.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੇਹਿ ਸਬਦੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak nadharee bakhas leh sabadhe mel milaeh ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, if the Gracious Lord forgives, then one is united in Union with the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮੁਹ ਫਿਰੇ ਤਿਨਾ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਠਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo satigur te muh fire tinaa Thaur na Thaau ||
verses.translation: Those who turn their faces away from the True Guru, shall find no place of rest or shelter.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਛੁਟੜਿ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਦੁਹਚਾਰਣਿ ਬਦਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jiau chhuTaR ghar ghar firai dhuhachaaran badhanaau ||
verses.translation: They wander around from door to door, like a woman forsaken, with a bad character and a bad reputation.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਖਸੀਅਹਿ ਸੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh bakhase'eeh se satigur mel milaau ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are forgiven, and united in Union with the True Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਤਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ਸੇ ਭਵਜਲ ਤਰਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jo seveh sat muraar se bhavajal tar giaa ||
verses.translation: Those who serve the True Lord, the Destroyer of ego, cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ਤਿਨ ਜਮੁ ਛਡਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jo boleh har har naau tin jam chhadd giaa ||
verses.translation: Those who chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, are passed over by the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: se dharageh paidhe jaeh jinaa har jap liaa ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on the Lord, go to His Court in robes of honor.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇਈ ਪੁਰਖ ਜਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har seveh seiee purakh jinaa har tudh miaa ||
verses.translation: They alone serve You, O Lord, whom You bless with Grace.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭਉ ਗਇਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: gun gaavaa piaare nit gurmukh bhram bhau giaa ||7||
verses.translation: I sing continually Your Glorious Praises, O Beloved; as Gurmukh, my doubts and fears have been dispelled. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਥਾਲੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਤੈ ਵਸਤੂ ਪਈਓ ਹਰਿ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: thaalai vich tai vasatoo pieeo har bhojan a(n)mrit saar ||
verses.translation: Upon the plate, three things have been placed; this is the sublime, ambrosial food of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਧੈ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀਐ ਪਾਈਐ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jit khaadhai man tirapateeaai paieeaai mokh dhuaar ||
verses.translation: Eating this, the mind is satisfied, and the Door of Salvation is found.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਅਲਭੁ ਹੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਲਭੈ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: eih bhojan alabh hai sa(n)tahu labhai gur veechaar ||
verses.translation: It is so difficult to obtain this food, O Saints; it is obtained only by contemplating the Guru.

verses.original: ਏਹ ਮੁਦਾਵਣੀ ਕਿਉ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਕਢੀਐ ਸਦਾ ਰਖੀਐ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: eh mudhaavanee kiau vichahu kaddeeaai sadhaa rakheeaai ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: Why should we cast this riddle out of our minds? We should keep it ever enshrined in our hearts.

verses.original: ਏਹ ਮੁਦਾਵਣੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਲਧੀ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: eh mudhaavanee satiguroo paiee gursikhaa ladhee bhaal ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has posed this riddle. The Guru's Sikhs have found its solution.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੁ ਬੁਝਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਘਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak jis bujhaae su bujhasee har paiaa gurmukh ghaal ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he alone understands this, whom the Lord inspires to understand. The Gurmukhs work hard, and find the Lord. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jo dhur mele se mil rahe satigur siau chit lai ||
verses.translation: Those whom the Primal Lord unites, remain in Union with Him; they focus their consciousness on the True Guru.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਵਿਛੋੜੇਨੁ ਸੇ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: aap vichhoRen se vichhuRe dhoojai bhai khuaai ||
verses.translation: Those whom the Lord Himself separates, remain separated; in the love of duality, they are ruined.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਿਆ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak vin karamaa kiaa paieeaai poorab likhiaa kamai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without good karma, what can anyone obtain? He earns what he is pre-destined to receive. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਬਹਿ ਸਖੀਆ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗਾਵਣਹਾਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: beh sakheeaa jas gaaveh gaavanahaareeaa ||
verses.translation: Sitting together, the companions sing the Songs of the Lord's Praises.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: har naam salaahih nit har kau balihaareeaa ||
verses.translation: They praise the Lord's Name continually; they are a sacrifice to the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ਤਿਨਾ ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: jinee sun ma(n)niaa har naau tinaa hau vaareeaa ||
verses.translation: Those who hear, and believe in the Lord's Name, to them I am a sacrifice.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੁ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਹਾਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukheeaa har mel milaavanahaareeaa ||
verses.translation: O Lord, let me unite with the Gurmukhs, who are united with You.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਦੇਖਣਹਾਰੀਆ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: hau bal jaavaa dhin raat gur dhekhanahaareeaa ||8||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who, day and night, behold their Guru. ||8||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭਿ ਭਰਮਦੇ ਨਿਤ ਜਗਿ ਤੋਟਾ ਸੈਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: vin naavai sabh bharamadhe nit jag toTaa saisaar ||
verses.translation: Without the Name of the Lord, everyone wanders around the world, losing.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਅੰਧੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh karam kamaavane haumai a(n)dh gubaar ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs do their deeds in the pitch black darkness of egotism.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਣਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gurmukh a(n)mrit peevanaa naanak sabadh veechaar ||1||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs drink in the Ambrosial Nectar, O Nanak, contemplating the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਜਾਗੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: sahaje jaagai sahaje sovai ||
verses.translation: He wakes in peace, and he sleeps in peace.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh anadhin usatat hovai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh praises the Lord night and day.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮੈ ਸਹਸਾ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh bharamai sahasaa hovai ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh remains deluded by his doubts.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਸੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar chi(n)taa needh na sovai ||
verses.translation: He is filled with anxiety, and he cannot even sleep.

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਾਗਹਿ ਸਵਹਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: giaanee jaageh saveh subhai ||
verses.translation: The spiritually wise wake and sleep in peace.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤਿਆ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam ratiaa bal jaau ||2||
verses.translation: Nanak is a sacrifice to those who are imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਤਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: se har naam dhiaaveh jo har ratiaa ||
verses.translation: They alone meditate on the Lord's Name, who are imbued with the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਇਕੁ ਇਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: har ik dhiaaveh ik iko har satiaa ||
verses.translation: They meditate on the One Lord; the One and Only Lord is True.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਇਕੁ ਇਕੋ ਉਤਪਤਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: har iko varatai ik iko utapatiaa ||
verses.translation: The One Lord is pervading everywhere; the One Lord created the Universe.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਡਰੁ ਸਟਿ ਘਤਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jo har naam dhiaaveh tin ddar saT ghatiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on the Lord's Name, cast out their fears.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਦੇਵੈ ਆਪਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: gurmatee dhevai aap gurmukh har japiaa ||9||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself blesses them with Guru's Instruction; the Gurmukh meditates on the Lord. ||9||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਜਿਤੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar giaan na aaio jit kichh sojhee pai ||
verses.translation: Spiritual wisdom, which would bring understanding, does not enter into his mind.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਡਿਠਾ ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਅੰਧਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vin ddiThaa kiaa saalaaheeaai a(n)dhaa a(n)dh kamai ||
verses.translation: Without seeing, how can he praise the Lord? The blind act in blindness.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak sabadh pachhaaneeaai naam vasai man aai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, when one realizes the Word of the Shabad, then the Naam comes to abide in the mind. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਇਕਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਇਕੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਇਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: eikaa baanee ik gur iko sabadh veechaar ||
verses.translation: There is One Bani; there is One Guru; there is one Shabad to contemplate.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸਉਦਾ ਹਟੁ ਸਚੁ ਰਤਨੀ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa saudhaa haT sach ratanee bhare bha(n)ddaar ||
verses.translation: True is the merchandise, and true is the shop; the warehouses are overflowing with jewels.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਅਨਿ ਜੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur kirapaa te paieean je dhevai dhevanahaar ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, they are obtained, if the Great Giver gives them.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸਉਦਾ ਲਾਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਖਟਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa saudhaa laabh sadhaa khaTiaa naam apaar ||
verses.translation: Dealing in this true merchandise, one earns the profit of the incomparable Naam.

verses.original: ਵਿਖੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਆ ਕਰਮਿ ਪੀਆਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: vikh vich a(n)mrit pragaTiaa karam peeaavanahaar ||
verses.translation: In the midst of poison, the Ambrosial Nectar is revealed; by His Mercy, one drinks it in.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sach salaaheeaai dha(n)n savaaranahaar ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, praise the True Lord; blessed is the Creator, the Embellisher. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit: jinaa a(n)dhar kooR varatai sach na bhaaviee ||
verses.translation: Those who are permeated by falsehood, do not love the Truth.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਕੂੜਾ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit: je ko bolai sach kooRaa jal jaaviee ||
verses.translation: If someone speaks the Truth, falsehood is burnt away.

verses.original: ਕੂੜਿਆਰੀ ਰਜੈ ਕੂੜਿ ਜਿਉ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਕਾਗੁ ਖਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit: kooRiaaree rajai kooR jiau visaTaa kaag khaaviee ||
verses.translation: The false are satisfied by falsehood, like the crows who eat manure.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਈ ॥
verses.translit: jis har hoi kirapaal so naam dhiaaviee ||
verses.translation: When the Lord grants His Grace, then one meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਪਾਪੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਵਈ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: har gurmukh naam araadh kooR paap leh jaaviee ||10||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, worship the Lord's Name in adoration; fraud and sin shall disappear. ||10||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੇਖਾ ਚਉਚਕਿਆ ਚਉਵਾਇਆ ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: sekhaa chauchakiaa chauvaiaa eh man ikat ghar aan ||
verses.translation: O Shaykh, you wander in the four directions, blown by the four winds; bring your mind back to the home of the One Lord.

verses.original: ਏਹੜ ਤੇਹੜ ਛਡਿ ਤੂ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: ehaR tehaR chhadd too gur kaa sabadh pachhaan ||
verses.translation: Renounce your petty arguments, and realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਗੈ ਢਹਿ ਪਉ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur agai ddeh pau sabh kichh jaanai jaan ||
verses.translation: Bow in humble respect before the True Guru; He is the Knower who knows everything.

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਜਲਾਇ ਤੂ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੁ ਮਿਹਮਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa manasaa jalai too hoi rahu mihamaan ||
verses.translation: Burn away your hopes and desires, and live like a guest in this world.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਭੀ ਚਲਹਿ ਤਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kai bhaanai bhee chaleh taa dharageh paaveh maan ||
verses.translation: If you walk in harmony with the True Guru's Will, then you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਨੀ ਤਿਨ ਧਿਗੁ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਧਿਗੁ ਖਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak j naam na chetanee tin dhig painan dhig khaan ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who do not contemplate the Naam, the Name of the Lord - cursed are their clothes, and cursed is their food. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har gun toT na aaviee keemat kahan na jai ||
verses.translation: There is no end to the Lord's Glorious Praises; His worth cannot be described.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh har gun raveh gun meh rahai samai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord; they are absorbed in His Glorious Virtues. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਚੋਲੀ ਦੇਹ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਕਢਿ ਪੈਧੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har cholee dheh savaaree kadd paidhee bhagat kar ||
verses.translation: The Lord has adorned the coat of the body; He has embroidered it with devotional worship.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪਾਟੁ ਲਗਾ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ਬਹੁ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਭਾਤਿ ਕਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har paaT lagaa adhikaiee bahu bahu bidh bhaat kar ||
verses.translation: The Lord has woven His silk into it, in so many ways and fashions.

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਬੂਝਣਹਾਰਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਬੇਕੁ ਕਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: koiee boojhai boojhanahaaraa a(n)tar bibek kar ||
verses.translation: How rare is that man of understanding, who understands, and deliberates within.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਏਹੁ ਬਿਬੇਕੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: so boojhai eh bibek jis bujhaae aap har ||
verses.translation: He alone understands these deliberations, whom the Lord Himself inspires to understand.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਹਰਿ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kahai vichaaraa gurmukh har sat har ||11||
verses.translation: Poor servant Nanak speaks: the Gurmukhs know the Lord, the Lord is True. ||11||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਰਥਾਇ ਸਾਖੀ ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖ ਬੋਲਦੇ ਸਾਝੀ ਸਗਲ ਜਹਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: parathai saakhee mahaa purakh boladhe saajhee sagal jahaanai ||
verses.translation: Great men speak the teachings by relating them to individual situations, but the whole world shares in them.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਭਉ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hoi su bhau kare aapanaa aap pachhaanai ||
verses.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh knows the Fear of God, and realizes his own self.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee jeevat marai taa man hee te man maanai ||
verses.translation: If, by Guru's Grace, one remains dead while yet alive, the mind becomes content in itself.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਥਹਿ ਗਿਆਨੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jin kau man kee parateet naahee naanak se kiaa katheh giaanai ||1||
verses.translation: Those who have no faith in their own minds, O Nanak - how can they speak of spiritual wisdom? ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਇਓ ਅੰਤਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਹੁਤਾ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh chit na laio a(n)t dhukh pahutaa aai ||
verses.translation: Those who do not focus their consciousness on the Lord, as Gurmukh, suffer pain and grief in the end.

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਅੰਧਿਆਂ ਸੁਧਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dharahu baaharahu a(n)dhiaa(n) sudh na kaiee pai ||
verses.translation: They are blind, inwardly and outwardly, and they do not understand anything.

verses.original: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਬਰਕਤੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਖਾਇ ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ddit tin kee barakatee sabh jagat khai jo rate har nai ||
verses.translation: O Pandit, O religious scholar, the whole world is fed for the sake of those who are attuned to the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jin gur kai sabadh salaahiaa har siau rahe samai ||
verses.translation: Those who praise the Word of the Guru's Shabad, remain blended with the Lord.

verses.original: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਬਰਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ddit dhoojai bhai barakat na hoviee naa dhan palai pai ||
verses.translation: O Pandit, O religious scholar, no one is satisfied, and no one finds true wealth through the love of duality.

verses.original: ਪੜਿ ਥਕੇ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਲਤ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: paR thake sa(n)tokh na aaio anadhin jalat vihai ||
verses.translation: They have grown weary of reading scriptures, but still, they do not find contentment, and they pass their lives burning, night and day.

verses.original: ਕੂਕ ਪੂਕਾਰ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਨਾ ਸੰਸਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kook pookaar na chukiee naa sa(n)saa vichahu jai ||
verses.translation: Their cries and complaints never end, and doubt does not depart from within them.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam vihooniaa muh kaalai uTh jai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they rise up and depart with blackened faces. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣ ਮੇਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਦਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har sajan mel piaare mil pa(n)th dhasaiee ||
verses.translation: O Beloved, lead me to meet my True Friend; meeting with Him, I shall ask Him to show me the Path.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਦਸੇ ਮਿਤੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jo har dhase mit tis hau bal jaiee ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to that Friend, who shows it to me.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਸਾਝੀ ਤਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਕਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: gun saajhee tin siau karee har naam dhiaaiee ||
verses.translation: I share His Virtues with Him, and meditate on the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵੀ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਨਿਤ ਸੇਵਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har sevee piaaraa nit sev har sukh paiee ||
verses.translation: I serve my Beloved Lord forever; serving the Lord, I have found peace.

verses.original: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: balihaaree satigur tis jin sojhee paiee ||12||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru, who has imparted this understanding to me. ||12||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਜੇ ਵੇਦ ਪੜੈ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ddit mail na chukiee je vedh paRai jug chaar ||
verses.translation: O Pandit, O religious scholar, your filth shall not be erased, even if you read the Vedas for four ages.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੂਲੁ ਹੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: trai gun maiaa mool hai vich haumai naam visaar ||
verses.translation: The three qualities are the roots of Maya; in egotism, one forgets the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਭੂਲੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਵਾਪਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ddit bhoole dhoojai laage maiaa kai vaapaar ||
verses.translation: The Pandits are deluded, attached to duality, and they deal only in Maya.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਹੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਭੁਖਿਆ ਮੁਏ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar tirasanaa bhukh hai moorakh bhukhiaa mue gavaar ||
verses.translation: They are filled with thirst and hunger; the ignorant fools starve to death.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: satigur seviaai sukh paiaa sachai sabadh veechaar ||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, peace is obtained, contemplating the True Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਗਈ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dharahu tirasanaa bhukh giee sachai nai piaar ||
verses.translation: Hunger and thirst have departed from within me; I am in love with the True Name.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਜੇ ਜਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak naam rate sahaje raje jinaa har rakhiaa ur dhaar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam, who keep the Lord clasped tightly to their hearts, are automatically satisfied. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਗਾ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh har naam na seviaa dhukh lagaa bahutaa aai ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh does not serve the Lord's Name, and so he suffers in horrible pain.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਹੈ ਸੁਧਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar agiaan a(n)dher hai sudh na kaiee pai ||
verses.translation: He is filled with the darkness of ignorance, and he does not understand anything.

verses.original: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਨ ਬੀਜਿਓ ਭੁਖਾ ਕਿ ਅਗੈ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: manahaTh sahaj na beejio bhukhaa k agai khai ||
verses.translation: Because of his stubborn mind, he does not plant the seeds of intuitive peace; what will he eat in the world hereafter, to satisfy his hunger?

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naam nidhaan visaariaa dhoojai lagaa jai ||
verses.translation: He has forgotten the treasure of the Naam; he is caught in the love of duality.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਜੇ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh mileh vaddiaaieeaa je aape mel milai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are honored with glory, when the Lord Himself unites them in His Union. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਖਰੀ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: har rasanaa har jas gaavai kharee suhaavanee ||
verses.translation: The tongue which sings the Lord's Praises, is so very beautiful.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲੈ ਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: jo man tan mukh har bolai saa har bhaavanee ||
verses.translation: One who speaks the Lord's Name, with mind, body and mouth, is pleasing to the Lord.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਖੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਸਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: jo gurmukh chakhai saadh saa tirapataavanee ||
verses.translation: That Gurmukh tastes the the sublime taste of the Lord, and is satisfied.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਝਾਵਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: gun gaavai piaare nit gun gai gunee samajhaavanee ||
verses.translation: She sings continually the Glorious Praises of her Beloved; singing His Glorious Praises, she is uplifted.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਬੁਲਾਵਣੀ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: jis hovai aap dhiaal saa satiguroo guroo bulaavanee ||13||
verses.translation: She is blessed with the Lord's Mercy, and she chants the Words of the Guru, the True Guru. ||13||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਸਤੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਜਿਉ ਅੰਕਸੁ ਹੈ ਅਹਰਣਿ ਜਿਉ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: hasatee sir jiau a(n)kas hai aharan jiau sir dhei ||
verses.translation: The elephant offers its head to the reins, and the anvil offers itself to the hammer;

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਰਾਖਿ ਕੈ ਊਭੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: man tan aagai raakh kai uoobhee sev karei ||
verses.translation: just so, we offer our minds and bodies to our Guru; we stand before Him, and serve Him.

verses.original: ਇਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਾ ਲੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: eiau gurmukh aap nivaareeaai sabh raaj sirasaT kaa lei ||
verses.translation: This is how the Gurmukhs eliminate their self-conceit, and come to rule the whole world.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh bujheeaai jaa aape nadhar karei ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh understands, when the Lord casts His Glance of Grace. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਆਏ ਤੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: jin gurmukh naam dhiaaiaa aae te paravaan ||
verses.translation: Blessed and approved is the coming into the world, of those Gurmukhs who meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak kul udhaareh aapanaa dharageh paaveh maan ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they save their families, and they are honored in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਖੀਆ ਸਿਖ ਗੁਰੂ ਮੇਲਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sakheeaa sikh guroo melaieeaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru unites His Sikhs, the Gurmukhs, with the Lord.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ਇਕਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: eik sevak gur paas ik gur kaarai laieeaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru keeps some of them with Himself, and engages others in His Service.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਭਾਉ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੇਵਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: jinaa gur piaaraa man chit tinaa bhaau guroo dhevaieeaa ||
verses.translation: Those who cherish their Beloved in their conscious minds, the Guru blesses them with His Love.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖਾ ਇਕੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਤਾ ਪੁਤਾ ਭਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur sikhaa iko piaar gur mitaa putaa bhaieeaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru loves all of His Gursikhs equally well, like friends, children and siblings.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਸਭਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਖਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਜੀਵਾਈਆ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: gur satigur bolahu sabh gur aakh guroo jeevaieeaa ||14||
verses.translation: So chant the Name of the Guru, the True Guru, everyone! Chanting the Name of the Guru, Guru, you shall be rejuvenated. ||14||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਨੀ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਅਵਰੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: naanak naam na chetanee agiaanee a(n)dhule avare karam kamaeh ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the blind, ignorant fools do not remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord; they involve themselves in other activities.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਚਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jam dhar badhe maare'eh fir visaTaa maeh pachaeh ||1||
verses.translation: They are bound and gagged at the door of the Messenger of Death; they are punished, and in the end, they rot away in manure. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਚੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak satigur seveh aapanaa se jan sache paravaan ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those humble beings are true and approved, who serve their True Guru.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ਸਮਾਇ ਰਹੇ ਚੂਕਾ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har kai nai samai rahe chookaa aavan jaan ||2||
verses.translation: They remain absorbed in the Name of the Lord, and their comings and goings cease. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਚੀਐ ਅੰਤੇ ਦੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhan sa(n)pai maiaa sa(n)cheeaai a(n)te dhukhadhaiee ||
verses.translation: Gathering the wealth and property of Maya, brings only pain in the end.

verses.original: ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਲ ਸਵਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ghar ma(n)dhar mahal savaare'eh kichh saath na jaiee ||
verses.translation: Homes, mansions and adorned palaces will not go with anyone.

verses.original: ਹਰ ਰੰਗੀ ਤੁਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਪਾਲੀਅਹਿ ਕਿਤੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: har ra(n)gee ture nit paale'eeh kitai kaam na aaiee ||
verses.translation: He may breed horses of various colors, but these will not be of any use to him.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਅੰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jan laavahu chit har naam siau a(n)t hoi sakhaiee ||
verses.translation: O human, link your consciousness to the Lord's Name, and in the end, it shall be your companion and helper.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: jan naanak naam dhiaaiaa gurmukh sukh paiee ||15||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the Gurmukh is blessed with peace. ||15||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਕਰਮੈ ਨਾਉ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin karamai naau na paieeaai poorai karam paiaa jai ||
verses.translation: Without the karma of good actions, the Name is not obtained; it can be obtained only by perfect good karma.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak nadhar kare je aapanee taa gurmat mel milai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, if the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, then under Guru's Instruction, one is united in His Union. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਇਕ ਦਝਹਿ ਇਕ ਦਬੀਅਹਿ ਇਕਨਾ ਕੁਤੇ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: eik dhajheh ik dhabe'eeh ikanaa kute khaeh ||
verses.translation: Some are cremated, and some are buried; some are eaten by dogs.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਸਟੀਅਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਭੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਹਸਣਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: eik paanee vich usaTe'eeh ik bhee fir hasan paeh ||
verses.translation: Some are thrown into water, while others are thrown into wells.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਵ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ ਕਿਥੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak ev na jaapiee kithai jai samaeh ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, it is not known, where they go and into what they merge. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਖਾਧਾ ਪੈਧਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਨਾਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: tin kaa khaadhaa paidhaa maiaa sabh pavit hai jo naam har raate ||
verses.translation: The food and clothes, and all the worldly possessions of those who are attuned to the Lord's Name are sacred.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਲ ਸਰਾਈ ਸਭਿ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹਹਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਿਖ ਅਭਿਆਗਤ ਜਾਇ ਵਰਸਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: tin ke ghar ma(n)dhar mahal saraiee sabh pavit heh jinee gurmukh sevak sikh abhiaagat jai varasaate ||
verses.translation: All the homes, temples, palaces and way-stations are sacred, where the Gurmukhs, the selfless servants, the Sikhs and the renouncers of the world, go and take their rest.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਤੁਰੇ ਜੀਨ ਖੁਰਗੀਰ ਸਭਿ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹਹਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤ ਚੜਿ ਜਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: tin ke ture jeen khurageer sabh pavit heh jinee gurmukh sikh saadh sa(n)t chaR jaate ||
verses.translation: All the horses, saddles and horse blankets are sacred, upon which the Gurmukhs, the Sikhs, the Holy and the Saints, mount and ride.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਭਿ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹਹਿ ਜੋ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: tin ke karam dharam kaaraj sabh pavit heh jo boleh har har raam naam har saate ||
verses.translation: All the rituals and Dharmic practices and deeds are sacred, for those who utter the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the True Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਸੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਿਖ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: jin kai potai pu(n)n hai se gurmukh sikh guroo peh jaate ||16||
verses.translation: Those Gurmukhs, those Sikhs, who have purity as their treasure, go to their Guru. ||16||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਘੁਥਿਆ ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak naavahu ghuthiaa halat palat sabh jai ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, forsaking the Name, he loses everything, in this world and the next.

verses.original: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਿਰਿ ਲਇਆ ਮੁਠੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jap tap sa(n)jam sabh hir liaa muThee dhoojai bhai ||
verses.translation: Chanting, deep meditation and austere self-disciplined practices are all wasted; he is deceived by the love of duality.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jam dhar badhe maare'eh bahutee milai sajai ||1||
verses.translation: He is bound and gagged at the door of the Messenger of Death. He is beaten, and receives terrible punishment. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੰਤਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਵੈਰੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਦੁਸਟਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)taa naal vair kamaavadhe dhusaTaa naal moh piaar ||
verses.translation: They inflict their hatred upon the Saints, and they love the wicked sinners.

verses.original: ਅਗੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: agai pichhai sukh nahee mar ja(n)meh vaaro vaar ||
verses.translation: They find no peace in either this world or the next; they are born only to die, again and again.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਬੁਝਈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: tirasanaa kadhe na bujhiee dhubidhaa hoi khuaar ||
verses.translation: Their hunger is never satisfied, and they are ruined by duality.

verses.original: ਮੁਹ ਕਾਲੇ ਤਿਨਾ ਨਿੰਦਕਾ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: muh kaale tinaa ni(n)dhakaa tit sachai dharabaar ||
verses.translation: The faces of these slanderers are blackened in the Court of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam vihooniaa naa uravaar na paar ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the Naam, they find no shelter on either this shore, or the one beyond. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jo har naam dhiaaidhe se har har naam rate man maahee ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on the Lord's Name, are imbued with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in their minds.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਇਕੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਇਕਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jinaa man chit ik araadhiaa tinaa ikas bin dhoojaa ko naahee ||
verses.translation: For those who worship the One Lord in their conscious minds, there is no other than the One Lord.

verses.original: ਸੇਈ ਪੁਰਖ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਜਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: seiee purakh har sevadhe jin dhur masatak lekh likhaahee ||
verses.translation: They alone serve the Lord, upon whose foreheads such pre-ordained destiny is written.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਵਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਝਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: har ke gun nit gaavadhe har gun gai gunee samajhaahee ||
verses.translation: They continually sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and singing the Glories of the Glorious Lord, they are uplifted.

verses.original: ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: vaddiaaiee vaddee gurmukhaa gur poorai har naam samaahee ||17||
verses.translation: Great is the greatness of the Gurmukhs, who, through the Perfect Guru, remain absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||17||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਗਾਖੜੀ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kee sevaa gaakhaRee sir dheejai aap gavai ||
verses.translation: It is very difficult to serve the True Guru; offer your head, and eradicate self-conceit.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਨਾ ਮਰਹਿ ਤਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਵੈ ਸਭ ਥਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh mareh fir naa mareh taa sevaa pavai sabh thai ||
verses.translation: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad shall never have to die again; his service is totally approved.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸਿਐ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: paaras parasiaai paaras hovai sach rahai liv lai ||
verses.translation: Touching the philosopher's stone, one becomes the philosopher's stone, which transforms lead into gold; remain lovingly attached to the True Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: jis poorab hovai likhiaa tis satigur milai prabh aai ||
verses.translation: One who has such pre-ordained destiny, comes to meet the True Guru and God.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਣਤੈ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਨਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਸੋ ਪਵੈ ਥਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak ganatai sevak naa milai jis bakhase so pavai thai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord's servant does not meet Him because of his own account; he alone is acceptable, whom the Lord forgives. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਹਲੁ ਕੁਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਮੂਰਖ ਅਪਣੈ ਸੁਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: mahal kumahal na jaananee moorakh apanai suaai ||
verses.translation: The fools do not know the difference between good and bad; they are deceived by their self-interests.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨਹਿ ਤਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਲਹਹਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh cheeneh taa mahal laheh jotee jot samai ||
verses.translation: But if they contemplate the Word of the Shabad, they obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and their light merges in the Light.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਾ ਸਭਾ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sache kaa bhau man vasai taa sabhaa sojhee pai ||
verses.translation: The Fear of God is always on their minds, and so they come to understand everything.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਣੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur apanai ghar varatadhaa aape le milai ||
verses.translation: The True Guru is pervading the homes within; He Himself blends them with the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਭ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak satigur miliaai sabh pooree piee jis no kirapaa kare rajai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they meet the True Guru, and all their desires are fulfilled, if the Lord grants His Grace and so wills. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਭਾਗ ਤਿਨਾ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਕਹਤਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)n dhan bhaag tinaa bhagat janaa jo har naamaa har mukh kahatiaa ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed is the good fortune of those devotees, who, with their mouths, utter the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਭਾਗ ਤਿਨਾ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਣਤਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhan dhan bhaag tinaa sa(n)t janaa jo har jas sravanee sunatiaa ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed is the good fortune of those Saints, who, with their ears, listen to the Lord's Praises.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਭਾਗ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਣੀ ਜਨ ਬਣਤਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhan dhan bhaag tinaa saadh janaa har keeratan gai gunee jan banatiaa ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed is the good fortune of those holy people, who sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, and so become virtuous.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਭਾਗ ਤਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਜਿਣਤਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhan dhan bhaag tinaa gurmukhaa jo gursikh lai man jinatiaa ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed is the good fortune of those Gurmukhs, who live as Gursikhs, and conquer their minds.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਦੂ ਵਡੇ ਭਾਗ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕੇ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਸਿਖ ਪੜਤਿਆ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: sabh dhoo vadde bhaag gursikhaa ke jo gur charanee sikh paRatiaa ||18||
verses.translation: But the greatest good fortune of all, is that of the Guru's Sikhs, who fall at the Guru's feet. ||18||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬਿੰਦੈ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: braham bi(n)dhai tis dhaa brahamat rahai ek sabadh liv lai ||
verses.translation: One who knows God, and who lovingly focuses his attention on the One Word of the Shabad, keeps his spirituality intact.

verses.original: ਨਵ ਨਿਧੀ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਸਿਧੀ ਪਿਛੈ ਲਗੀਆ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਦਾ ਵਸਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: nav nidhee aThaareh sidhee pichhai lageeaa fireh jo har hiradhai sadhaa vasai ||
verses.translation: The nine treasures and the eighteen spiritual powers of the Siddhas follow him, who keeps the Lord enshrined in his heart.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਉ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬੁਝਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur naau na paieeaai bujhahu kar veechaar ||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, the Name is not found; understand this, and reflect upon it.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak poorai bhaag satigur milai sukh paae jug chaar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through perfect good destiny, one meets the True Guru, and finds peace, throughout the four ages. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਗਭਰੂ ਕਿਆ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਹੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa gabharoo kiaa biradh hai manmukh tirasanaa bhukh na jai ||
verses.translation: Whether he is young or old, the self-willed manmukh cannot escape hunger and thirst.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਤਿਆ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਏ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sabadhe ratiaa seetal hoe aap gavai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs are imbued with the Word of the Shabad; they are at peace, having lost their self-conceit.

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhar tirapat sa(n)tokhiaa fir bhukh na lagai aai ||
verses.translation: They are satisfied and satiated within; they never feel hungry again.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak j gurmukh kareh so paravaan hai jo naam rahe liv lai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, whatever the Gurmukhs do is acceptable; they remain lovingly absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿੰਨ ਕੰਉ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਿਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: hau balihaaree ti(n)n ka(n)au jo gurmukh sikhaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those Sikhs who are Gurmukhs.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਿਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo har naam dhiaaidhe tin dharasan pikhaa ||
verses.translation: I behold the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of those who meditate on the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਲਿਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: sun keeratan har gun ravaa har jas man likhaa ||
verses.translation: Listening to the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, I contemplate His virtues; I write His Praises on the fabric of my mind.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕ੍ਰਿਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: har naam salaahee ra(n)g siau sabh kilavikh kirakhaa ||
verses.translation: I praise the Lord's Name with love, and eradicate all my sins.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਸੋ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਥੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਧਰੇ ਵਿਖਾ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: dhan dha(n)n suhaavaa so sareer thaan hai jithai meraa gur dhare vikhaa ||19||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed and beauteous is that body and place, where my Guru places His feet. ||19||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur bin giaan na hoviee naa sukh vasai man aai ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, spiritual wisdom is not obtained, and peace does not come to abide in the mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ਮਨਮੁਖੀ ਜਾਸਨਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak naam vihoone manmukhee jaasan janam gavai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the self-willed manmukhs depart, after having wasted their lives. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਨਾਵੈ ਨੋ ਸਭਿ ਖੋਜਦੇ ਥਕਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sidh saadhik naavai no sabh khojadhe thak rahe liv lai ||
verses.translation: All the Siddhas, spiritual masters and seekers search for the Name; they have grown weary of concentrating and focusing their attention.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur kinai na paio gurmukh milai milai ||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, no one finds the Name; the Gurmukhs unite in Union with the Lord.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਖਾਣੁ ਸਭੁ ਬਾਦਿ ਹੈ ਧਿਗੁ ਸਿਧੀ ਧਿਗੁ ਕਰਮਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: bin naavai painan khaan sabh baadh hai dhig sidhee dhig karamaat ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, all food and clothes are worthless; cursed is such spirituality, and cursed are such miraculous powers.

verses.original: ਸਾ ਸਿਧਿ ਸਾ ਕਰਮਾਤਿ ਹੈ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: saa sidh saa karamaat hai achi(n)t kare jis dhaat ||
verses.translation: That alone is spirituality, and that alone is miraculous power, which the Carefree Lord spontaneously bestows.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਏਹਾ ਸਿਧਿ ਏਹਾ ਕਰਮਾਤਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh har naam man vasai ehaa sidh ehaa karamaat ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord's Name abides in the mind of the Gurmukh; this is spirituality, and this is miraculous power. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਮ ਢਾਢੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਖਸਮ ਕੇ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਵਹ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਛੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: ham ddaaddee har prabh khasam ke nit gaaveh har gun chha(n)taa ||
verses.translation: I am a minstrel of God, my Lord and Master; every day, I sing the songs of the Lord's Glorious Praises.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਹ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਣਹ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਵਲਾ ਕੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: har keeratan kareh har jas suneh tis kavalaa ka(n)taa ||
verses.translation: I sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, and I listen to the Praises of the Lord, the Master of wealth and Maya.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਭਿਖਾਰੀਆ ਮੰਗਤ ਜਨ ਜੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: har dhaataa sabh jagat bhikhaareeaa ma(n)gat jan ja(n)taa ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the Great Giver; all the world is begging; all beings and creatures are beggars.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਥਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਮ ਜੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: har dhevahu dhaan dhiaal hoi vich paathar kiram ja(n)taa ||
verses.translation: O Lord, You are kind and compassionate; You give Your gifts to even worms and insects among the rocks.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: jan naanak naam dhiaaiaa gurmukh dhanava(n)taa ||20||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; as Gurmukh, he has become truly wealthy. ||20||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਪੜਣਾ ਗੁੜਣਾ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਹੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: paRanaa guRanaa sa(n)saar kee kaar hai a(n)dhar tirasanaa vikaar ||
verses.translation: Reading and studying are just worldly pursuits, if there is thirst and corruption within.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਭਿ ਪੜਿ ਥਕੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: haumai vich sabh paR thake dhoojai bhai khuaar ||
verses.translation: Reading in egotism, all have grown weary; through the love of duality, they are ruined.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪੜਿਆ ਸੋ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਬੀਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: so paRiaa so pa(n)ddit beenaa gur sabadh kare veechaar ||
verses.translation: He alone is educated, and he alone is a wise Pandit, who contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਖੋਜੈ ਤਤੁ ਲਹੈ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhar khojai tat lahai paae mokh dhuaar ||
verses.translation: He searches within himself, and finds the true essence; he finds the Door of Salvation.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gun nidhaan har paiaa sahaj kare veechaar ||
verses.translation: He finds the Lord, the treasure of excellence, and peacefully contemplates Him.

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dha(n)n vaapaaree naanakaa jis gurmukh naam adhaar ||1||
verses.translation: Blessed is the trader, O Nanak, who, as Gurmukh, takes the Name as his only Support. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਿਝਈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vin man maare koi na sijhiee vekhahu ko liv lai ||
verses.translation: Without conquering his mind, no one can be successful. See this, and concentrate on it.

verses.original: ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ਤੀਰਥੀ ਭਵਿ ਥਕੇ ਨਾ ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhekhadhaaree teerathee bhav thake naa eh man maariaa jai ||
verses.translation: The wandering holy men are tired of of making pilgrimages to sacred shrines; they have not been able to conquer their minds.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh eh man jeevat marai sach rahai liv lai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh has conquered his mind, and he remains lovingly absorbed in the True Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਇਉ ਉਤਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak is man kee mal iau utarai haumai sabadh jalai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, this is how the filth of the mind is removed; the Word of the Shabad burns away the ego. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵਹੁ ਇਕ ਕਿਨਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: har har sa(n)t milahu mere bhaiee har naam dhiraRaavahu ik kinakaa ||
verses.translation: O Saints of the Lord, O my Siblings of Destiny, please meet with me, and implant the Name of the One Lord within me.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਨਾਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਪਹਿਰਹੁ ਖਿਮ ਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: har har seegaar banaavahu har jan har kaapaR pahirahu khim kaa ||
verses.translation: O humble servants of the Lord, adorn me with the decorations of the Lord, Har, Har; let me wear the robes of the Lord's forgiveness.

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਿਮ ਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa seegaar mere prabh bhaavai har laagai piaaraa piram kaa ||
verses.translation: Such decorations are pleasing to my God; such love is dear to the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟੈ ਇਕ ਪਲਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam bolahu dhin raatee sabh kilabikh kaaTai ik palakaa ||
verses.translation: I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, day and night; in an instant, all sins are eradicated.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਉਪਰਿ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਿਣਕਾ ॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: har har dhiaal hovai jis upar so gurmukh har jap jinakaa ||21||
verses.translation: That Gurmukh, unto whom the Lord becomes merciful, chants the Lord's Name, and wins the game of life. ||21||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਕਾਲਾ ਹੋਆ ਸਿਆਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: janam janam kee is man kau mal laagee kaalaa hoaa siaahu ||
verses.translation: The filth of countless incarnations sticks to this mind; it has become pitch black.

verses.original: ਖੰਨਲੀ ਧੋਤੀ ਉਜਲੀ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਸਉ ਧੋਵਣਿ ਪਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: kha(n)nalee dhotee ujalee na hoviee je sau dhovan paahu ||
verses.translation: The oily rag cannot be cleaned by merely washing it, even if it is washed a hundred times.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਉਲਟੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਤਿ ਬਦਲਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee jeevat marai ulaTee hovai mat badhalaahu ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, one remains dead while yet alive; his intellect is transformed, and he becomes detached from the world.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਨਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak mail na lagiee naa fir jonee paahu ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, no filth sticks to him, and he does not fall into the womb again. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ ਕਲਿ ਕਾਲੀ ਕਾਂਢੀ ਇਕ ਉਤਮ ਪਦਵੀ ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: chahu jugee kal kaalee kaa(n)ddee ik utam padhavee is jug maeh ||
verses.translation: Kali Yuga is called the Dark Age, but the most sublime state is attained in this age.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh har keerat fal paieeaai jin kau har likh paeh ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh obtains the fruit, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises; this is his destiny, ordained by the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਚਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gur parasaadhee anadhin bhagat har uchareh har bhagatee maeh samaeh ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, by Guru's Grace, he worships the Lord night and day; he chants the Lord's Name, and remains absorbed in the Lord's devotional worship. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਲੀ ਬਾਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: har har mel saadh jan sa(n)gat mukh bolee har har bhalee baan ||
verses.translation: O Lord, unite me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, so that with my mouth, I may speak the sublime Word of the Guru's Bani.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਚਵਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਾਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: har gun gaavaa har nit chavaa gurmatee har ra(n)g sadhaa maan ||
verses.translation: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and constantly chant the Lord's Name; through the Guru's Teachings, I enjoy the Lord's Love constantly.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਅਉਖਧ ਖਾਧਿਆ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ਗਵਾਤੇ ਦੁਖਾ ਘਾਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: har jap jap aaukhadh khaadhiaa sabh rog gavaate dhukhaa ghaan ||
verses.translation: I take the medicine of meditation on the Lord's Name, which has cured all diseases and multitudes of sufferings.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਹੀ ਜਾਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: jinaa saas giraas na visarai se har jan poore sahee jaan ||
verses.translation: Those who do not forget the Lord, while breathing or eating - know them to be the perfect servants of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਚੂਕੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਜਗਤ ਕਾਣਿ ॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: jo gurmukh har aaraadhadhe tin chookee jam kee jagat kaan ||22||
verses.translation: Those Gurmukhs who worship the Lord in adoration end their subservience to the Messenger of Death, and to the world. ||22||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਰੇ ਜਨ ਉਥਾਰੈ ਦਬਿਓਹੁ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਗਈ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: re jan uthaarai dhabioh sutiaa giee vihai ||
verses.translation: O man, you have been tormented by a nightmare, and you have passed your life in sleep.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਨ ਜਾਗਿਓ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਚਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kaa sabadh sun na jaagio a(n)tar na upajio chaau ||
verses.translation: You did not wake to hear the Word of the True Guru's Shabad; you have no inspiration within yourself.

verses.original: ਸਰੀਰੁ ਜਲਉ ਗੁਣ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਕਾਰ ਨ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sareer jalau gun baaharaa jo gur kaar na kamai ||
verses.translation: That body burns, which has no virtue, and which does not serve the Guru.

verses.original: ਜਗਤੁ ਜਲੰਦਾ ਡਿਠੁ ਮੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jagat jala(n)dhaa ddiTh mai haumai dhoojai bhai ||
verses.translation: I have seen that the world is burning, in egotism and the love of duality.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak gur saranaiee ubare sach man sabadh dhiaai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who seek the Guru's Sanctuary are saved; within their minds, they meditate on the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਈ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh rate haumai giee sobhaava(n)tee naar ||
verses.translation: Attuned to the Word of the Shabad, the soul-bride is rid of egotism, and she is glorified.

verses.original: ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਦਾ ਚਲੈ ਤਾ ਬਨਿਆ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: pir kai bhaanai sadhaa chalai taa baniaa seegaar ||
verses.translation: If she walks steadily in the way of His Will, then she is adorned with decorations.

verses.original: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sej suhaavee sadhaa pir raavai har var paiaa naar ||
verses.translation: Her couch becomes beautiful, and she constantly enjoys her Husband Lord; she obtains the Lord as her Husband.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਕਦੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: naa har marai na kadhe dhukh laagai sadhaa suhaagan naar ||
verses.translation: The Lord does not die, and she never suffers pain; she is a happy soul-bride forever.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak har prabh mel liee gur kai het piaar ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord God unites her with Himself; she enshrines love and affection for the Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਪਿਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਤੇ ਨਰ ਬੁਰਿਆਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jinaa gur gopiaa aapanaa te nar buriaaree ||
verses.translation: Those who conceal and deny their Guru, are the most evil people.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਪਾਪਿਸਟ ਹਤਿਆਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau tin kaa dharasan naa karahu paapisaT hatiaaree ||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord, let me not even see them; they are the worst sinners and murderers.

verses.original: ਓਹਿ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਕੁਸੁਧ ਮਨਿ ਜਿਉ ਧਰਕਟ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: oh ghar ghar fireh kusudh man jiau dharakaT naaree ||
verses.translation: They wander from house to house, with impure minds, like wicked, forsaken women.

verses.original: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: vaddabhaagee sa(n)gat mile gurmukh savaaree ||
verses.translation: But by great good fortune, they may meet the Company of the Holy; as Gurmukhs, they are reformed.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੨੩॥
verses.translit: har melahu satigur dhiaa kar gur kau balihaaree ||23||
verses.translation: O Lord, please be kind and let me meet the True Guru; I am a sacrifice to the Guru. ||23||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur sevaa te sukh uoopajai fir dhukh na lagai aai ||
verses.translation: Serving the Guru, peace is produced, and then, one does not suffer in pain.

verses.original: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ ਕਾਲੈ ਕਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਬਸਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ja(n)man maranaa miT giaa kaalai kaa kichh na basai ||
verses.translation: The cycle of birth and death is brought to an end, and death has no power over at all.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਚੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har setee man rav rahiaa sache rahiaa samai ||
verses.translation: His mind is imbued with the Lord, and he remains merged in the True Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿੰਨ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਚਲਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak hau balihaaree ti(n)n kau jo chalan satigur bhai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who walk in the Way of the True Guru's Will. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਸੁਧੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਰੈ ਸੀਗਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: bin sabadhai sudh na hoviee je anek karai seegaar ||
verses.translation: Without the Word of the Shabad, purity is not obtained, even though the soul-bride may adorn herself with all sorts of decorations.

verses.original: ਪਿਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: pir kee saar na jaaniee dhoojai bhai piaar ||
verses.translation: She does not know the value of her Husband Lord; she is attached to the love of duality.

verses.original: ਸਾ ਕੁਸੁਧ ਸਾ ਕੁਲਖਣੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਰੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਕੁਨਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saa kusudh saa kulakhanee naanak naaree vich kunaar ||2||
verses.translation: She is impure, and ill-mannered, O Nanak; among women, she is the most evil woman. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਪਣੀ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਬੈਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: har har apanee dhiaa kar har bolee bainee ||
verses.translation: Be kind to me, Lord, that I might chant the Word of Your Bani.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਉਚਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਲੈਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: har naam dhiaaiee har ucharaa har laahaa lainee ||
verses.translation: May I meditate on the Lord's Name, chant the Lord's Name, and obtain the profit of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜਪਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬੈਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: jo japadhe har har dhinas raat tin hau kurabainee ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, day and night.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਦੇਖਾ ਨੈਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: jinaa satigur meraa piaaraa araadhiaa tin jan dhekhaa nainee ||
verses.translation: May I behold with my eyes those who worship and adore my Beloved True Guru.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਅਪਣੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਮੇਲਿਆ ਸੈਣੀ ॥੨੪॥
verses.translit: hau vaariaa apane guroo kau jin meraa har sajan meliaa sainee ||24||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has united me with my Lord, my friend, my very best friend. ||24||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਨ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੋ ਮਿਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: har dhaasan siau preet hai har dhaasan ko mit ||
verses.translation: The Lord loves His slaves; the Lord is the friend of His slaves.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਜਿਉ ਜੰਤੀ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਜੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: har dhaasan kai vas hai jiau ja(n)tee kai vas ja(n)t ||
verses.translation: The Lord is under the control of His slaves, like the musical instrument under the control of the musician.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: har ke dhaas har dhiaaidhe kar preetam siau neh ||
verses.translation: The Lord's slaves meditate on the Lord; they love their Beloved.

verses.original: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਸੈ ਮੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: kirapaa kar kai sunahu prabh sabh jag meh varasai meh ||
verses.translation: Please, hear me, O God - let Your Grace rain over the whole world.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਹੈ ਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: jo har dhaasan kee usatat hai saa har kee vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: The praise of the Lord's slaves is the Glory of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਭਾਵਦੀ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har aapanee vaddiaaiee bhaavadhee jan kaa jaikaar karaiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord loves His Own Glory, and so His humble servant is celebrated and hailed.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਇਕ ਸਮਾਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: so har jan naam dhiaaidhaa har har jan ik samaan ||
verses.translation: That humble servant of the Lord meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the Lord, and the Lord's humble servant, are one and the same.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਹੁ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak har kaa dhaas hai har paij rakhahu bhagavaan ||1||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak is the slave of the Lord; O Lord, O God, please, preserve his honor. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: naanak preet laiee tin saachai tis bin rahan na jaiee ||
verses.translation: Nanak loves the True Lord; without Him, he cannot even survive.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: satigur milai ta pooraa paieeaai har ras rasan rasaiee ||2||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, one finds the Perfect Lord, and the tongue enjoys the sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਪਰਭਾਤਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਹੀ ਗਾਵਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: rain dhinas parabhaat toohai hee gaavanaa ||
verses.translation: Night and day, morning and night, I sing to You, Lord.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਰਬਤ ਨਾਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਧਿਆਵਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t sarabat naau teraa dhiaavanaa ||
verses.translation: All beings and creatures meditate on Your Name.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਖਾਵਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: too dhaataa dhaataar teraa dhitaa khaavanaa ||
verses.translation: You are the Giver, the Great Giver; we eat whatever You give us.

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਪ ਗਵਾਵਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat janaa kai sa(n)g paap gavaavanaa ||
verses.translation: In the congregation of the devotees, sins are eradicated.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵਣਾ ॥੨੫॥
verses.translit: jan naanak sadh balihaarai bal bal jaavanaa ||25||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, O Lord. ||25||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਭਈ ਮਤਿ ਮਧਿਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar agiaan bhiee mat madhim satigur kee parateet naahee ||
verses.translation: He has spiritual ignorance within, and his intellect is dull and dim; he does not place his faith in the True Guru.

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਪਟੋ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਪਟੇ ਖਪਹਿ ਖਪਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhar kapaT sabh kapaTo kar jaanai kapaTe khapeh khapaahee ||
verses.translation: He has deceit within himself, and so he sees deception in all others; through his deceptions, he is totally ruined.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਆਪਣੈ ਸੁਆਇ ਫਿਰਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kaa bhaanaa chit na aavai aapanai suaai firaahee ||
verses.translation: The True Guru's Will does not enter into his consciousness, and so he wanders around, pursuing his own interests.
