verses.original: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kirapaa kare je aapanee taa naanak sabadh samaahee ||1||
verses.translation: If He grants His Grace, then Nanak is absorbed into the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਮਨੂਆ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh maiaa moh viaape dhoojai bhai manooaa thir naeh ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are engrossed in emotional attachment to Maya; in the love of duality, their minds are unsteady.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਲਤ ਰਹਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਖਪਹਿ ਖਪਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin jalat raheh dhin raatee haumai khapeh khapaeh ||
verses.translation: Night and day, they are burning; day and night, they are totally ruined by their egotism.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਮਹਾ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar lobh mahaa gubaaraa tin kai nikaT na koiee jaeh ||
verses.translation: Within them, is the total pitch darkness of greed, and no one even approaches them.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਆਪਿ ਦੁਖੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: oi aap dhukhee sukh kabahoo na paaveh janam mareh mar jaeh ||
verses.translation: They themselves are miserable, and they never find peace; they are born, only to die, and die again.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਜਿ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak bakhas le prabh saachaa j gur charanee chit laeh ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the True Lord God forgives those, who focus their consciousness on the Guru's feet. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਭਗਤ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t bhagat paravaan jo prabh bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: That Saint, that devotee, is acceptable, who is loved by God.

verses.original: ਸੇਈ ਬਿਚਖਣ ਜੰਤ ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: seiee bichakhan ja(n)t jinee har dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: Those beings are wise, who meditate on the Lord.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit naam nidhaan bhojan khaiaa ||
verses.translation: They eat the food, the treasure of the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa kee dhoor masatak laiaa ||
verses.translation: They apply the dust of the feet of the Saints to their foreheads.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਹਰਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਇਆ ॥੨੬॥
verses.translit: naanak bhe puneet har teerath naiaa ||26||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they are purified, bathing in the sacred shrine of the Lord. ||26||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh a(n)tar saa(n)t hai man tan naam samai ||
verses.translation: Within the Gurmukh is peace and tranquility; his mind and body are absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੋ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੜੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naamo chitavai naam paRai naam rahai liv lai ||
verses.translation: He contemplates the Naam, he studies the Naam, and he remains lovingly absorbed in the Naam.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਗਈ ਬਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naam padhaarath paiaa chi(n)taa giee bilai ||
verses.translation: He obtains the treasure of the Naam, and his anxiety is dispelled.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur miliaai naam uoopajai tisanaa bhukh sabh jai ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Guru, the Naam wells up, and his thirst and hunger are completely relieved.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਤਿਆ ਨਾਮੋ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak naame ratiaa naamo palai pai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, he gathers in the Naam. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਜਿ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਆ ਘਰੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: satigur purakh j maariaa bhram bhramiaa ghar chhodd giaa ||
verses.translation: One who is cursed by the True Guru, abandons his home, and wanders around aimlessly.

verses.original: ਓਸੁ ਪਿਛੈ ਵਜੈ ਫਕੜੀ ਮੁਹੁ ਕਾਲਾ ਆਗੈ ਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: os pichhai vajai fakaRee muh kaalaa aagai bhiaa ||
verses.translation: He is jeered at, and his face is blackened in the world hereafter.

verses.original: ਓਸੁ ਅਰਲੁ ਬਰਲੁ ਮੁਹਹੁ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਨਿਤ ਝਗੂ ਸੁਟਦਾ ਮੁਆ ॥
verses.translit: os aral baral muhahu nikalai nit jhagoo suTadhaa muaa ||
verses.translation: He babbles incoherently, and foaming at the mouth, he dies.

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਸੈ ਹੀ ਦੈ ਕੀਤੈ ਜਾਂ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਓਸ ਦਾ ਏਹੋ ਜੇਹਾ ਪਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa hovai kisai hee dhai keetai jaa(n) dhur kirat os dhaa eho jehaa piaa ||
verses.translation: What can anyone do? Such is his destiny, according to his past deeds.

verses.original: ਜਿਥੈ ਓਹੁ ਜਾਇ ਤਿਥੈ ਓਹੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jithai oh jai tithai oh jhooThaa kooR bole kisai na bhaavai ||
verses.translation: Wherever he goes, he is a liar, and by telling lies, he not liked by anyone.

verses.original: ਵੇਖਹੁ ਭਾਈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਜੈਸਾ ਕੋਈ ਕਰੈ ਤੈਸਾ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: vekhahu bhaiee vaddiaaiee har sa(n)tahu suaamee apune kee jaisaa koiee karai taisaa koiee paavai ||
verses.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, behold this, the glorious greatness of our Lord and Master, O Saints; as one behaves, so does he receive.

verses.original: ਏਹੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਅਗੋ ਦੇ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: eh braham beechaar hovai dhar saachai ago dhe jan naanak aakh sunaavai ||2||
verses.translation: This shall be God's determination in His True Court; servant Nanak predicts and proclaims this. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਬਧਾ ਥੇਹੁ ਰਖਵਾਲੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur sachai badhaa theh rakhavaale gur dhite ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has established the village; the Guru has appointed its guards and protectors.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਆਸ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨ ਰਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: pooran hoiee aas gur charanee man rate ||
verses.translation: My hopes are fulfilled, and my mind is imbued with the love of the Guru's Feet.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਿ ਬੇਅੰਤਿ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਸਭਿ ਹਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kirapaal bea(n)t avagun sabh hate ||
verses.translation: The Guru is infinitely merciful; He has erased all my sins.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਅਪਣੇ ਕਰਿ ਲਿਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur apanee kirapaa dhaar apane kar lite ||
verses.translation: The Guru has showered me with His Mercy, and He has made me His own.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਇਤੇ ॥੨੭॥
verses.translit: naanak sadh balihaar jis gur ke gun ite ||27||
verses.translation: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to the Guru, who has countless virtues. ||27||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਰਜਾਇ ਲੇਖਿਆ ਪਾਇ ਅਬ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜੈ ਪਾਂਡੇ ॥
verses.translit: taa kee rajai lekhiaa pai ab kiaa keejai paa(n)dde ||
verses.translation: By His Command, we receive our pre-ordained rewards; so what can we do now, O Pandit?

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਹਾਸਲੁ ਤਦੇ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਬੜਿਆ ਹੰਢਹਿ ਜੀਅ ਕਮਾਂਦੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hukam hoaa haasal tadhe hoi nibaRiaa ha(n)ddeh jeea kamaa(n)dhe ||1||
verses.translation: When His Command is received, then it is decided; all beings move and act accordingly. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਕਿ ਨਥ ਖਸਮ ਹਥ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਧਕੇ ਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: nak nath khasam hath kirat dhake dhe ||
verses.translation: The string through the nose is in the hands of the Lord Master; one's own actions drive him on.

verses.original: ਜਹਾ ਦਾਣੇ ਤਹਾਂ ਖਾਣੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਚੁ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jahaa dhaane tahaa(n) khaane naanakaa sach he ||2||
verses.translation: Wherever his food is, there he eats it; O Nanak, this is the Truth. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਭੇ ਗਲਾ ਆਪਿ ਥਾਟਿ ਬਹਾਲੀਓਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabhe galaa aap thaaT bahaaleeon ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself puts everything in its proper place.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਘਾਲਿਓਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape rachan rachai aape hee ghaalion ||
verses.translation: He Himself created the creation, and He Himself destroys it.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਿਓਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape ja(n)t upai aap pratipaalion ||
verses.translation: He Himself fashions His creatures, and He Himself nourishes them.

verses.original: ਦਾਸ ਰਖੇ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਓਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhaas rakhe ka(n)Th lai nadhar nihaalion ||
verses.translation: He hugs His slaves close in His embrace, and blesses them with His Glance of Grace.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ਜਾਲਿਓਨੁ ॥੨੮॥
verses.translit: naanak bhagataa sadhaa ana(n)dh bhaau dhoojaa jaalion ||28||
verses.translation: O Nanak, His devotees are forever in bliss; they have burnt away the love of duality. ||28||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਏ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕ ਚਿਤਿ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: e man har jee dhiaai too ik man ik chit bhai ||
verses.translation: O mind, meditate on the Dear Lord, with single-minded conscious concentration.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har keeaa sadhaa sadhaa vaddiaaieeaa dhei na pachhotai ||
verses.translation: The glorious greatness of the Lord shall last forever and ever; He never regrets what He gives.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: hau har kai sadh balihaaranai jit seviaai sukh pai ||
verses.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to the Lord; serving Him, peace is obtained.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh mil rahai haumai sabadh jalai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh remains merged with the Lord; he burns away his ego through the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape sevaa laian aape bakhas karei ||
verses.translation: He Himself enjoins us to serve Him, and He Himself blesses us with forgiveness.

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਮਾ ਪਿਉ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa kaa maa piau aap hai aape saar karei ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the father and mother of all; He Himself cares for us.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਤਿਨ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam dhiaain tin nij ghar vaas hai jug jug sobhaa hoi ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abide in the home of their inner being; they are honored throughout the ages. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੂ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: too karan kaaran samarath heh karate mai tujh bin avar na koiee ||
verses.translation: You are the Creator, all-powerful, able to do anything. Without You, there is no other at all.
